# index.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/index.en.mdx

title: "Basic components"

The agent is the core of VeADK: driven by a model, with tools, memory, a knowledge base, and skills attached. `Agent` extends Google ADK's `LlmAgent`, adding model fallbacks, memory, knowledge base, skills, tracing, and a pluggable runtime. This page is organized by constructor parameters, explaining each group with examples.

<Callout type="info">
  Almost every parameter has a sensible default (mostly from environment variables or built-in defaults). The simplest `Agent()` runs with no arguments — start with the [Quickstart](/en/docs/framework/quickstart), then come back to configure.

```python title="agent.py"
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent()
response = asyncio.run(Runner(agent=agent).run("Hi!"))
print(response)
```

Before running, provide the model API key via an environment variable (`MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` by default):

```bash
export MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY="<your Ark API key>"
```

<Callout type="info">
  Keys can also be managed centrally in `config.yaml`; see [Configuration](/en/docs/references/configuration). **Never hard-code an API key in source.**

## Metadata

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `str` | `veAgent` | Agent name; uniquely identifies an agent in the Agent Tree, used as the identity for transfers, A2A, and tracing. |
| `description` | `str` | built-in | Short description of the agent's capabilities; used by parents/peers to decide transfers in multi-agent and A2A. |
| `instruction` | `str \| InstructionProvider` | built-in | System prompt. A string, or a callable that builds the prompt dynamically from context. |
| `id` | `str` | auto | Instance ID; rarely set by hand. |

```python title="agent.py"
root_agent = Agent(
    name="life_assistant",
    description="Life assistant",
    instruction="You are a life assistant who answers everyday questions.",
)
```

## Tools, memory, and knowledge base

Mounting these capabilities makes VeADK **auto-inject the corresponding tool or callback**.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tools` | `list[ToolUnion]` | `[]` | Tool list: plain functions, tool instances, toolsets, MCP tools, etc. |
| `sub_agents` | `list[BaseAgent]` | `[]` | Sub-agents, for building [multi-agent](/en/docs/framework/multi-agent/overview) systems. |
| `knowledgebase` | `KnowledgeBase \| None` | `None` | Attach a knowledge base. **Auto-injects the `load_knowledgebase` tool.** |
| `short_term_memory` | `ShortTermMemory \| None` | `None` | Short-term (single-session) memory, usually passed to `Runner`. |
| `long_term_memory` | `LongTermMemory \| None` | `None` | Long-term (cross-session) memory. **Auto-injects the `load_memory` tool.** |
| `auto_save_session` | `bool` | `False` | Persist the session to long-term memory on finish; requires `long_term_memory`. |
| `example_store` | `BaseExampleProvider \| None` | `None` | Few-shot example provider; injects an `ExampleTool` when set. |
| `prompt_manager` | `BasePromptManager \| None` | `None` | Prompt manager; see [Prompt management](/en/docs/framework/prompt). |

### Tools

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk.tools.demo_tools import get_city_weather

agent = Agent(instruction="Call tools to answer weather questions.", tools=[get_city_weather])
```

See [Built-in tools](/en/docs/framework/tools/builtin) and [Custom function tools](/en/docs/framework/tools/custom-function).

### Memory

Pass short-term memory to `Runner` and long-term memory to `Agent`:

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

agent = Agent(long_term_memory=LongTermMemory(backend="local"))
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=ShortTermMemory(backend="local"))
```

See [Short-term memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term) and [Long-term memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term).

### Knowledge base

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

agent = Agent(
    instruction="Retrieve from the knowledge base before answering.",
    knowledgebase=KnowledgeBase(backend="local"),
)
```

See [Knowledge base](/en/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview).

---

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/index.mdx

title: "基本组件"

智能体（Agent）是 VeADK 的核心：由模型驱动，并可挂载工具、记忆、知识库与技能。`Agent` 继承自 Google ADK 的 `LlmAgent`，在其之上增加模型容错、记忆、知识库、技能、追踪与可插拔运行时等能力。本页按构造参数分组，逐组说明含义并给出示例。

<Callout type="info">
  绝大多数参数都有合理默认值（多来自环境变量或内置默认）。最简单的 `Agent()` 无需任何参数即可运行——先看[快速开始](/cn/docs/framework/quickstart)，再回到本页按需配置。

```python title="agent.py"
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent()
response = asyncio.run(Runner(agent=agent).run("Hi!"))
print(response)
```

运行前通过环境变量提供模型 API Key（默认读取 `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`）：

```bash
export MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY="<你的方舟 API Key>"
```

<Callout type="info">
  密钥也可在 `config.yaml` 中集中管理，详见[配置](/cn/docs/references/configuration)。**切勿在代码中硬编码 API Key。**

## 元信息

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `str` | `veAgent` | 智能体名称，在 Agent Tree 中唯一标识一个智能体；在多智能体转交、A2A、追踪中作为标识。 |
| `description` | `str` | 内置默认 | 智能体能力的简短描述。在多智能体与 A2A 场景中，父智能体/对端据此判断是否转交。 |
| `instruction` | `str \| InstructionProvider` | 内置默认 | 系统提示词。可传字符串，也可传一个根据上下文动态生成提示词的可调用对象。 |
| `id` | `str` | 自动生成 | 智能体实例 ID，一般无需手动设置。 |

```python title="agent.py"
root_agent = Agent(
    name="life_assistant",
    description="生活助手",
    instruction="你是一个生活助手，回答用户的日常问题。",
)
```

## 工具、记忆与知识库

挂载这些能力时，VeADK 会**自动注入对应的工具或回调**。

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tools` | `list[ToolUnion]` | `[]` | 工具列表。可放入普通函数、工具实例、Toolset、MCP 工具等。 |
| `sub_agents` | `list[BaseAgent]` | `[]` | 子智能体列表，用于构建[多智能体](/cn/docs/framework/multi-agent/overview)系统。 |
| `knowledgebase` | `KnowledgeBase \| None` | `None` | 挂载知识库。**自动注入 `load_knowledgebase` 工具**。 |
| `short_term_memory` | `ShortTermMemory \| None` | `None` | 短期记忆（单会话上下文），通常传给 `Runner`。 |
| `long_term_memory` | `LongTermMemory \| None` | `None` | 长期记忆（跨会话上下文）。**自动注入 `load_memory` 工具**。 |
| `auto_save_session` | `bool` | `False` | 会话结束后自动写入长期记忆，需先配置 `long_term_memory`。 |
| `example_store` | `BaseExampleProvider \| None` | `None` | 少样本示例提供器，设置后注入 `ExampleTool`。 |
| `prompt_manager` | `BasePromptManager \| None` | `None` | 提示词管理器，详见 [Prompt 管理](/cn/docs/framework/prompt)。 |

### 工具

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk.tools.demo_tools import get_city_weather

agent = Agent(instruction="根据用户问题调用工具回答天气。", tools=[get_city_weather])
```

参见[内置工具](/cn/docs/framework/tools/builtin)与[自定义函数工具](/cn/docs/framework/tools/custom-function)。

### 记忆

短期记忆传给 `Runner`，长期记忆传给 `Agent`：

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

agent = Agent(long_term_memory=LongTermMemory(backend="local"))
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=ShortTermMemory(backend="local"))
```

参见[短期记忆](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term)与[长期记忆](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term)。

### 知识库

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

agent = Agent(
    instruction="回答前先检索知识库。",
    knowledgebase=KnowledgeBase(backend="local"),
)
```

参见[知识库](/cn/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview)。

# model.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/model.en.mdx

title: "Model"

VeADK builds the model client on [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) by default, so every LiteLLM provider is supported.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `str \| list[str]` | env `MODEL_AGENT_NAME` | Model name. **A list enables fallbacks**: the first is primary, the rest are tried in order. |
| `model_provider` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_PROVIDER` | Provider, e.g. `openai`. See the [LiteLLM provider list](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers). |
| `model_api_base` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE` | Base URL of the model API. |
| `model_api_key` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` | Model API key. **Never hard-code it** — use env vars or `config.yaml`. |
| `model_extra_config` | `dict` | `{}` | Extra config forwarded to model requests; supports `extra_headers` and `extra_body`, merged with VeADK defaults. |
| `model` | `LiteLlm` | `None` | A pre-built LiteLLM client. **Once set, the `model_*` fields are ignored.** |
| `enable_responses` | `bool` | `False` | Use the Ark Responses API; see [Responses API](/en/docs/framework/agent/responses-api). |
| `enable_responses_cache` | `bool` | `True` | Reuse `previous_response_id` for multi-turn continuation and caching; only when `enable_responses=True`. |
| `context_cache_config` | `ContextCacheConfig` | `None` | Context-cache config to reduce repeated computation on long contexts. |

## Use a different model

Specify a provider or local model (the API key still comes from the environment):

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(
    model_provider="openai",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    model_api_base="https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/",
)
```

## Model fallbacks

Pass a list to `model_name`: the first model is tried first; on failure the next is tried, until one succeeds.

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(model_name=["doubao-seed-1-8-251228", "deepseek-r1-250528"])
```

## Customize the model client

For full control, pass a LiteLLM client directly:

```python title="agent.py"
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

agent = Agent(model=LiteLlm(model="doubao-seed-1-8-251228"))
```

## Extra parameters

Specify extra options based on [Ark platform](https://www.volcengine.com/product/ark) capabilities — for example, disable thinking for faster responses:

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    model_extra_config={"extra_body": {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}},
)
```

---

# model.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/model.mdx

title: "模型管理"

VeADK 默认基于 [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) 构建模型客户端，因此支持 LiteLLM 的所有提供商。

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `str \| list[str]` | 环境变量 `MODEL_AGENT_NAME` | 模型名称。**传入列表即开启容错**：第一个为主模型，其余作为 fallback 依次重试。 |
| `model_provider` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_PROVIDER` | 模型提供商，如 `openai`。参见 [LiteLLM 提供商列表](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers)。 |
| `model_api_base` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE` | 模型 API 的 base URL。 |
| `model_api_key` | `str` | `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` | 模型 API Key。**切勿硬编码**，通过环境变量或 `config.yaml` 提供。 |
| `model_extra_config` | `dict` | `{}` | 透传给模型请求的额外配置，支持 `extra_headers` 与 `extra_body`，会与 VeADK 默认值合并。 |
| `model` | `LiteLlm` | `None` | 直接传入构造好的 LiteLLM 客户端。**一旦设置，上面的 `model_*` 字段将被忽略**。 |
| `enable_responses` | `bool` | `False` | 启用方舟 Responses API，详见 [Responses API 支持](/cn/docs/framework/agent/responses-api)。 |
| `enable_responses_cache` | `bool` | `True` | 在 Responses API 下复用 `previous_response_id` 做多轮续接与缓存，仅在 `enable_responses=True` 时生效。 |
| `context_cache_config` | `ContextCacheConfig` | `None` | 上下文缓存配置，用于降低长上下文的重复计算成本。 |

## 使用不同模型

指定提供商或本地模型（API Key 仍通过环境变量提供）：

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(
    model_provider="openai",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    model_api_base="https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/",
)
```

## 模型容错（Fallbacks）

将 `model_name` 传入列表即开启容错：按顺序优先尝试第一个模型，失败后依次尝试后续模型，直至成功。

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(model_name=["doubao-seed-1-8-251228", "deepseek-r1-250528"])
```

## 自定义模型客户端

如需高度自定义，直接传入一个 LiteLLM 客户端：

```python title="agent.py"
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

agent = Agent(model=LiteLlm(model="doubao-seed-1-8-251228"))
```

## 配置额外参数

根据[方舟平台](https://www.volcengine.com/product/ark)能力指定额外选项。例如关闭思考以获得更快响应：

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    model_extra_config={"extra_body": {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}},
)
```

---

# responses-api.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/responses-api.en.mdx

title: "Responses API"

The Responses API is the latest API released by Volcengine Ark. It natively supports efficient context management and offers a more concise input/output format. Its tool-calling approach is more convenient — it preserves the ease of use of the Chat API while combining stronger agentic capabilities.

As foundation model technology keeps advancing, the Responses API provides a more flexible foundation for building action-oriented applications of all kinds, and supports a variety of tool-calling extensions, making it well suited for building intelligent assistants, automation tools, and similar scenarios.

## Tutorial

Currently only the `veadk-python` version supports the Responses API, and it has a specific requirement on the `google-adk` version (`google-adk>=1.21.0`). Make sure your environment meets the requirement.

<Tabs items={['pip', 'uv']}>
<Tab value="pip">

```bash
pip install "google-adk>=1.21.0"
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="uv">

```bash
uv pip install "google-adk>=1.21.0"
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

### Quick Start

**Enable the Responses API**

Just set `enable_responses=True`.

```python
from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    enable_responses=True, # Enable the Responses API
)
```

**Result**

![responses-api](/assets/images/agents/responses_api.png)

### Multimodal Support

Beyond text interaction, the Responses API also supports multimodal understanding of images, video, and files. You can use the `google.genai.types.FileData` field to pass multimodal data (such as an image path, a video URL, or a file_id generated by the Files API).

`FileData` supports the following ways of passing data:

1. **Files API resource (`file_id`)**
    - Passed via `file_data`; you must add a specific scheme prefix in `file_uri` to distinguish it.
    - Format: `file_uri="file_id://xxxxxxx"`; this value is automatically mapped to the `file_id` field.

2. **Generic resource identifier (URI)**
    All file upload methods supported by Volcengine Ark (including `image_url`, `video_url`, `file_url`) can be handled uniformly through `file_data`.
    1. **Network URL**
        - The system automatically detects the resource type (video, image, file, etc.) based on `mime_type`.
        - Format: `file_uri="https://..."`
    2. **Local file path**
        - Use the local file path directly as `file_uri`; the underlying layer automatically calls the Files API to complete the upload.
        - Format: `file_uri=f"file://{local_path}"`
    3. **Base64 Data URI**
        - Supports passing Base64-encoded data.
        - Reference: [Volcengine Ark: Image Understanding - Base64 Encoding](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1362931?lang=zh#477e51ce)

#### Example Code

**Note**: All example code below is based on the following `Agent` configuration and `main` function:

```python
import os
import asyncio
import uuid

from google.adk.events import Event
from google.genai import types
from google.genai.types import FileData

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

agent = Agent(
    enable_responses=True
)
short_term_memory = ShortTermMemory()
runner = Runner(
    agent=agent,
    short_term_memory=short_term_memory,
)

async def main(message: types.Content):
    session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    await short_term_memory.session_service.create_session(
        app_name=runner.app_name, user_id=runner.user_id, session_id=session_id
    )

    async for event in runner.run_async(
        user_id=runner.user_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        new_message=message,
    ):
        if isinstance(event, Event) and event.is_final_response():
            if event.content and event.content.parts:
                if not event.content.parts[0].thought:
                    print(event.content.parts[0].text)
                elif len(event.content.parts) > 1:
                    print(event.content.parts[1].text)
```

#### Image Understanding

<Tabs items={['Local path', 'Files API', 'Image URL']}>
<Tab value="Local path">

Supports image files up to **512MB**.

This approach passes a local file path directly; the system automatically calls the Files API to upload it, then calls the Responses API for analysis.

```python
local_path = os.path.abspath("example-data.png")
message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="Describe this image"),
        types.Part(
            file_data=FileData(
                file_uri=f"file://{local_path}",
                mime_type="image/png"
            )
        )
    ],
)
asyncio.run(
    main(message)
)
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="Files API">

Upload the file via the Volcengine Ark Files API. Supports image files up to **512MB**.

```python
from veadk.utils.misc import upload_to_files_api
local_path = os.path.abspath("example-data.png")

message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="Describe this image"),

                file_uri=f"file_id://{file_id}",

            )
```

#### Video Understanding

<Tabs items={['Files API', 'Video URL']}>
<Tab value="Files API">

Upload the file via the Volcengine Ark Files API. Supports video files up to **512MB**.

When passing a video file in `file_data`, you may optionally add the `video_metadata` field to specify the video frame rate (fps).

You can use the `fps` field to control how often frames are extracted from the video. The default is 1, i.e. one frame is extracted per second and fed to the model for visual understanding. Adjust the `fps` field to balance video length against model processing efficiency.

- When the video changes rapidly or you need to track frame changes (e.g. counting a character's actions), increase `fps` (up to 5) to prevent missing content due to too-sparse sampling.
- When the video changes slowly or frame changes are not important (e.g. analyzing a person's behavior), lower `fps` appropriately (down to 0.2) to balance video length and processing efficiency.

```python
from veadk.utils.misc import upload_to_files_api
local_path = os.path.abspath("example-video.mp4")
file_id = asyncio.run(upload_to_files_api(local_path, fps=0.3)) # optional `fps`
message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="Describe this video"),
        types.Part(
            file_data=FileData(
                file_uri=f"file_id://{file_id}",
                mime_type="video/mp4"
            ),
            video_metadata={        # optional
                "fps": 0.3
            }
        )
    ],
)
asyncio.run(
    main(message)
)
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="Video URL">

Supports video files up to **50MB**.

```python
video_url = "<your-video-url>"
message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="Describe this video"),
        types.Part(
            file_data=FileData(
                file_uri=f"{video_url}",
                mime_type="video/mp4"
            )
        )
    ],
)
asyncio.run(
    main(message)
)
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

#### Document Understanding

Some models support processing PDF documents; the system understands the entire document's context through its vision capabilities. When a PDF document is passed in, the model paginates the file into multiple images, analyzes and interprets the text and image information within, and combines this information to complete the document-understanding task.

<Tabs items={['Files API', 'Document URL']}>

## Context Caching

In Responses API mode, VeADK enables session caching by default. This mechanism automatically stores the initial context and dynamically updates it on each conversation turn. On subsequent requests, the system merges the cached content with the new input before sending it to the model for inference. This is especially useful for long-context scenarios such as multi-turn conversations and complex tool calls.

### Viewing Cache Information

You can inspect token usage and cache hits through the returned `Event.usage_metadata` field.

Here is an example `usage_metadata` from a conversation with two turns:

```json
{"cached_content_token_count":0,"candidates_token_count":87,"prompt_token_count":210,"total_token_count":297}
{"cached_content_token_count":297,"candidates_token_count":181,"prompt_token_count":314,"total_token_count":495}
```

**Field descriptions:**

- `cached_content_token_count`: Number of cached tokens hit (i.e. tokens read from the cache).
- `candidates_token_count`: Number of tokens generated by the model (output tokens).
- `prompt_token_count`: Total number of input tokens sent to the model (including both cached and uncached parts).
- `total_token_count`: Total tokens consumed (input + output).

**Caching mechanism notes:**

- Caching only affects input (prompt) tokens, not output (completion) tokens.
- The **cache hit rate** reflects the effectiveness of the caching strategy; the higher the hit rate, the greater the token cost savings.
  - Formula: `cache hit rate = (cached_content_token_count / prompt_token_count) × 100%`
- Input token cost-saving rate: used to quantify the cache benefit across the whole session. It is the core business-facing metric and supports session-level aggregation.

### Cost Savings Example

Based on the sample data above, the cache hit rate is computed as follows:

- **First turn**: 0% (initial state, no cache)
- **Second turn**: `297 / 314 * 100% ≈ 94.58%`

Input token cost-saving rate: `(0 + 297) / (210 + 314) ≈ 56.68%`

This means that with caching enabled, the session's **input token cache hit rate reached 56.68%**, greatly reducing the computation overhead of repeated content. [Volcengine Ark: Cached Token Billing](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1544106?lang=zh)

Note: The `cached_content_token_count` of turn N is not necessarily equal to the `total_token_count` of turn N-1; if thinking is enabled, the two are not equal.

## Notes

1. **Version requirement**: You must ensure `google-adk>=1.21.0`.
2. **Model support**: Make sure the model you use supports the Responses API (note: Doubao series models after version 0615 generally support it unless otherwise stated).
3. **Caching mechanism**: When VeADK enables the Responses API with a Volcengine Ark model, context (session) caching is enabled by default. However, if `output_schema` is set on the Agent, caching is automatically disabled because that field conflicts with the caching mechanism.

## References

1. [Volcengine Ark: Responses API Migration Guide](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1585128?lang=zh)
2. [Volcengine Ark: Context Caching](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1602228?lang=zh#3e69e743)
3. [Volcengine Ark: Cached Token Billing](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1544106?lang=zh)
4. [Volcengine Ark: Multimodal Understanding](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1958521?lang=zh)

# responses-api.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/responses-api.mdx

title: "Responses API"

Responses API 是火山方舟最新推出的 API 接口，原生支持高效的上下文管理，具备更简洁的输入输出格式。其工具调用方式更加便捷，不仅延续了 Chat API 的易用性，还结合了更强的智能代理能力。

随着大模型技术不断升级，Responses API 为开发各类面向实际行动的应用提供了更灵活的基础，并支持多种工具调用扩展能力，非常适合搭建智能助手、自动化工具等场景。

## 使用教程

目前仅 `veadk-python` 版本支持 Responses API，且对 `google-adk` 版本有特定要求（`google-adk>=1.21.0`）。请确保您的环境符合要求。

<Tabs items={['pip', 'uv']}>
<Tab value="pip">

```bash
pip install "google-adk>=1.21.0"
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="uv">

```bash
uv pip install "google-adk>=1.21.0"
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

### 快速开始

**开启 Responses API**

只需配置 `enable_responses=True` 即可。

```python
from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    enable_responses=True, # 开启 Responses API
)
```

**效果展示**

![responses-api](/assets/images/agents/responses_api.png)

### 多模态能力支持

Responses API 除文本交互外，还具备图片、视频和文件等多模态理解能力。您可以使用 `google.genai.types.FileData` 字段传递多模态数据（如图片路径、视频 URL、Files API 生成的 file_id 等）。

`FileData` 支持以下数据传递方式：

1. **Files API 资源 (`file_id`)**
    - 通过 `file_data` 传递，需在 `file_uri` 中添加特定 Scheme 前缀以区分。
    - 格式：`file_uri="file_id://xxxxxxx"`，该值将被自动映射到 `file_id` 字段。

2. **通用资源标识符 (URI)**
    火山方舟支持的所有文件上传方式（包括 `image_url`、`video_url`、`file_url`）均可通过 `file_data` 统一处理。
    1. **网络 URL**
        - 系统根据 `mime_type` 自动识别资源类型（视频、图片、文件等）。
        - 格式：`file_uri="https://..."`
    2. **本地文件路径**
        - 直接使用本地文件路径作为 `file_uri`，底层会自动调用 Files API 完成上传。
        - 格式：`file_uri=f"file://{local_path}"`
    3. **Base64 Data URI**
        - 支持传入 Base64 编码的数据。
        - 参考：[火山方舟：图片理解-Base64 编码](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1362931?lang=zh#477e51ce)

#### 样例代码

**注**：以下所有示例代码均基于下述 `Agent` 配置与 `main` 函数：

```python
import os
import asyncio
import uuid

from google.adk.events import Event
from google.genai import types
from google.genai.types import FileData

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

agent = Agent(
    enable_responses=True
)
short_term_memory = ShortTermMemory()
runner = Runner(
    agent=agent,
    short_term_memory=short_term_memory,
)

async def main(message: types.Content):
    session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    await short_term_memory.session_service.create_session(
        app_name=runner.app_name, user_id=runner.user_id, session_id=session_id
    )

    async for event in runner.run_async(
        user_id=runner.user_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        new_message=message,
    ):
        if isinstance(event, Event) and event.is_final_response():
            if event.content and event.content.parts:
                if not event.content.parts[0].thought:
                    print(event.content.parts[0].text)
                elif len(event.content.parts) > 1:
                    print(event.content.parts[1].text)
```

#### 图片理解

<Tabs items={['本地路径', 'Files API', '图片 URL']}>

```python
    main(message)
)
```

#### 视频理解

<Tabs items={['Files API', '视频 URL']}>
<Tab value="Files API">

通过火山方舟 Files API 上传文件，支持处理**最大 512MB** 的视频文件。

在 `file_data` 中传递视频文件时，可选择添加 `video_metadata` 字段，指定视频的帧率（fps）。

您可以通过 `fps` 字段，控制从视频中抽取图像的频率，默认为 1，即每秒从视频中抽取一帧图像，输入给模型进行视觉理解。可通过 fps 字段调整抽取频率，以平衡视频长度与模型处理效率。

- 当视频画面变化剧烈或需要关注画面变化，如计算视频中角色动作次数，可以调高 fps 的设置（最高为 5），防止抽帧频率过快导致模型无法准确理解视频内容。
- 当视频画面变化缓慢或不需要关注画面变化，如分析视频中人物行为，可适当降低 fps 的设置（最低为 0.2），以平衡视频长度与模型处理效率。

```python
from veadk.utils.misc import upload_to_files_api
local_path = os.path.abspath("example-video.mp4")
file_id = asyncio.run(upload_to_files_api(local_path, fps=0.3)) # optional `fps`
message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="描述一下这个视频"),
        types.Part(
            file_data=FileData(
                file_uri=f"file_id://{file_id}",
                mime_type="video/mp4"
            ),
            video_metadata={        # optional
                "fps": 0.3
            }
        )
    ],
)
asyncio.run(
    main(message)
)
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="视频 URL">

支持处理**最大 50MB** 的视频文件。

```python
video_url = "<your-video-url>"
message = types.UserContent(
    parts=[
        types.Part(text="描述一下这个视频"),
        types.Part(
            file_data=FileData(
                file_uri=f"{video_url}",
                mime_type="video/mp4"
            )
        )
    ],
)
asyncio.run(
    main(message)
)
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

## 上下文缓存

在 Responses API 模式下，VeADK 默认开启会话缓存（Session Caching）。该机制会自动存储初始上下文信息，并在每一轮对话中动态更新。在后续请求中，系统会将缓存内容与新输入合并后发送给模型推理。此功能特别适用于多轮对话、复杂工具调用等长上下文场景。

### 缓存信息查看

您可以通过返回的 `Event.usage_metadata` 字段查看 Token 使用及缓存命中情况。

以下是一次包含两轮对话的 `usage_metadata` 示例：

```json
{"cached_content_token_count":0,"candidates_token_count":87,"prompt_token_count":210,"total_token_count":297}
{"cached_content_token_count":297,"candidates_token_count":181,"prompt_token_count":314,"total_token_count":495}
```

**字段说明：**

- `cached_content_token_count`：命中缓存的 Token 数量（即从缓存中读取的 Token 数）。
- `candidates_token_count`：模型生成的 Token 数量（输出 Token）。
- `prompt_token_count`：输入给模型的总 Token 数量（包含已缓存和未缓存部分）。
- `total_token_count`：总消耗 Token 数量（输入 + 输出）。

**缓存机制说明：**

- 缓存仅影响输入（Prompt）Token，不影响输出（Completion）Token。
- **缓存命中率**反映了缓存策略的有效性，命中率越高，Token 成本节省越多。
  - 计算公式：`缓存命中率 = (cached_content_token_count / prompt_token_count) × 100%`
- 输入 Token 成本节约率：用于量化整个会话的缓存收益，是面向业务侧的核心指标，支持会话级汇总计算。

### 成本节省示例

基于上述样例数据，缓存命中率计算如下：

- **第一轮对话**：0%（初始状态，无缓存）
- **第二轮对话**：`297 / 314 * 100% ≈ 94.58%`

输入 Token 成本节约率：`(0 + 297) / (210 + 314) ≈ 56.68%`

这意味着在开启缓存后，该次会话的 **输入 Token 缓存命中率达到了 56.68%**，大幅减少了重复内容的计算开销。[火山方舟：缓存 Token 计费说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1544106?lang=zh)

注：第 N 轮的 `cached_content_token_count` 不一定等于第 N-1 轮的 `total_token_count`，如果开启了 thinking，二者不等。

## 注意事项

1. **版本要求**：必须保证 `google-adk>=1.21.0`。
2. **模型支持**：请确保使用的模型支持 Responses API（注：Doubao 系列模型 0615 版本之后，除特殊说明外均支持）。
3. **缓存机制**：VeADK 开启 Responses API 并使用火山方舟模型时默认开启上下文缓存（Session 缓存）。但若在 Agent 中设置了 `output_schema`，因该字段与缓存机制冲突，系统将自动关闭缓存。

## 参考文档

1. [火山方舟：Responses API 迁移文档](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1585128?lang=zh)
2. [火山方舟：上下文缓存](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1602228?lang=zh#3e69e743)
3. [火山方舟：缓存 Token 计费说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1544106?lang=zh)
4. [火山方舟：多模态理解](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1958521?lang=zh)

# runtime.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/runtime.en.mdx

title: "Runtime"
status: new

The runtime decides how an agent's inner loop runs — how each turn calls the model, parses intent, and invokes tools. The default runtime is built on Google ADK's execution flow and works out of the box. You can also switch to another execution backend, or insert shared processing into the flow (auth, logging, retries) without touching the agent itself.

## Basic usage

The ADK runtime is the default — no extra configuration needed:

```python title="agent.py"
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent(name="assistant")  # uses the ADK runtime by default
print(asyncio.run(Runner(agent=agent).run("Hello")))
```

## Switch the execution backend

Use `runtime` to choose the inner-loop backend:

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(name="assistant", runtime="codex")
```

| Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `adk` (default) | Google ADK's built-in execution flow; fits almost every case. |
| `codex` | An alternative backend for advanced customization. |

## Request processing

Insert shared, cross-cutting processing into every run — auth, logging, retries, performance monitoring — without touching business logic. Pass a processor to `run_processor`, for example to enforce login via identity auth:

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import AuthRequestProcessor

agent = Agent(name="assistant", run_processor=AuthRequestProcessor())
```

When unset, a default no-op processor is used and behavior is unchanged.

---

# runtime.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/runtime.mdx

title: "运行时"
status: new

运行时决定智能体「内层循环」如何执行——也就是每一轮怎样调用模型、解析意图、调用工具。默认运行时基于 Google ADK 的内置执行流程，开箱即用。你也可以切换到其他执行后端，或在执行流程上插入统一的处理逻辑（如鉴权、日志、重试），而无需改动智能体本身。

## 基本使用

默认即为 ADK 运行时，无需任何额外配置：

```python title="agent.py"
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent(name="assistant")  # 默认使用 ADK 运行时
print(asyncio.run(Runner(agent=agent).run("你好")))
```

## 切换执行后端

通过 `runtime` 选择内层循环的执行后端：

```python title="agent.py"
agent = Agent(name="assistant", runtime="codex")
```

| 取值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- |
| `adk`（默认） | 使用 Google ADK 内置的执行流程，适用于绝大多数场景。 |
| `codex` | 其他执行后端，面向高级定制场景。 |

## 请求处理

在不侵入业务逻辑的前提下，可为每次执行插入统一的横切处理——鉴权、日志、重试、性能监控等。把处理器传入 `run_processor` 即可，例如接入身份认证做登录态校验：

```python title="agent.py"
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import AuthRequestProcessor

agent = Agent(name="assistant", run_processor=AuthRequestProcessor())
```

不设置时使用默认的空处理器，不改变任何行为。

---

# skills.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/skills.en.mdx

title: "Skills"

Skills are reusable "prompt packages" that inject specific domain knowledge, operating procedures, and scripts into an Agent. For local skill loading and execution, the recommended integration is Google ADK's official `load_skill_from_dir` / `SkillToolset` path. VeADK's legacy `Agent(skills=..., skills_mode="local")` local entry point remains compatible, but is deprecated. The `skills_sandbox` and `aio_sandbox` modes keep their existing behavior.

## Recommended: ADK SkillToolset

Local skills can be loaded directly by Google ADK and passed to a VeADK Agent as a standard toolset:

```python
from google.adk.skills import load_skill_from_dir
from google.adk.tools.skill_toolset import SkillToolset
from veadk import Agent

skill = load_skill_from_dir("/abs/path/to/skills/kb-skill")
agent = Agent(
    tools=[SkillToolset(skills=[skill])],
)
```

On this path, skill loading, prompt injection, and tool exposure are handled by ADK. The model sees ADK's official skill tools: `list_skills`, `load_skill`, `load_skill_resource`, and `run_skill_script`. If a skill depends on `scripts/`, configure an appropriate `code_executor` explicitly on the `SkillToolset` or Agent; VeADK does not create a local code executor by default.

Cloud SkillHub / SkillSpace skills should be exposed through VeADK's ADK registry. `search_skills` fetches the remote list live, and `get_skill` downloads and loads a concrete skill only when requested:

```python
from google.adk.tools.skill_toolset import SkillToolset
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.skills import VeSkillRegistry

registry = VeSkillRegistry(skill_source_id=skill_space_id)
agent = Agent(
    tools=[SkillToolset(registry=registry)],
)
```

This path does not download every skill at initialization time. The cache only stores concrete downloaded skill versions; remote metadata is fetched again on every search / get, so remote version changes are picked up before loading.

## Skill Directory Structure

An ADK local skill consists of its own directory containing a `SKILL.md` file. The frontmatter must include `name` and `description`, and the directory name must match `name`:

<Files>
  <Folder name="skills" defaultOpen>
    <Folder name="kb-skill" defaultOpen>
      <File name="SKILL.md" />
      <Folder name="references" />
      <Folder name="assets" />
      <Folder name="scripts" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

```markdown title="skills/kb-skill/SKILL.md"
---
name: kb-skill
description: Query the knowledge base and compose an answer.
---

...body (operating steps, constraints, script descriptions, etc.)
```

## Deprecated: VeADK Legacy Local Entry

`Agent(skills=..., skills_mode="local")` keeps its legacy behavior, but this local entry point is deprecated. Whether `skills` contains local directories or remote skill sources, once the final mode is `local`, VeADK uses the legacy local loading path: it loads skill metadata, writes the skill list into `instruction`, and mounts the legacy `SkillsToolset`.

The `skills` parameter still supports three skill execution modes. Only the legacy `local` loading and execution path is deprecated:

| Mode | Description |
| :- | :- |
| `local` | Deprecated. Skills are loaded by VeADK's legacy `skills_tool` plus file/Shell helper tools; migrate to ADK `SkillToolset` for local execution. |
| `skills_sandbox` | Skills are hosted in a cloud Skill Space and executed in a sandbox through the `execute_skills` tool. |
| `aio_sandbox` | All-in-one sandbox mode, suitable for the AgentKit-hosted tool runtime. |

When `skills_mode` is not set explicitly, VeADK infers it from the runtime environment: local runs default to `local`; in the AgentKit tool runtime, it automatically selects `skills_sandbox` or `aio_sandbox` based on the tool type.

### Local Mode

In `local` mode, pass the skills root directory path to `skills` and set `skills_mode` to `local`:

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills=["/abs/path/to/skills"],
    skills_mode="local",
)
```

During initialization, the Agent loads each skill's metadata (`name` and `description`) and injects it into the system prompt, guiding the model to invoke the corresponding skill at the right time. In local mode, VeADK also automatically mounts a set of supporting tools (read/write files, edit files, run shell commands, register skills, etc.) for the Agent to use when executing a skill.

### Sandbox Mode

In `skills_sandbox` mode, skills are hosted in a cloud Skill Space. Pass the cloud skill space identifier to `skills` and add the `execute_skills` tool; the Agent invokes that tool to execute the chosen skill in the sandbox when needed:

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.tools.builtin_tools.execute_skills import execute_skills

agent = Agent(
    skills=[skill_space_id],
    skills_mode="skills_sandbox",
    tools=[execute_skills],
)
```

### Skill Checklist

A skill can carry a checklist in its definition to constrain the Agent to complete the task step by step. When enabled, the Agent must complete each checklist item while executing the skill, and mark each item as done through the `update_check_list` tool:

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills=["/abs/path/to/skills"],
    skills_mode="local",
    enable_skills_checklist=True,
)
```

When a skill defines a checklist, VeADK automatically initializes the state of all checklist items when the skill is invoked, and prompts the model in the system prompt to complete them one by one.

### Dynamically Loading Skills

With `enable_dynamic_load_skills=True`, new skills can be discovered and loaded at runtime, without declaring all skills up front at Agent initialization:

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills_mode="local",
    enable_dynamic_load_skills=True,
)
```

## Parameter Overview

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `skills` | `list[str]` | Skill list; each item is a local skills root path or a cloud skill-space identifier. The legacy local loading path is deprecated when `skills_mode="local"`. |
| `skills_mode` | `"local" \| "skills_sandbox" \| "aio_sandbox"` | Skill execution mode; inferred automatically when omitted. The legacy `local` path is deprecated, while `skills_sandbox` / `aio_sandbox` keep their existing behavior. |
| `enable_skills_checklist` | `bool` | Whether to enable the legacy skill checklist; defaults to `False`. |
| `enable_dynamic_load_skills` | `bool` | Whether to enable dynamic loading for legacy skills; defaults to `False`. |

---

# skills.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agent/skills.mdx

title: "技能"

技能（Skills）是一种可复用的「提示词包」，用于为 Agent 注入特定的领域知识、操作流程与脚本。本地技能加载/执行场景推荐使用 Google ADK 官方的 `load_skill_from_dir` / `SkillToolset` 方式接入；VeADK 旧的 `Agent(skills=..., skills_mode="local")` 本地入口仍保持兼容，但已标记为 deprecated。`skills_sandbox` 与 `aio_sandbox` 模式仍按原方式使用。

## 推荐：ADK SkillToolset

本地技能可直接通过 Google ADK 加载，并作为标准工具集传给 VeADK Agent：

```python
from google.adk.skills import load_skill_from_dir
from google.adk.tools.skill_toolset import SkillToolset
from veadk import Agent

skill = load_skill_from_dir("/abs/path/to/skills/kb-skill")
agent = Agent(
    tools=[SkillToolset(skills=[skill])],
)
```

这一路径下，技能加载、prompt 注入和工具暴露都由 ADK 处理。模型可见的工具包括 `list_skills`、`load_skill`、`load_skill_resource` 和 `run_skill_script`。如果技能依赖 `scripts/` 执行，请在 `SkillToolset` 或 Agent 上显式配置合适的 `code_executor`；VeADK 不会默认创建本地代码执行器。

云端 SkillHub / SkillSpace 技能推荐通过 VeADK 的 ADK Registry 接入。`search_skills` 会实时拉取远端技能列表，`get_skill` 会在需要某个技能时按需下载并加载：

```python
from google.adk.tools.skill_toolset import SkillToolset
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.skills import VeSkillRegistry

registry = VeSkillRegistry(skill_source_id=skill_space_id)
agent = Agent(
    tools=[SkillToolset(registry=registry)],
)
```

该方式不会在初始化阶段全量下载技能；缓存仅用于已下载的具体技能版本。远端 metadata 每次 search / get 都会重新拉取，因此远端版本变化后会按新版本重新下载。

## 技能目录结构

一个 ADK 本地技能由独立目录构成，目录中包含一个 `SKILL.md` 文件。`SKILL.md` 必须包含 `name` 与 `description` frontmatter，且目录名必须与 `name` 一致：

<Files>
  <Folder name="skills" defaultOpen>
    <Folder name="kb-skill" defaultOpen>
      <File name="SKILL.md" />
      <Folder name="references" />
      <Folder name="assets" />
      <Folder name="scripts" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

```markdown title="skills/kb-skill/SKILL.md"
---
name: kb-skill
description: 查询知识库并整理答案的技能。
---

...正文部分（操作步骤、约束、脚本说明等）
```

## Deprecated：VeADK 旧本地入口

`Agent(skills=..., skills_mode="local")` 会继续保持旧行为，但该本地入口已 deprecated。无论 `skills` 传入本地目录还是远端技能源，只要最终以 `local` 模式执行，VeADK 都会走旧的本地加载路径：加载技能元信息、把技能列表写入 `instruction`，并挂载旧的 `SkillsToolset`。

VeADK `skills` 参数仍支持三种技能运行模式，其中仅 `local` 的旧本地加载/执行路径标记为 deprecated：

| 模式 | 说明 |
| :- | :- |
| `local` | Deprecated。技能由 VeADK 旧 `skills_tool` 和配套文件/Shell 工具加载，建议迁移到 ADK `SkillToolset`。 |
| `skills_sandbox` | 技能托管在云端技能空间（Skill Space），通过 `execute_skills` 工具在沙箱中执行。 |
| `aio_sandbox` | All-in-one 沙箱模式，适用于 AgentKit 托管的工具运行时。 |

未显式设置 `skills_mode` 时，VeADK 会根据运行环境自动推断：本地运行默认为 `local`；在 AgentKit 工具运行时中，会根据工具类型自动选择 `skills_sandbox` 或 `aio_sandbox`。

### 本地模式

在 `local` 模式下，向 `skills` 传入技能根目录的路径，并将 `skills_mode` 设置为 `local`：

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills=["/abs/path/to/skills"],
    skills_mode="local",
)
```

Agent 在初始化时会加载技能元信息（`name` 与 `description`）并将其注入系统提示词，引导模型在合适的时机调用对应技能。本地模式下，VeADK 还会自动挂载一组配套工具（读写文件、编辑文件、执行 Shell 命令、注册技能等），供 Agent 在执行技能时使用。

### 沙箱模式

在 `skills_sandbox` 模式下，技能托管在云端技能空间。向 `skills` 传入云端技能空间标识，并引入 `execute_skills` 工具，Agent 会在需要时调用该工具在沙箱中执行所选技能：

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.tools.builtin_tools.execute_skills import execute_skills

agent = Agent(
    skills=[skill_space_id],
    skills_mode="skills_sandbox",
    tools=[execute_skills],
)
```

### 技能检查清单（Checklist）

技能可在其定义中携带一份检查清单（checklist），用于约束 Agent 按步骤完成任务。开启后，Agent 在执行技能时需逐项完成检查项，并通过 `update_check_list` 工具将每一项标记为已完成：

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills=["/abs/path/to/skills"],
    skills_mode="local",
    enable_skills_checklist=True,
)
```

当某个技能定义了 checklist 时，VeADK 会在该技能被调用时自动初始化所有检查项的状态，并在系统提示词中提示模型逐项完成。

### 动态加载技能

通过 `enable_dynamic_load_skills=True`，可在运行时动态发现并加载新的技能，而无需在 Agent 初始化时一次性声明全部技能：

```python
from veadk import Agent

agent = Agent(
    skills_mode="local",
    enable_dynamic_load_skills=True,
)
```

## 参数总览

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `skills` | `list[str]` | 技能列表，元素为本地技能根目录路径或云端技能空间标识；当 `skills_mode="local"` 时，该旧本地加载路径已 deprecated。 |
| `skills_mode` | `"local" \| "skills_sandbox" \| "aio_sandbox"` | 技能运行模式，缺省时自动推断；其中 `local` 旧路径已 deprecated，`skills_sandbox` / `aio_sandbox` 仍保持原用法。 |
| `enable_skills_checklist` | `bool` | 是否启用旧技能检查清单，默认 `False`。 |
| `enable_dynamic_load_skills` | `bool` | 是否启用旧技能的动态加载，默认 `False`。 |

---

# agentkit.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agentkit.en.mdx

title: "Deploy to AgentKit"

Besides deploying to VeFaaS, you can deploy your agent to the Volcengine **AgentKit** platform. The VeADK CLI is compatible with AgentKit commands—just prefix the familiar AgentKit commands with `veadk` (using the `agentkit` command directly works as well).

## Prerequisites

- VeADK is installed (it bundles the `agentkit` dependency).
- Volcengine access credentials (Access Key / Secret Key) are configured in the `.env` file at your project root.

## Steps

<Steps>

<Step>
### Create the project

Generate a standard AgentKit project:

```bash
veadk agentkit init
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Configure the project

Configure the project as needed:

```bash
veadk agentkit config
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Deploy the project

From the project root, deploy it to the Volcengine AgentKit platform:

```bash
veadk agentkit launch
```
</Step>

</Steps>

`veadk agentkit` passes through all of AgentKit's subcommands (such as `build`, `deploy`, `status`, and `destroy`). For the full command list and descriptions, see [AgentKit-Compatible Commands](/en/docs/cli/agentkit-cli); for more detailed platform deployment steps, see the [AgentKit documentation](https://volcengine.github.io/agentkit-sdk-python/content/2.agentkit-cli/1.overview.html).

---

# agentkit.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/agentkit.mdx

title: "部署到 AgentKit"

除了部署到 VeFaaS，你还可以把智能体部署到火山引擎 **AgentKit** 平台。VeADK 命令行兼容 AgentKit 命令——在熟悉的 AgentKit 命令前加上 `veadk` 前缀即可（直接使用 `agentkit` 命令同样有效）。

## 前置条件

- 已安装 VeADK（包含 `agentkit` 依赖）。
- 已在项目根目录的 `.env` 文件中配置火山引擎访问凭据（Access Key / Secret Key）。

## 步骤

<Steps>

<Step>
### 创建项目

生成一个标准的 AgentKit 项目：

```bash
veadk agentkit init
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 配置项目

按需对项目进行配置：

```bash
veadk agentkit config
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 部署项目

在项目根目录下，将项目部署到火山引擎 AgentKit 平台：

```bash
veadk agentkit launch
```
</Step>

</Steps>

`veadk agentkit` 透传了 AgentKit 的全部子命令（如 `build`、`deploy`、`status`、`destroy` 等）。完整命令列表与说明见 [AgentKit 命令兼容](/cn/docs/cli/agentkit-cli)，更详细的平台部署步骤见 [AgentKit 官方文档](https://volcengine.github.io/agentkit-sdk-python/content/2.agentkit-cli/1.overview.html)。

# api-key.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/api-key.en.mdx

title: "Outbound Auth with API Key"

API Key is the simplest outbound auth method, ideal for fixed credentials and service-to-service calls. Credentials are encrypted and hosted by Agent Identity, never appearing in your code. This page covers only what is specific to API Key; the shared `VeIdentityFunctionTool` / `VeIdentityMcpToolset` usage, the `into` default, and the common FAQ live in the [security overview](/en/docs/framework/security#outbound-authentication).

## Create an API Key credential

1. Sign in to the Volcengine console and open the **Agent Identity** service.
2. Go to **Identity Auth > Outbound Credential Hosting**.
3. Click **New > New API Key** and enter a name.
4. Enter the API Key issued by the third-party service.
5. Choose how it is passed (Header or Query) and click **OK**.

## Use it in code

Create an auth config with `api_key_auth(provider_name=...)` and pass it to `VeIdentityFunctionTool` or `VeIdentityMcpToolset`. The API Key credential injects into the function's `api_key` parameter by default (the `into` default), so you never pass it yourself:

```python
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import VeIdentityFunctionTool, api_key_auth
import aiohttp

async def query_api(api_key: str, user_id: str):
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
    url = f"https://api.example.com/users/{user_id}"
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(url, headers=headers) as resp:
            return await resp.json()

tool = VeIdentityFunctionTool(
    func=query_api,
    auth_config=api_key_auth(provider_name="user-api"),
)

agent = Agent(tools=[tool])
runner = Runner(agent=agent)
asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="Look up user 123"))
```

To wrap an entire MCP service, use `VeIdentityMcpToolset` with the same `api_key_auth` config:

```python
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import VeIdentityMcpToolset, api_key_auth
from mcp import StdioServerParameters

toolset = VeIdentityMcpToolset(
    auth_config=api_key_auth(provider_name="my-api-provider"),
    connection_params=StdioServerParameters(
        command="python",
        args=["-m", "my_api_mcp_server"],
    ),
)
```

## When to choose API Key

API Key is the simplest option with a fixed credential, ideal when no token refresh is needed. For short-lived, auto-refreshed tokens, use [OAuth2 M2M](/en/docs/framework/oauth2-m2m); to act on behalf of a specific user, use [OAuth2 user federation](/en/docs/framework/oauth2-user-federation).

---

# api-key.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/api-key.mdx

title: "使用 API Key 进行出站认证"

API Key 是最简单的出站认证方式，适用于固定凭证、服务间通信的场景。凭据由 Agent Identity 加密托管，不出现在代码中。本页只讲 API Key 特有的部分；`VeIdentityFunctionTool` / `VeIdentityMcpToolset` 的通用用法、`into` 默认值与常见问题见[安全概述](/cn/docs/framework/security#出站认证)。

## 创建 API Key 凭据

1. 登录火山引擎控制台，进入 **Agent Identity** 服务。
2. 选择 **身份认证 > 出站凭据托管**。
3. 点击 **新建 > 新建 API Key**，填写名称。
4. 输入第三方服务提供的 API Key。
5. 选择传递方式（Header 或 Query）并点击 **确定**。

## 在代码中使用

用 `api_key_auth(provider_name=...)` 创建认证配置，传给 `VeIdentityFunctionTool` 或 `VeIdentityMcpToolset`。API Key 凭据默认注入到函数的 `api_key` 参数（`into` 的默认值），调用时无需自己传入：

```python
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import VeIdentityFunctionTool, api_key_auth
import aiohttp

async def query_api(api_key: str, user_id: str):
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
    url = f"https://api.example.com/users/{user_id}"
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(url, headers=headers) as resp:
            return await resp.json()

tool = VeIdentityFunctionTool(
    func=query_api,
    auth_config=api_key_auth(provider_name="user-api"),
)

agent = Agent(tools=[tool])
runner = Runner(agent=agent)
asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="查询用户 123"))
```

封装整个 MCP 服务时换用 `VeIdentityMcpToolset`，传入同一个 `api_key_auth` 配置：

```python
from veadk.integrations.ve_identity import VeIdentityMcpToolset, api_key_auth
from mcp import StdioServerParameters

toolset = VeIdentityMcpToolset(
    auth_config=api_key_auth(provider_name="my-api-provider"),
    connection_params=StdioServerParameters(
        command="python",
        args=["-m", "my_api_mcp_server"],
    ),
)
```

## 何时选 API Key

API Key 凭证固定、用法最简单，适合无需令牌刷新的场景。需要短期令牌与自动刷新时改用 [OAuth2 M2M](/cn/docs/framework/oauth2-m2m)；需代表某个用户访问时改用 [OAuth2 用户委托](/cn/docs/framework/oauth2-user-federation)。

---

# ide-support.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/community/ide-support.en.mdx

title: "IDE Rules / llms.txt"

VeADK uses the [`llms.txt`](https://llmstxt.org/) mechanism to provide LLMs and AI IDEs with prompts about VeADK. Feed this content to your LLM or IDE so it can generate VeADK-based code more accurately.

## Prompt Files

VeADK provides two prompt files; use whichever fits your need:

| File | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| [`llms.txt`](/llms.txt) | A concise index listing VeADK's key concepts and documentation links. |
| [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt) | The full version, containing all prompt content ready to use as IDE rules. |

## Using It in Trae

Using [Trae](https://www.trae.ai/) as an example, configure the prompts as rules:

<Steps>

<Step>
### Download the prompt file

Download [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt).
</Step>

<Step>
### Open the rules settings

Open Trae's settings page and find the **Rules** option.
</Step>

<Step>
### Add the rules

Copy the file content into your Trae rules file.
</Step>

</Steps>

![Configure rules in Trae](/assets/images/trae_rules.png)

<Callout type="info">
  Any other IDE or editor that supports custom rules / system prompts can likewise paste the content of `llms-full.txt` to use as rules.

# ide-support.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/community/ide-support.mdx

title: "IDE 规则 / llms.txt"

VeADK 通过 [`llms.txt`](https://llmstxt.org/) 机制为大模型和智能 IDE 提供关于 VeADK 的提示词。把这些内容提供给你的大模型或 IDE，即可让它更准确地生成基于 VeADK 的代码。

## 提示词文件

VeADK 提供两份提示词文件，按需取用：

| 文件 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- |
| [`llms.txt`](/llms.txt) | 精简版索引，列出 VeADK 的关键概念与文档链接。 |
| [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt) | 完整版，包含可直接作为 IDE 规则使用的全部提示词内容。 |

## 在 Trae 中使用

以 [Trae](https://www.trae.ai/) 为例，将提示词配置为规则：

<Steps>

<Step>
### 下载提示词文件

下载 [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt)。
</Step>

<Step>
### 打开规则设置

打开 Trae 的设置界面，找到 **规则** 选项。
</Step>

<Step>
### 写入规则

将文件内容复制到你的 Trae 规则文件中。
</Step>

</Steps>

![在 Trae 中配置规则](/assets/images/trae_rules.png)

<Callout type="info">
  其它支持自定义规则 / 系统提示词的 IDE 与编辑器，同样可以将 `llms-full.txt` 的内容粘贴为规则使用。
