# Ingest from in-memory text; you can also use add_from_files / add_from_directory

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview.en.mdx

title: "Overview"

The KnowledgeBase is an agent's external source of knowledge — a "library" of static material it can consult at any time. Attach it to an agent and VeADK automatically gives the agent a retrieval tool, so it can look up relevant passages from your content before answering, producing more precise, grounded responses (RAG).

## Key features

1. **Ingestion**: add external, unstructured text (product docs, FAQs, articles) into the knowledge base; the framework converts it into a retrievable format automatically.
   - From files: `kb.add_from_files([...])`
   - From a directory: `kb.add_from_directory("./docs")`
   - From in-memory text: `kb.add_from_text([...])`
2. **Backend abstraction**: a unified interface hides the underlying vector store. Specify `local`, `viking`, `opensearch`, or `redis` via `backend` at init — your business code stays the same.
3. **Retrieval**: once a knowledge base is passed to an agent, the agent gains a built-in `load_knowledgebase` tool and decides on its own whether to use it when answering.
4. **Seamless agent integration**: pass `knowledgebase=kb` when creating an `Agent`.

## Usage

Here is the minimal flow for using a knowledge base.

<Steps>

<Step>
### Initialize the knowledge base and ingest knowledge

The `local` backend requires no external service, making it the easiest to start with. It embeds documents, so install the extensions dependency `pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"` and configure an embedding model (it reuses `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` when omitted).

```python
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="local", index="company_faq")

# Ingest from in-memory text; you can also use add_from_files / add_from_directory
kb.add_from_text(
    [
        "Standard annual leave is 15 days per year, available after one year of employment.",
        "Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.",
    ]
)
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Integrate with an agent and run

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent(
    name="kb_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction="You are a knowledgeable assistant. Prefer the knowledge base when answering.",
    knowledgebase=kb,  # automatically gains the load_knowledgebase tool
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name="company_faq")

print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="How many days of annual leave are there? Can I work remotely?")))
```
</Step>

</Steps>

Switching to a persistent production backend (`viking`, `opensearch`, `redis`) barely changes your code — just change `backend` and provide the connection details in `config.yaml`. The sections below cover provisioning and configuring those two backends.

## Getting started

### Provisioning resources

#### Provisioning VikingDB

1. Log in to the console and open the VikingDB page.

![VikingDB page](/assets/images/knowledge/image.png)

- After entering the console, select the option in the middle red box to open the knowledge base.

![Knowledge base entry](/assets/images/knowledge/image-1.png)

- On the knowledge base list page, follow the red box to open the creation page.

![Knowledge base list page](/assets/images/knowledge/image-3.png)

- Click Create; in the options that pop up, choose the Flagship edition.

![Creation options](/assets/images/knowledge/image-4.png)

- On the creation details page, enter the key information as prompted (core parts in the red boxes).

![Creation details page](/assets/images/knowledge/image-5.png)

![Creation details page](/assets/images/knowledge/image-6.png)

![Creation details page](/assets/images/knowledge/image-7.png)

![Creation details page](/assets/images/knowledge/image-8.png)

2. Click Create Knowledge Base; when asked whether to import documents, choose not to import for now.

![Create knowledge base](/assets/images/knowledge/image-9.png)

![Create knowledge base](/assets/images/knowledge/image-10.png)

#### TOS configuration

1. Log in to the Volcengine console, open the TOS console, and create a TOS bucket.

![TOS console](/assets/images/knowledge/image-11.png)

See the [Volcengine TOS docs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6349?lang=zh).

#### Provisioning OpenSearch

1. Log in to the Volcengine console, open the Cloud Search console, and create an OpenSearch instance.

![Cloud Search console](/assets/images/knowledge/image-13.png)

![Create OpenSearch instance](/assets/images/knowledge/image-14.png)

See the [Volcengine Cloud Search Service docs: Create an instance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6465/1117829?lang=zh).

### Code configuration

#### config.yaml

Fill the provisioned VikingDB, TOS, and OpenSearch details into `config.yaml`. Do **not** put secrets in the file — reference them via environment variables:

```yaml
model:
  agent:
    provider: openai
    name: doubao-seed-1-8-251228
    api_base: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/
    api_key: ${MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY}

volcengine:
  # Viking DB and embedding require Volcengine ak/sk
  access_key: ${VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: ${VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY}

database:
  viking:
    project: default    # project in Volcengine Viking DB
    region: cn-beijing
  tos:
    endpoint: tos-cn-beijing.volces.com
    region: cn-beijing
    bucket: your_bucket_name
  opensearch:
    host: your_opensearch_host
    port: 9200
    username: admin
    password: ${DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD}
```

Provide those secrets in environment variables:

```bash
export MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY="<your Ark API key>"
export VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY="<your AK>"
export VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY="<your SK>"
export DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD="<your OpenSearch password>"
```

### Demo scenario

The example below uses short bios of two psychologists as knowledge, plus a date-difference tool, to demonstrate "retrieve from the knowledge base + call a tool."

Knowledge content:

```python
mock_data = [
    """西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（Sigmund Freud，1856年5月6日-1939年9月23日）是精神分析的创始人。
精神分析既是一种治疗精神疾病的方法，也是一种解释人类行为的理论。""",
    """阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒（Alfred Adler，1870年2月7日-1937年5月28日），奥地利精神病学家，
人本主义心理学先驱，个体心理学的创始人。""",
]
```

Agent persona:

```python
instruction = """You are an excellent assistant. When asked, follow these steps:
1. Give a preliminary answer from your own knowledge;
2. Query the knowledge base to verify or enrich the answer;
3. Combine your own knowledge and the knowledge base to give a complete, accurate answer."""
```

Test questions:

1. How many years apart are Freud and Adler?
2. How many days apart are Freud and Adler? How significant was their influence on later generations?

### Using VikingDB as storage

VikingDB requires explicitly creating a collection once before use. Here we ingest knowledge from in-memory text:

```python
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

APP_NAME = "viking_demo"

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="viking", index=APP_NAME)

if not kb.collection_status()["existed"]:
    kb.create_collection()  # Viking requires an explicit create

kb.add_from_text(mock_data)
```

Complete runnable example (VikingDB backend with a date-difference tool):

```python
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

APP_NAME = "viking_demo"

mock_data = [
    "Sigmund Freud (6 May 1856 - 23 Sep 1939) founded psychoanalysis.",
    "Alfred Adler (7 Feb 1870 - 28 May 1937) founded individual psychology.",
]

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="viking", index=APP_NAME)
if not kb.collection_status()["existed"]:
    kb.create_collection()
kb.add_from_text(mock_data)

def calculate_date_difference(date1: str, date2: str) -> int:
    """Calculate the absolute number of days between two dates.

    Args:
        date1: the first date, in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
        date2: the second date, in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

    Returns:
        The number of days between the two dates.
    """
    d1 = datetime.strptime(date1, "%Y-%m-%d")
    d2 = datetime.strptime(date2, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return abs((d2 - d1).days)

agent = Agent(
    name="chat_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction=(
        "You are an excellent assistant. Query the knowledge base to verify or "
        "enrich your answer, then combine it with your own knowledge for a "
        "complete, accurate response."
    ),
    knowledgebase=kb,
    tools=[calculate_date_difference],
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="How many days apart are Freud and Adler?")))
```

#### Run results

The images below show the agent first retrieving from the knowledge base via `load_knowledgebase`, then calling `calculate_date_difference` via a Function Call, and finally giving a combined answer.

![Input question](/assets/images/knowledge/image-17.png)

![Execution process](/assets/images/knowledge/image-18.png)

![Execution process](/assets/images/knowledge/image-19.png)

![Execution result](/assets/images/knowledge/image-20.png)

### Using OpenSearch as storage

OpenSearch usually creates the index automatically, with no explicit create. Here we ingest knowledge from a file and also attach the real `web_search` tool to supplement from the web when the knowledge base is insufficient:

```python
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase
from veadk.tools.builtin_tools.web_search import web_search

APP_NAME = "opensearch_demo"

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="opensearch", index=APP_NAME)
kb.add_from_files(["tmp/demo.txt"])  # write your knowledge into tmp/demo.txt first

def calculate_date_difference(date1: str, date2: str) -> int:
    """Calculate the absolute number of days between two dates.

    Args:
        date1: the first date, in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
        date2: the second date, in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

    Returns:
        The number of days between the two dates.
    """
    d1 = datetime.strptime(date1, "%Y-%m-%d")
    d2 = datetime.strptime(date2, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return abs((d2 - d1).days)

agent = Agent(
    name="chat_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction=(
        "You are an excellent assistant. Query the knowledge base first; "
        "if it is insufficient or the question involves real-time information, "
        "use `web_search`; then combine everything into a complete, accurate answer."
    ),
    knowledgebase=kb,
    tools=[calculate_date_difference, web_search],
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="How many days apart are Freud and Adler?")))
```

![Execution process](/assets/images/knowledge/image-21.png)

![Execution result](/assets/images/knowledge/image-22.png)

## Summary and comparison

The KnowledgeBase design lets you switch the underlying vector store without changing most of your business logic. The main differences are the upfront configuration and the fact that Viking requires explicitly creating a collection.

| Feature | Viking backend | OpenSearch backend |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core advantage** | Managed service, no ops overhead, tightly integrated with the Volcengine ecosystem. | Open-source and flexible, supports private deployment, with a mature community. |
| **config.yaml** | Requires `viking.project`, `viking.region`, and `tos`. | Requires `opensearch.host`, `port`, `username`, `password`. |
| **Initialization** | Check and call `kb.create_collection()` before use. | Usually creates the index automatically, with no extra steps. |
| **Code usage** | **Identical**: `add_from_files`, `add_from_text`, etc. are used the same way. | **Identical**: the abstraction layer hides the differences. |
| **Dependencies** | Relies on Volcengine `ak/sk` for authentication and embedding. | Also requires `ak/sk` to call the embedding model, but the database itself is independent. |

---

# 从内存文本注入；也可用 add_from_files / add_from_directory

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview.mdx

title: "概述"

知识库（KnowledgeBase）是智能体的外部知识来源——一个可随时查阅、专门存放静态资料的"图书馆"。把它挂到智能体上，VeADK 会自动赋予智能体一个检索工具，让它在回答前先到你的资料里检索相关片段，从而给出更精准、更有依据的回答（RAG）。

## 主要功能

1. **知识注入（Ingestion）**：把外部、非结构化的文本资料（产品文档、FAQ、文章等）添加进知识库，框架自动转换为可检索的格式。
   - 从文件导入：`kb.add_from_files([...])`
   - 从目录导入：`kb.add_from_directory("./docs")`
   - 从内存文本导入：`kb.add_from_text([...])`
2. **后端抽象（Backend Abstraction）**：统一接口屏蔽底层向量库差异，初始化时用 `backend` 指定 `local`、`viking`、`opensearch` 或 `redis` 即可，业务代码无需改动。
3. **知识检索（Retrieval）**：把知识库传给智能体后，智能体会自动获得一个内置的 `load_knowledgebase` 工具。回答问题时，它会自主决定是否检索知识库。
4. **与 Agent 无缝集成**：创建 `Agent` 时传入 `knowledgebase=kb` 即可。

## 使用方法

下面是使用知识库的最小流程。

<Steps>

<Step>
### 初始化知识库并注入知识

`local` 后端无需任何外部服务，最适合上手。它会对文档做向量化，需要安装扩展依赖 `pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"`，并配置 embedding 模型（缺省时复用 `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`）。

```python
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="local", index="company_faq")

# 从内存文本注入；也可用 add_from_files / add_from_directory
kb.add_from_text(
    [
        "公司的标准年假为每年 15 天，入职满一年起享受。",
        "经主管批准后，员工每周最多可远程办公 2 天。",
    ]
)
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 集成到 Agent 并运行

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent(
    name="kb_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction="你是一个知识渊博的助手，请优先利用知识库回答问题。",
    knowledgebase=kb,  # 自动获得 load_knowledgebase 检索工具
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name="company_faq")

print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="年假有多少天？可以远程办公吗？")))
```
</Step>

</Steps>

切换到生产用的持久化后端（如 `viking`、`opensearch`、`redis`）时，业务代码几乎不变——只改 `backend`，并在 `config.yaml` 里提供对应连接信息。下文介绍这两种后端的开通与配置。

### 代码配置

#### config.yaml

把上面开通的 VikingDB、TOS、OpenSearch 信息填入 `config.yaml`。密钥**不要**写进配置文件——用环境变量引用：

```yaml
model:
  agent:
    provider: openai
    name: doubao-seed-1-8-251228
    api_base: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/
    api_key: ${MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY}

volcengine:
  # Viking DB 与 embedding 需要火山引擎 ak/sk
  access_key: ${VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: ${VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY}

database:
  viking:
    project: default    # Volcengine Viking DB 中的项目
    region: cn-beijing
  tos:
    endpoint: tos-cn-beijing.volces.com
    region: cn-beijing
    bucket: your_bucket_name
  opensearch:
    host: your_opensearch_host
    port: 9200
    username: admin
    password: ${DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD}
```

对应地，在环境变量中提供这些密钥：

```bash
export MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY="<你的方舟 API Key>"
export VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY="<你的 AK>"
export VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY="<你的 SK>"
export DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD="<你的 OpenSearch 密码>"
```

### 演示场景

下面用一段心理学家简介作为知识，并配一个计算日期差的工具，演示「检索知识库 + 调用工具」。

知识内容：

```python
mock_data = [
    """西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（Sigmund Freud，1856年5月6日-1939年9月23日）是精神分析的创始人。
精神分析既是一种治疗精神疾病的方法，也是一种解释人类行为的理论。""",
    """阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒（Alfred Adler，1870年2月7日-1937年5月28日），奥地利精神病学家，
人本主义心理学先驱，个体心理学的创始人。""",
]
```

智能体角色设定：

```python
instruction = """你是一个优秀的助手。当被提问时，请遵循以下步骤：
1. 先根据内部知识给出初步回答；
2. 查询知识库，寻找相关信息来验证或丰富答案；
3. 结合内部知识与知识库信息，给出全面、准确的最终答案。"""
```

测试问题：

1. 弗洛伊德和阿德勒相差多少岁？
2. 弗洛伊德和阿德勒相差多少天？他们对后世的影响有多大？

### VikingDB 作为存储

VikingDB 需要在使用前显式创建一次集合。下面从内存文本注入知识：

```python
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

APP_NAME = "viking_demo"

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="viking", index=APP_NAME)

if not kb.collection_status()["existed"]:
    kb.create_collection()  # Viking 需要显式创建集合

kb.add_from_text(mock_data)
```

完整可运行示例（VikingDB 后端，配合一个日期差工具）：

```python
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase

APP_NAME = "viking_demo"

mock_data = [
    "西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（1856年5月6日-1939年9月23日）是精神分析的创始人。",
    "阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒（1870年2月7日-1937年5月28日）是个体心理学的创始人。",
]

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="viking", index=APP_NAME)
if not kb.collection_status()["existed"]:
    kb.create_collection()
kb.add_from_text(mock_data)

def calculate_date_difference(date1: str, date2: str) -> int:
    """计算两个日期之间的天数差（绝对值）。

    Args:
        date1: 第一个日期，格式 "YYYY-MM-DD"。
        date2: 第二个日期，格式 "YYYY-MM-DD"。

    Returns:
        两个日期之间的天数差。
    """
    d1 = datetime.strptime(date1, "%Y-%m-%d")
    d2 = datetime.strptime(date2, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return abs((d2 - d1).days)

agent = Agent(
    name="chat_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction=(
        "你是一个优秀的助手。回答时先查询知识库验证或丰富答案，"
        "再结合内部知识给出全面准确的回答。"
    ),
    knowledgebase=kb,
    tools=[calculate_date_difference],
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="弗洛伊德和阿德勒相差多少天？")))
```

#### 运行结果

下图展示智能体先通过 `load_knowledgebase` 检索知识库，再通过 Function Call 调用 `calculate_date_difference`，最后给出综合回答。

![输入问题](/assets/images/knowledge/image-17.png)

![执行过程](/assets/images/knowledge/image-18.png)

![执行过程](/assets/images/knowledge/image-19.png)

![执行结果](/assets/images/knowledge/image-20.png)

### OpenSearch 作为存储

OpenSearch 通常自动创建索引，无需显式 create。下面从文件注入知识，并额外挂载真实的 `web_search` 工具，在知识库信息不足时联网补充：

```python
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.knowledgebase import KnowledgeBase
from veadk.tools.builtin_tools.web_search import web_search

APP_NAME = "opensearch_demo"

kb = KnowledgeBase(backend="opensearch", index=APP_NAME)
kb.add_from_files(["tmp/demo.txt"])  # 事先把知识写入 tmp/demo.txt

def calculate_date_difference(date1: str, date2: str) -> int:
    """计算两个日期之间的天数差（绝对值）。

    Args:
        date1: 第一个日期，格式 "YYYY-MM-DD"。
        date2: 第二个日期，格式 "YYYY-MM-DD"。

    Returns:
        两个日期之间的天数差。
    """
    d1 = datetime.strptime(date1, "%Y-%m-%d")
    d2 = datetime.strptime(date2, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return abs((d2 - d1).days)

agent = Agent(
    name="chat_agent",
    model_name="doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    instruction=(
        "你是一个优秀的助手。回答时先查询知识库；"
        "若知识库信息不足或涉及实时信息，使用 `web_search` 联网搜索；"
        "最后结合各方信息给出全面准确的回答。"
    ),
    knowledgebase=kb,
    tools=[calculate_date_difference, web_search],
)

runner = Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(asyncio.run(runner.run(messages="弗洛伊德和阿德勒相差多少天？")))
```

![执行过程](/assets/images/knowledge/image-21.png)

![执行结果](/assets/images/knowledge/image-22.png)

## 总结与对比

知识库的设计让你可以轻松切换底层向量库，而无需改动大部分业务代码。主要差异在于前期配置，以及 Viking 需要显式创建集合。

| 特性 | Viking 后端 | OpenSearch 后端 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **核心优势** | 托管服务、免运维，与火山引擎生态结合紧密。 | 开源、灵活，可私有化部署，社区成熟。 |
| **config.yaml** | 需要 `viking.project`、`viking.region` 及 `tos`。 | 需要 `opensearch.host`、`port`、`username`、`password`。 |
| **初始化** | 使用前需检查并调用 `kb.create_collection()`。 | 通常自动创建索引，无需额外步骤。 |
| **代码使用** | **完全一致**：`add_from_files`、`add_from_text` 等用法相同。 | **完全一致**：抽象层屏蔽了差异。 |
| **依赖** | 依赖火山引擎 `ak/sk` 进行认证与 embedding。 | 同样需要 `ak/sk` 调用 embedding 模型，但数据库本身独立。 |

---

# index.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/index.en.mdx

title: "Long-term memory"

Long-term memory persists important information across sessions and over time — user preferences, task history, key facts, or long-lived state. [Short-term memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term) only lives within a single session; long-term memory lets an agent remember facts **across different sessions**.

Why you need it:

- Continuous conversation experience across sessions;
- Retain learnings and user-specific information over many interactions;
- Avoid repetitive questions, improving satisfaction and efficiency;
- Support long-term strategy optimization such as personalization or task tracking.

## Single entry point: `LongTermMemory`

Whatever backend you use, you interact with `veadk.memory.long_term_memory.LongTermMemory`. It implements Google ADK's `BaseMemoryService` (so it plugs straight in as the agent's memory service) and selects/initializes the underlying implementation by `backend`.

```python
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo")
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `backend` | `"local" \| "opensearch" \| "redis" \| "viking" \| "mem0"` or a backend instance | `"opensearch"` | Selects the backend, or pass a `BaseLongTermMemoryBackend` instance directly. `viking_mem` is deprecated and maps to `viking`. |
| `backend_config` | `dict` | `{}` | Config passed to the backend constructor; if it lacks `index`, it's filled from `index` or `app_name`. |
| `top_k` | `int` | `5` | Number of most-similar chunks to retrieve. |
| `index` | `str` | `""` | Index/collection name for storing memories. Falls back to `app_name`, then `default_app`. |
| `app_name` | `str` | `""` | The owning application name; used for data isolation and as the `index` fallback. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `""` | **Deprecated**, kept only for backward compatibility. |

<Callout type="info">
Vector backends (`local`, `opensearch`, `redis`) embed memories, which requires `pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"` and an embedding model (env prefix `MODEL_EMBEDDING_`, falling back to `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`). `viking` and `mem0` are managed services and need no local embedding.

## Backend contract: `BaseLongTermMemoryBackend`

Every backend extends `BaseLongTermMemoryBackend` and implements three methods:

```python
class BaseLongTermMemoryBackend(ABC, BaseModel):
    index: str

    @abstractmethod
    def precheck_index_naming(self): ...
    """Validate the index name."""

    @abstractmethod
    def save_memory(self, user_id: str, event_strings: list[str], **kwargs) -> bool: ...
    """Write memories to the backend."""

    @abstractmethod
    def search_memory(self, user_id: str, query: str, top_k: int, **kwargs) -> list[str]: ...
    """Semantically retrieve memories from the backend."""
```

`LongTermMemory` filters and serializes session events before handing them to the backend's `save_memory`, and wraps `search_memory` results into ADK `MemoryEntry` objects. So **the usage above the backend is backend-agnostic**; only the storage medium and retrieval implementation differ. To add a custom backend, subclass this base, implement the three methods, and pass the instance via `LongTermMemory(backend=<instance>)`.

## Choosing a backend

Use `local` for debugging; prefer `viking` or `mem0` in production.

| Backend | Storage | Requires | Use case | Docs |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local` | In-memory vector index | `extensions` + embedding | Local debugging | [In-memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/local) |
| `viking` | VikingDB memory (managed) | Volcengine account | Recommended for production | [VikingDB](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb) |
| `mem0` | Mem0 memory (managed) | Mem0 API key | Recommended for production | [Mem0](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0) |
| `opensearch` | OpenSearch vector store | OpenSearch + embedding | Self-hosted vector search | [OpenSearch](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch) |
| `redis` | Redis vector store | Redis (RediSearch) + embedding | Self-hosted vector search | [Redis](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis) |

## Binding to an Agent

Passing `long_term_memory` to an `Agent` **auto-injects the `load_memory` tool** so the agent can retrieve past sessions at run time.

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

APP_NAME = "ltm_demo"
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name=APP_NAME)

root_agent = Agent(
    name="ltm_agent",
    instruction="Answer the user. If the answer might be in past conversations, use the `load_memory` tool.",
    long_term_memory=ltm,
)
runner = Runner(agent=root_agent, app_name=APP_NAME)
```

## Managing memory

### Write: `add_session_to_memory`

When a session ends or hits a checkpoint, call the async `add_session_to_memory` to persist it. `LongTermMemory` first filters events (keeping user text events to improve retrieval quality), then hands them to the backend.

```python
completed_session = await runner.session_service.get_session(
    app_name=APP_NAME, user_id=USER_ID, session_id=SESSION_ID
)
await ltm.add_session_to_memory(completed_session)
```

### Retrieve: `search_memory`

Besides the agent's automatic retrieval via `load_memory`, you can call the async `search_memory` directly for semantic search — useful for debugging or custom RAG:

```python
response = await ltm.search_memory(
    app_name=APP_NAME,
    user_id=USER_ID,
    query="favorite project",
)
print(response.memories)
```

<Callout type="info">
`get_user_profile(user_id)` is supported only by the `viking` backend; others return an empty string.

## Auto-save sessions

Set `auto_save_session=True` on the `Agent` with long-term memory configured, and VeADK persists sessions automatically — no manual `add_session_to_memory`.

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

agent = Agent(
    name="ltm_agent",
    auto_save_session=True,
    long_term_memory=LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo"),
)
```

To avoid frequent index re-initialization, VeADK exposes `MIN_MESSAGES_THRESHOLD` and `MIN_TIME_THRESHOLD` env vars to tune the save cadence: by default it saves after 10 accumulated events or a 60-second interval; additionally, when you switch `session_id` and start a new turn, VeADK saves the previous session to long-term memory.

## Cross-session example

An end-to-end flow: session #1 tells the agent a fact and auto-archives it, then a **brand-new** session #2 asks a question — and the agent recalls the fact via memory retrieval (not the context window). This uses the `local` backend, which needs `pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"`.

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

APP_NAME = "ltm_demo"
USER_ID = "user-42"

def build_runner() -> Runner:
    ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="local", app_name=APP_NAME)
    agent = Agent(
        name="ltm_agent",
        instruction=(
            "You are a personal assistant. When the user asks about something they "
            "told you earlier, use the `load_memory` tool to recall it."
        ),
        long_term_memory=ltm,
        auto_save_session=True,
    )
    return Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME, user_id=USER_ID)

async def main() -> None:
    runner = build_runner()

    print(
        "Session 1 ->",
        await runner.run(
            messages="Note this: I'm allergic to peanuts and I'm vegetarian.",
            session_id="session-1",
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Session 2 ->",
        await runner.run(
            messages="Recommend a dish for me, considering my dietary restrictions.",
            session_id="session-2",
        ),
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

In session #2 the agent recognizes the same user's preferences left in session #1 and answers coherently and personally (e.g. a peanut-free vegetarian dish).

---

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/index.mdx

title: "长期记忆"

长期记忆（Long-term Memory）跨会话、跨时间保存重要信息——用户偏好、任务历史、知识要点或长期状态。[短期记忆](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term)只在单次会话内有效，而长期记忆让智能体在**不同会话**之间也能记住事实。

为什么需要它：

- 支持跨会话的连续对话体验；
- 让智能体在多次交互中保留学习成果和用户特定信息；
- 减少重复询问，提升满意度与效率；
- 支撑长期策略优化，如个性化推荐或任务追踪。

## 统一入口：`LongTermMemory`

无论用哪种后端，你都只与 `veadk.memory.long_term_memory.LongTermMemory` 打交道。它实现了 Google ADK 的 `BaseMemoryService`，因此可直接作为智能体的记忆服务；同时根据 `backend` 选择并初始化底层实现。

```python
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo")
```

### 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `backend` | `"local" \| "opensearch" \| "redis" \| "viking" \| "mem0"` 或后端实例 | `"opensearch"` | 选择后端实现，也可直接传入一个 `BaseLongTermMemoryBackend` 实例。`viking_mem` 已废弃，自动转为 `viking`。 |
| `backend_config` | `dict` | `{}` | 传给后端构造函数的配置；若不含 `index`，会用 `index` 或 `app_name` 补齐。 |
| `top_k` | `int` | `5` | 检索时返回最相似的片段数量。 |
| `index` | `str` | `""` | 存储记忆所用的索引/集合名。为空时回退到 `app_name`，再为空则用 `default_app`。 |
| `app_name` | `str` | `""` | 拥有该记忆的应用名，常用作数据隔离与 `index` 的回退值。 |
| `user_id` | `str` | `""` | **已废弃**，仅为向后兼容保留。 |

<Callout type="info">
向量类后端（`local`、`opensearch`、`redis`）会对记忆做向量化（embedding），需要安装扩展依赖：`pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"`，并配置 embedding 模型（环境变量前缀 `MODEL_EMBEDDING_`，缺省时复用 `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`）。`viking` 与 `mem0` 是托管服务，无需本地 embedding。

## 后端契约：`BaseLongTermMemoryBackend`

所有后端都继承自 `BaseLongTermMemoryBackend`，需实现三个方法：

```python
class BaseLongTermMemoryBackend(ABC, BaseModel):
    index: str

    @abstractmethod
    def precheck_index_naming(self): ...
    """校验 index 命名是否合法。"""

    @abstractmethod
    def save_memory(self, user_id: str, event_strings: list[str], **kwargs) -> bool: ...
    """把记忆写入后端。"""

    @abstractmethod
    def search_memory(self, user_id: str, query: str, top_k: int, **kwargs) -> list[str]: ...
    """从后端按语义检索记忆。"""
```

`LongTermMemory` 负责把会话事件过滤、序列化后交给后端的 `save_memory`，并把 `search_memory` 的结果包装为 ADK 的 `MemoryEntry`。因此**上层使用方式与后端无关**，区别仅在存储介质与检索实现。要自定义后端，继承该基类实现这三个方法，并把实例直接传给 `LongTermMemory(backend=<实例>)`。

## 选择后端

调试可以用 `local`，生产更建议使用 `viking` 或 `mem0`。

| 后端 | 存储 | 依赖 | 适用场景 | 文档 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local` | 内存向量索引 | `extensions` + embedding | 本地调试 | [本地内存](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/local) |
| `viking` | VikingDB 记忆库（托管） | 火山引擎账号 | 生产推荐 | [VikingDB](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb) |
| `mem0` | Mem0 记忆库（托管） | Mem0 API Key | 生产推荐 | [Mem0](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0) |
| `opensearch` | OpenSearch 向量库 | OpenSearch + embedding | 自建向量检索 | [OpenSearch](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch) |
| `redis` | Redis 向量库 | Redis(RediSearch) + embedding | 自建向量检索 | [Redis](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis) |

## 绑定到 Agent

把 `long_term_memory` 传给 `Agent` 后，智能体会**自动获得 `load_memory` 工具**，可在运行时检索过往会话。

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

APP_NAME = "ltm_demo"
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name=APP_NAME)

root_agent = Agent(
    name="ltm_agent",
    instruction="回答用户问题。如果答案可能在过往对话里，使用 `load_memory` 工具检索。",
    long_term_memory=ltm,
)
runner = Runner(agent=root_agent, app_name=APP_NAME)
```

## 记忆管理

### 写入：`add_session_to_memory`

会话结束或达到某个节点时，调用异步方法 `add_session_to_memory` 把会话持久化。`LongTermMemory` 会先过滤事件（只保留用户文本事件以提升检索质量），再交给后端写入。

```python
completed_session = await runner.session_service.get_session(
    app_name=APP_NAME, user_id=USER_ID, session_id=SESSION_ID
)
await ltm.add_session_to_memory(completed_session)
```

### 检索：`search_memory`

除了智能体运行时通过 `load_memory` 自动检索，你也可以直接调用异步方法 `search_memory` 做语义搜索，用于调试或自定义 RAG：

```python
response = await ltm.search_memory(
    app_name=APP_NAME,
    user_id=USER_ID,
    query="favorite project",
)
print(response.memories)
```

<Callout type="info">
`get_user_profile(user_id)` 仅 `viking` 后端支持，用于获取用户画像；其他后端会返回空字符串。

## 自动保存会话

在初始化 `Agent` 时开启 `auto_save_session=True` 并配置好长期记忆，VeADK 会自动把会话写入长期记忆，无需手动调用 `add_session_to_memory`。

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

agent = Agent(
    name="ltm_agent",
    auto_save_session=True,
    long_term_memory=LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo"),
)
```

为避免索引被频繁初始化，VeADK 提供 `MIN_MESSAGES_THRESHOLD` 与 `MIN_TIME_THRESHOLD` 两个环境变量自定义保存周期：默认在累计 10 条 event 或间隔 60 秒时触发保存；此外，当切换 `session_id` 并发起新问答时，VeADK 会自动把上一个会话写入长期记忆。

## 跨会话示例

下面是端到端流程：会话 #1 告诉智能体一个事实并自动归档，然后在**全新的**会话 #2 提问——智能体通过检索长期记忆（而非上下文窗口）回忆起该事实。这里用 `local` 后端，需要 `pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"`。

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

APP_NAME = "ltm_demo"
USER_ID = "user-42"

def build_runner() -> Runner:
    ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="local", app_name=APP_NAME)
    agent = Agent(
        name="ltm_agent",
        instruction=(
            "你是个人助理。当用户问起之前告诉过你的事情时，"
            "使用 `load_memory` 工具去回忆。"
        ),
        long_term_memory=ltm,
        auto_save_session=True,
    )
    return Runner(agent=agent, app_name=APP_NAME, user_id=USER_ID)

async def main() -> None:
    runner = build_runner()

    print(
        "Session 1 ->",
        await runner.run(
            messages="记一下：我对花生过敏，而且我是素食者。",
            session_id="session-1",
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Session 2 ->",
        await runner.run(
            messages="帮我推荐一道适合我的菜，要考虑我的饮食限制。",
            session_id="session-2",
        ),
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

智能体能在会话 #2 中识别同一用户在会话 #1 留下的偏好，给出连贯、个性化的回答（如推荐一道无花生的素食菜品）。

---

# local.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/local.en.mdx

title: "In-memory (local)"

The `local` backend (`InMemoryLTMBackend`) keeps a vector index in process memory for long-term memory. Memories are embedded and written to the in-memory vector store; retrieval recalls by similarity. Everything is cleared when the process exits.

## When to use

- Local development and debugging;
- Validating the end-to-end long-term memory flow (write → cross-session retrieval) without standing up an external service.

## Dependencies

```bash
pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"
```

And configure an embedding model (falls back to `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`):

| Field | Env var | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_NAME` | Embedding model name |
| `dim` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM` | Vector dimension (varies by model) |
| `api_base` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_BASE` | Embedding API base |
| `api_key` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | Embedding API key |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="local", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

For a full cross-session example, see [Long-term memory · Cross-session example](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term#cross-session-example).

Need persistence or multi-instance sharing? Use [VikingDB](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb), [Mem0](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0), [OpenSearch](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch), or [Redis](/en/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis).

# local.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/local.mdx

title: "本地内存（local）"

`local` 后端（`InMemoryLTMBackend`）在进程内存中维护一个向量索引来存取长期记忆。记忆会被 embedding 后写入内存向量库，检索时按相似度召回。进程退出即清空。

## 何时使用

- 本地开发与调试；
- 验证长期记忆的端到端流程（写入 → 跨会话检索），无需搭建外部服务。

## 依赖

```bash
pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"
```

并配置 embedding 模型（缺省时复用 `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY`）：

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_NAME` | embedding 模型名 |
| `dim` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM` | 向量维度（随模型不同而不同） |
| `api_base` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_BASE` | embedding API base |
| `api_key` | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | embedding API Key |

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="local", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

完整跨会话示例见[长期记忆 · 跨会话示例](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term#跨会话示例)。

需要持久化或多实例共享？请改用 [VikingDB](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb)、[Mem0](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0)、[OpenSearch](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch) 或 [Redis](/cn/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis)。

# mem0.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0.en.mdx

title: "Mem0 (mem0)"

The `mem0` backend (`Mem0LTMBackend`) uses [Mem0](https://mem0.ai/) as long-term storage. It is a managed service requiring no self-hosted vector store or local embedding — **recommended for production**.

## When to use

- Production needing a managed memory service;
- You already have a Mem0 account and API key.

## Configuration

VeADK reads config via `Mem0Config`, with the env prefix `DATABASE_MEM0_`:

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `api_key` | `DATABASE_MEM0_API_KEY` | `""` | Mem0 API key. |
| `api_key_id` | `DATABASE_MEM0_API_KEY_ID` | `""` | Used to auto-fetch the API key (alternative to `project_id`). |
| `project_id` | `DATABASE_MEM0_PROJECT_ID` | `""` | Used to auto-fetch the API key. |
| `base_url` | `DATABASE_MEM0_BASE_URL` | `""` | Mem0 service endpoint. |

<Callout type="info">
If `api_key` isn't provided directly, VeADK tries to obtain it via `api_key_id` or `project_id`; an error is raised if neither is set.

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="mem0", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

Install the dependency:

```bash
pip install mem0
```

# mem0.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/mem0.mdx

title: "Mem0（mem0）"

`mem0` 后端（`Mem0LTMBackend`）使用 [Mem0](https://mem0.ai/) 记忆库作为长期记忆存储。它是托管服务，无需自建向量库或本地 embedding，**生产推荐**。

## 何时使用

- 生产环境、需要托管的记忆服务；
- 已有 Mem0 账号与 API Key。

## 配置

VeADK 用 `Mem0Config` 读取配置，环境变量前缀为 `DATABASE_MEM0_`：

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `api_key` | `DATABASE_MEM0_API_KEY` | `""` | Mem0 API Key。 |
| `api_key_id` | `DATABASE_MEM0_API_KEY_ID` | `""` | 用于自动获取 API Key（与 `project_id` 二选一）。 |
| `project_id` | `DATABASE_MEM0_PROJECT_ID` | `""` | 用于自动获取 API Key。 |
| `base_url` | `DATABASE_MEM0_BASE_URL` | `""` | Mem0 服务端点。 |

<Callout type="info">
若未直接提供 `api_key`，VeADK 会尝试用 `api_key_id` 或 `project_id` 自动换取；两者都没有则报错。

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="mem0", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

依赖安装：

```bash
pip install mem0
```

# index must be lowercase, only a-z0-9_-., and not start with _ or -

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch.en.mdx

title: "OpenSearch (opensearch)"

The `opensearch` backend (`OpensearchLTMBackend`) uses OpenSearch as the vector store. Memories are embedded and written to OpenSearch, with a per-user index (`{index}_{user_id}`), and retrieved by similarity. It is the **default backend** for `LongTermMemory`.

## When to use

- You already run an OpenSearch cluster and want self-hosted vector search;
- You need persistence with full control over indexing/retrieval.

## Dependencies

```bash
pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"
```

## Configuration

OpenSearch connection is read via `OpensearchConfig` (env prefix `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_`); embedding via `MODEL_EMBEDDING_*`.

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_HOST` | `""` | OpenSearch host. |
| `port` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PORT` | `9200` | Port. |
| `username` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USERNAME` | `""` | Username. |
| `password` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD` | `""` | Password. |
| `use_ssl` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USE_SSL` | `true` | Whether to enable SSL. |
| `cert_path` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_CERT_PATH` | `""` | CA cert path; when empty, certificates are not verified (a security risk; warns). |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

# index must be lowercase, only a-z0-9_-., and not start with _ or -
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="opensearch", index="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

<Callout type="warn">
`index` must follow OpenSearch naming rules: all lowercase, only `a-z0-9_-.`, and not starting with `_` or `-`, otherwise a `ValueError` is raised. In production, set `cert_path` to enable certificate verification.

---

# index 需为小写，仅含 a-z0-9_-.，且不以 _ 或 - 开头

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/opensearch.mdx

title: "OpenSearch（opensearch）"

`opensearch` 后端（`OpensearchLTMBackend`）使用 OpenSearch 作为向量存储。记忆经 embedding 后写入 OpenSearch，按用户隔离索引（`{index}_{user_id}`），检索时按相似度召回。它是 `LongTermMemory` 的**默认后端**。

## 何时使用

- 已有 OpenSearch 集群，希望自建向量检索；
- 需要持久化且对索引/检索有完全掌控。

## 依赖

```bash
pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"
```

## 配置

OpenSearch 连接用 `OpensearchConfig` 读取，环境变量前缀 `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_`；embedding 用 `MODEL_EMBEDDING_*`。

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_HOST` | `""` | OpenSearch 主机。 |
| `port` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PORT` | `9200` | 端口。 |
| `username` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USERNAME` | `""` | 用户名。 |
| `password` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD` | `""` | 密码。 |
| `use_ssl` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USE_SSL` | `true` | 是否启用 SSL。 |
| `cert_path` | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_CERT_PATH` | `""` | CA 证书路径；为空时不校验证书（有安全风险，会告警）。 |

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

# index 需为小写，仅含 a-z0-9_-.，且不以 _ 或 - 开头
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="opensearch", index="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

<Callout type="warn">
`index` 必须符合 OpenSearch 命名规则：全小写，仅含 `a-z0-9_-.`，且不以 `_` 或 `-` 开头，否则会抛出 `ValueError`。生产环境请配置 `cert_path` 以启用证书校验。

# redis.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis.en.mdx

title: "Redis (redis)"

The `redis` backend (`RedisLTMBackend`) uses Redis as the vector store, with a per-user index (`veadk-ltm/{index}/{user_id}`). Memories are embedded and written; retrieval recalls by similarity (cosine).

## When to use

- You already run Redis with the **RediSearch** module enabled;
- You want Redis as a low-latency vector-search backend.

## Dependencies

```bash
pip install "veadk-python[extensions]"
```

Redis must support RediSearch (vector search).

## Configuration

Redis connection is read via `RedisConfig` (env prefix `DATABASE_REDIS_`); embedding via `MODEL_EMBEDDING_*`.

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_REDIS_HOST` | `""` | Redis host. |
| `port` | `DATABASE_REDIS_PORT` | `6379` | Port. |
| `username` | `DATABASE_REDIS_USERNAME` | `None` | Username (optional). |
| `password` | `DATABASE_REDIS_PASSWORD` | `""` | Password. |
| `db` | `DATABASE_REDIS_DB` | `0` | Database number. |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="redis", index="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

<Callout type="info">
The vector dimension comes from the embedding config (`MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM`), and the distance metric is cosine. An index is created per user.

---

# redis.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/redis.mdx

title: "Redis（redis）"

`redis` 后端（`RedisLTMBackend`）使用 Redis 作为向量存储，按用户隔离索引（`veadk-ltm/{index}/{user_id}`）。记忆经 embedding 后写入，检索时按相似度（cosine）召回。

## 何时使用

- 已有 Redis 且开启了 **RediSearch** 模块；
- 希望用 Redis 作为低延迟的向量检索后端。


Redis 需支持 RediSearch（向量检索）能力。

## 配置

Redis 连接用 `RedisConfig` 读取，环境变量前缀 `DATABASE_REDIS_`；embedding 用 `MODEL_EMBEDDING_*`。

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_REDIS_HOST` | `""` | Redis 主机。 |
| `port` | `DATABASE_REDIS_PORT` | `6379` | 端口。 |
| `username` | `DATABASE_REDIS_USERNAME` | `None` | 用户名（可选）。 |
| `password` | `DATABASE_REDIS_PASSWORD` | `""` | 密码。 |
| `db` | `DATABASE_REDIS_DB` | `0` | 数据库编号。 |

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="redis", index="ltm_demo")

```

<Callout type="info">
向量维度取自 embedding 配置（`MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM`），距离度量为 cosine。索引会为每个用户单独创建。

# index must start with a letter, contain only letters/digits/underscores, length 1–128

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb.en.mdx

title: "VikingDB (viking)"

The `viking` backend (`VikingDBLTMBackend`) uses Volcengine [VikingDB memory](https://www.volcengine.com/product/vikingdb) as long-term storage. It is a managed service requiring no self-hosted vector store or local embedding — **recommended for production**. This backend also supports user profiles (`get_user_profile`).

## When to use

- Production with persistence and managed operations;
- When you want Volcengine's memory capabilities (including user profiles).

## Configuration

Authenticated via Volcengine AK/SK. VeADK reads AK/SK from environment variables first, falling back to VeFaaS IAM credentials (for cloud deployments).

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `volcengine_access_key` | `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` | — | Volcengine Access Key. |
| `volcengine_secret_key` | `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | — | Volcengine Secret Key. |
| `volcengine_project` | `DATABASE_VIKINGMEM_PROJECT` | `default` | VikingDB memory project. |
| `region` | `DATABASE_VIKING_REGION` | `cn-beijing` (`cn-hongkong` for byteplus) | Region. |
| `memory_type` | `DATABASE_VIKINGMEM_MEMORY_TYPE` | `["sys_event_v1", "sys_profile_v1"]` | Memory type list; a comma-separated env var is parsed into a list. |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

# index must start with a letter, contain only letters/digits/underscores, length 1–128
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

At init, if the collection doesn't exist, VeADK creates it from `memory_type`.

### Get a user profile

```python
profile = ltm.get_user_profile(user_id="user-42")
print(profile)
```

<Callout type="info">
`index` (the collection name) must follow VikingDB rules: start with an English letter, contain only letters, digits, and underscores, length 1–128.

---

# index 必须以字母开头，仅含字母、数字、下划线，长度 1–128

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/long-term/vikingdb.mdx

title: "VikingDB（viking）"

`viking` 后端（`VikingDBLTMBackend`）使用火山引擎 [VikingDB 记忆库](https://www.volcengine.com/product/vikingdb)作为长期记忆存储。它是托管服务，无需自建向量库或本地 embedding，**生产推荐**。该后端还支持获取用户画像（`get_user_profile`）。

## 何时使用

- 生产环境、需要持久化与托管运维；
- 希望使用火山引擎的记忆库能力（含用户画像）。

## 配置

通过火山引擎 AK/SK 鉴权。VeADK 会优先从环境变量读取 AK/SK，未设置时尝试从 VeFaaS IAM 获取凭证（云上部署场景）。

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `volcengine_access_key` | `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` | — | 火山引擎 Access Key。 |
| `volcengine_secret_key` | `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | — | 火山引擎 Secret Key。 |
| `volcengine_project` | `DATABASE_VIKINGMEM_PROJECT` | `default` | VikingDB 记忆库项目。 |
| `region` | `DATABASE_VIKING_REGION` | `cn-beijing`（byteplus 为 `cn-hongkong`） | 区域。 |
| `memory_type` | `DATABASE_VIKINGMEM_MEMORY_TYPE` | `["sys_event_v1", "sys_profile_v1"]` | 记忆类型列表，逗号分隔的环境变量会被解析为列表。 |

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent
from veadk.memory.long_term_memory import LongTermMemory

# index 必须以字母开头，仅含字母、数字、下划线，长度 1–128
ltm = LongTermMemory(backend="viking", app_name="ltm_demo")
agent = Agent(name="demo", long_term_memory=ltm)
```

初始化时若集合（collection）不存在，VeADK 会按 `memory_type` 自动创建。

### 获取用户画像

```python
profile = ltm.get_user_profile(user_id="user-42")
print(profile)
```

<Callout type="info">
`index`（即集合名）需满足 VikingDB 命名规则：以英文字母开头，仅包含字母、数字和下划线，长度 1–128。

# Select the implementation via backend

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/index.en.mdx

title: "Short-term memory"

Short-term memory holds **session-level** context so an agent remembers what was said across turns. It is essentially the conversation context sent to the model — the system prompt plus the message history — keyed by `session_id`: reuse the same `session_id` and the agent remembers earlier turns.

When a user starts a conversation, `ShortTermMemory` (or the underlying `SessionService`) automatically creates a `Session` object and tracks everything in that conversation.

<Callout type="info">
Short-term memory builds on Google ADK's Session mechanism. For background, see [Google ADK Session](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/sessions/session).

## Single entry point: `ShortTermMemory`

Whatever backend you use, you interact with one class — `veadk.memory.short_term_memory.ShortTermMemory`. It selects and initializes the underlying session service based on `backend` (or `db_url`) and exposes a uniform session-management surface.

```python
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

# Select the implementation via backend
stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="sqlite", local_database_path="./stm.db")
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `backend` | `"local" \| "sqlite" \| "mysql" \| "postgresql" \| "database"` | `"local"` | Selects the backend. `database` is deprecated and equivalent to `sqlite`. |
| `db_url` | `str` | `""` | A database connection string (e.g. `sqlite:///./test.db`). **Once set, `backend` is ignored** and ADK's `DatabaseSessionService` is used directly. |
| `backend_configs` | `dict` | `{}` | Config passed to the backend constructor (e.g. overriding the `mysql`/`postgresql` config). |
| `db_kwargs` | `dict` | `{}` | Extra args forwarded to the underlying database session service/driver (e.g. connection pool settings). |
| `local_database_path` | `str` | `/tmp/veadk_local_database.db` | Local DB file path, used only by `sqlite`. |
| `after_load_memory_callback` | `Callable \| None` | `None` | Callback invoked after a session is loaded; receives the loaded `Session`. |

<Callout type="warn">
If a username or password in the connection string contains special characters such as `@` or `:`, URL-encode it with `urllib.parse.quote_plus` first (e.g. `p@ssword` → `p%40ssword`), otherwise parsing fails.

## Backend abstraction: `BaseShortTermMemoryBackend`

Every persistent backend extends `BaseShortTermMemoryBackend`, whose only contract is to expose a Google ADK `BaseSessionService`.

```python
class BaseShortTermMemoryBackend(ABC, BaseModel):
    @cached_property
    @abstractmethod
    def session_service(self) -> BaseSessionService:
        """Return the underlying session service instance."""
```

So:

- `local` uses ADK's `InMemorySessionService` directly;
- `sqlite` / `mysql` / `postgresql` each build a connection string and return an instance backed by ADK's `DatabaseSessionService`.

This means **every backend behaves the same to the layers above**; only the persistence location and connection differ. To add a custom backend, subclass this base and implement `session_service`.

## Choosing a backend

| Backend | Persistent | External service | Use case | Docs |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local` | No (memory only) | None | Local debugging, ephemeral sessions | [In-memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/local) |
| `sqlite` | Yes (local file) | None | Single-node persistence | [SQLite](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite) |
| `mysql` | Yes | MySQL | Distributed persistence | [MySQL](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql) |
| `postgresql` | Yes | PostgreSQL | Distributed persistence | [PostgreSQL](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/postgresql) |

## Working with the Runner

Short-term memory is usually passed to the `Runner`, which pulls `session_service` from it to auto-create/restore sessions. Reuse the same `session_id` at run time to continue the context.

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="sqlite", local_database_path="./stm.db")
agent = Agent(name="memory_agent", instruction="Remember what the user tells you.")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")

async def main():
    sid = "user-42-chat"
    print(await runner.run(messages="My name is Ming and my favorite color is blue.", session_id=sid))
    print(await runner.run(messages="What's my name? What's my favorite color?", session_id=sid))

asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="info">
If you pass neither `short_term_memory` nor `session_service` to the `Runner`, it falls back to creating a `local` (in-memory) short-term memory automatically.

## Session management interface

You rarely create or manage a `Session` directly; instead you use `session_service` to manage the full lifecycle:

1. **Start a session** `create_session()`: create a new `Session` when the user starts interacting.
2. **Resume a session** `get_session()`: retrieve a `Session` by `session_id` to continue.
3. **Save progress** `append_event()`: append a new interaction (`Event`) to the history.
4. **List sessions** `list_sessions()`: query active sessions for a user and app.
5. **Clean up** `delete_session()`: delete a `Session` and its associated data.

Under a database backend, `ShortTermMemory.create_session()` first lists and reuses an existing session with the same `session_id` to avoid duplicates.

## Context compaction

As a conversation grows, the history keeps expanding, increasing what the model must process and slowing responses. Context compaction summarizes the history with a sliding window: when the history exceeds a threshold, older events are compacted automatically.

### Configure compaction

Once configured, the `Runner` compacts the history each time the interval is reached.

```python
from google.adk.apps.app import App, EventsCompactionConfig

from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    name="my_agent",
    instruction="You are a helpful assistant who answers politely.",
)

app = App(
    name="my_agent",
    root_agent=root_agent,
    events_compaction_config=EventsCompactionConfig(
        compaction_interval=3,  # compact every 3 new calls
        overlap_size=1,         # overlap with the last event of the previous window
    ),
)
```

### Custom compactor

Use `LlmEventSummarizer` to set the model and prompt template for compaction. Provide the model's API key / base via environment variables (read from `os.environ`, never hard-code):

```python
import os

from google.adk.apps.app import App, EventsCompactionConfig
from google.adk.apps.llm_event_summarizer import LlmEventSummarizer
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    name="my_agent",
    instruction="You are a helpful assistant who answers politely.",
)

summarization_llm = LiteLlm(
    model="volcengine/doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    api_key=os.environ["MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY"],
    api_base=os.environ.get(
        "MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE", "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/"
    ),
)

my_compactor = LlmEventSummarizer(
    llm=summarization_llm,
    prompt_template="""Summarize this conversation:
1. Keep key entities, data points, and timeline;
2. Highlight the core problems discussed and their solutions;
3. Stay logically coherent and context-relevant;
4. Remove repetition and redundant details.""",
)

app = App(
    name="my_agent",
    root_agent=root_agent,
    events_compaction_config=EventsCompactionConfig(
        compactor=my_compactor,
        compaction_interval=5,
        overlap_size=1,
    ),
)
```

---

# 通过 backend 选择实现

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/index.mdx

title: "短期记忆"

短期记忆（Short-term Memory）保存「会话级」上下文，让智能体在多轮交互中记住之前说过的话。它本质上就是发送给模型的对话上下文——系统提示词加历史消息——VeADK 用 `session_id` 来标识：复用同一个 `session_id`，智能体就能记住之前的轮次。

当用户开启对话时，`ShortTermMemory`（或底层的 `SessionService`）会自动创建一个 `Session` 对象，全程跟踪并管理该会话的所有内容。

<Callout type="info">
短期记忆基于 Google ADK 的 Session 机制，更多背景见 [Google ADK Session](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/sessions/session)。

## 统一入口：`ShortTermMemory`

无论用哪种后端，你都只与一个类打交道——`veadk.memory.short_term_memory.ShortTermMemory`。它根据 `backend`（或 `db_url`）选择并初始化底层的会话服务，对外暴露统一的会话管理能力。

```python
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

# 通过 backend 选择实现
stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="sqlite", local_database_path="./stm.db")
```

### 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `backend` | `"local" \| "sqlite" \| "mysql" \| "postgresql" \| "database"` | `"local"` | 选择后端实现。`database` 已废弃，等价于 `sqlite`。 |
| `db_url` | `str` | `""` | 直接给出数据库连接串（如 `sqlite:///./test.db`）。**一旦设置，将忽略 `backend`**，直接用 ADK 的 `DatabaseSessionService`。 |
| `backend_configs` | `dict` | `{}` | 传给后端构造函数的配置（如 `mysql`/`postgresql` 的 config 覆盖）。 |
| `db_kwargs` | `dict` | `{}` | 透传给底层数据库会话服务/驱动的额外参数（如连接池配置）。 |
| `local_database_path` | `str` | `/tmp/veadk_local_database.db` | 仅 `sqlite` 使用的本地数据库文件路径。 |
| `after_load_memory_callback` | `Callable \| None` | `None` | 读取会话后触发的回调，入参为加载到的 `Session`。 |

<Callout type="warn">
当连接串里的用户名或密码包含 `@`、`:` 等特殊字符时，请先用 `urllib.parse.quote_plus` 编码（例如 `p@ssword` → `p%40ssword`），否则解析会出错。

## 后端抽象：`BaseShortTermMemoryBackend`

所有持久化后端都继承自 `BaseShortTermMemoryBackend`，其契约只有一项：暴露一个 Google ADK 的 `BaseSessionService`。

```python
class BaseShortTermMemoryBackend(ABC, BaseModel):
    @cached_property
    @abstractmethod
    def session_service(self) -> BaseSessionService:
        """返回底层的会话服务实例。"""
```

这意味着：

- `local` 直接使用 ADK 的 `InMemorySessionService`；
- `sqlite` / `mysql` / `postgresql` 各自构造连接串，返回基于 ADK `DatabaseSessionService` 的实例。

因此**所有后端对上层的行为是一致的**，区别只在于持久化位置与连接方式。要自定义后端，继承该基类并实现 `session_service` 即可。

## 选择后端

| 后端 | 是否持久化 | 依赖外部服务 | 适用场景 | 文档 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local` | 否（仅内存） | 无 | 本地调试、临时会话 | [本地内存](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/local) |
| `sqlite` | 是（本地文件） | 无 | 单机持久化 | [SQLite](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite) |
| `mysql` | 是 | MySQL | 分布式持久化 | [MySQL](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql) |
| `postgresql` | 是 | PostgreSQL | 分布式持久化 | [PostgreSQL](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/postgresql) |

## 与 Runner 协作

短期记忆通常传给 `Runner`：`Runner` 会从中取出 `session_service` 来自动创建/恢复会话。运行时复用相同的 `session_id` 即可延续上下文。

```python
import asyncio

from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="sqlite", local_database_path="./stm.db")
agent = Agent(name="memory_agent", instruction="记住用户告诉你的信息。")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")

async def main():
    sid = "user-42-chat"
    print(await runner.run(messages="我叫小明，最喜欢蓝色。", session_id=sid))
    print(await runner.run(messages="我叫什么？喜欢什么颜色？", session_id=sid))

asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="info">
若既没给 `Runner` 传 `short_term_memory` 也没传 `session_service`，`Runner` 会自动创建一个 `local`（内存）短期记忆兜底。

## 会话管理接口

你通常无需直接创建或管理 `Session`，而是通过 `session_service` 管理整个会话生命周期：

1. **启动新会话** `create_session()`：用户发起交互时创建新的 `Session`。
2. **恢复已有会话** `get_session()`：通过 `session_id` 检索特定 `Session`，接续之前的进度。
3. **保存进度** `append_event()`：把新的交互（`Event`）追加到会话历史。
4. **列出会话** `list_sessions()`：查询某用户与应用下的活跃会话。
5. **清理会话** `delete_session()`：删除 `Session` 及其关联数据。

`ShortTermMemory.create_session()` 在数据库后端下会先列出并复用同 `session_id` 的已有会话，避免重复创建。

## 上下文压缩

随着会话进行，历史会不断增长，导致模型处理的数据变多、响应变慢。上下文压缩用滑动窗口汇总历史：当会话历史超过设定阈值时，自动压缩较早的事件。

### 配置上下文压缩

配置后，`Runner` 会在每次达到间隔时自动压缩会话历史。

```python
from google.adk.apps.app import App, EventsCompactionConfig

from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    name="my_agent",
    instruction="你是一个智能助手，擅长用中文礼貌地回复用户问题。",
)

app = App(
    name="my_agent",
    root_agent=root_agent,
    events_compaction_config=EventsCompactionConfig(
        compaction_interval=3,  # 每 3 次新调用触发一次压缩
        overlap_size=1,         # 与上一个窗口的最后一个事件重叠
    ),
)
```

### 自定义压缩器

用 `LlmEventSummarizer` 指定压缩使用的模型和提示词模板。模型的 API Key / API Base 通过环境变量提供，这里从 `os.environ` 读取，不要硬编码：

```python
import os

from google.adk.apps.app import App, EventsCompactionConfig
from google.adk.apps.llm_event_summarizer import LlmEventSummarizer
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

from veadk import Agent

root_agent = Agent(
    name="my_agent",
    instruction="你是一个智能助手，擅长用中文礼貌地回复用户问题。",
)

summarization_llm = LiteLlm(
    model="volcengine/doubao-seed-1-8-251228",
    api_key=os.environ["MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY"],
    api_base=os.environ.get(
        "MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE", "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/"
    ),
)

my_compactor = LlmEventSummarizer(
    llm=summarization_llm,
    prompt_template="""请总结这段对话，压缩要求：
1. 保留关键实体、数据点和时间线；
2. 突出讨论过的核心问题与解决方案；
3. 保持逻辑连贯与上下文相关；
4. 去除重复表达和冗余细节。""",
)

app = App(
    name="my_agent",
    root_agent=root_agent,
    events_compaction_config=EventsCompactionConfig(
        compactor=my_compactor,
        compaction_interval=5,
        overlap_size=1,
    ),
)
```

---

# local.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/local.en.mdx

title: "In-memory (local)"

The `local` backend keeps sessions in process memory, backed by Google ADK's `InMemorySessionService`. It needs no external service and never touches disk — when the process exits, sessions are gone.

## When to use

- Local development and debugging;
- Unit tests, example scripts, and other ephemeral scenarios;
- When sessions don't need to survive across processes or restarts.

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="local")  # local is the default

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm)
```

<Callout type="info">
`local` is the default backend for `ShortTermMemory`. If the `Runner` receives no short-term memory or session service, it also falls back to creating a `local` instance.

## Parameters

The `local` backend needs no extra configuration; it only uses `ShortTermMemory`'s common parameters. See [Short-term memory · Parameters](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term#parameters).

Need sessions to survive restarts? Use [SQLite](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite) instead.

---

# local.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/local.mdx

title: "本地内存（local）"

`local` 后端把会话保存在进程内存中，底层使用 Google ADK 的 `InMemorySessionService`。它不依赖任何外部服务，也不落盘——进程退出，会话即清空。

## 何时使用

- 本地开发与调试；
- 单元测试、示例脚本等临时场景；
- 不需要会话跨进程/跨重启保留时。

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="local")  # 默认即为 local

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm)
```

<Callout type="info">
`local` 是 `ShortTermMemory` 的默认后端。若 `Runner` 未收到任何短期记忆或会话服务，也会自动创建一个 `local` 实例兜底。

## 参数

`local` 后端无需额外配置，仅使用 `ShortTermMemory` 的通用参数。详见[短期记忆 · 参数](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term#参数)。

需要会话在重启后仍然保留？请改用 [SQLite](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite)。

---

# mysql.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql.en.mdx

title: "MySQL (mysql)"

The `mysql` backend stores sessions in a MySQL database, backed by Google ADK's `DatabaseSessionService`. Multiple agent instances can connect to the same database for shared, distributed persistence.

## When to use

- Production, multi-instance / distributed deployments;
- When sessions are centrally managed by a shared MySQL.

## Configuration

Provide connection details via `config.yaml` (or the matching environment variables) — **never hard-code the password**. VeADK reads them through `MysqlConfig`, with the env prefix `DATABASE_MYSQL_`:

```yaml title="config.yaml"
database:
  mysql:
    host:       # host or IP
    user:
    password:
    database:
    charset: utf8
```

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_HOST` | `""` | Database host. |
| `user` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_USER` | `""` | Username. |
| `password` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_PASSWORD` | `""` | Password. |
| `database` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_DATABASE` | `""` | Database name. |
| `charset` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_CHARSET` | `utf8` | Character set. |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="mysql")  # connection details from config.yaml / env

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")
```

To forward driver args such as connection pooling, use `db_kwargs`:

```python
stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="mysql", db_kwargs={"pool_size": 10, "pool_recycle": 3600})
```

<Callout type="info">
VeADK auto-selects the sync or async MySQL driver (`pymysql` or `aiomysql`) based on the runtime. Special characters in the username/password are URL-encoded automatically. You can [provision MySQL on Volcengine](https://www.volcengine.com/product/rds-mysql).

---

# mysql.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql.mdx

title: "MySQL（mysql）"

`mysql` 后端把会话存储到 MySQL 数据库，底层使用 Google ADK 的 `DatabaseSessionService`。多个智能体实例可连接同一数据库，实现会话共享与分布式持久化。

## 何时使用

- 生产环境、多实例/分布式部署；
- 需要由统一的 MySQL 集中管理会话数据。

## 配置

连接信息通过 `config.yaml`（或对应环境变量）提供，**不要把密码写进代码**。VeADK 用 `MysqlConfig` 读取，环境变量前缀为 `DATABASE_MYSQL_`：

```yaml title="config.yaml"
database:
  mysql:
    host:       # 主机或 IP
    user:
    password:
    database:
    charset: utf8
```

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_HOST` | `""` | 数据库主机。 |
| `user` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_USER` | `""` | 用户名。 |
| `password` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_PASSWORD` | `""` | 密码。 |
| `database` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_DATABASE` | `""` | 数据库名。 |
| `charset` | `DATABASE_MYSQL_CHARSET` | `utf8` | 字符集。 |

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="mysql")  # 连接信息来自 config.yaml / 环境变量

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")
```

如需透传连接池等驱动参数，可使用 `db_kwargs`：

```python
stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="mysql", db_kwargs={"pool_size": 10, "pool_recycle": 3600})
```

<Callout type="info">
VeADK 会根据运行环境自动选择同步或异步 MySQL 驱动（`pymysql` 或 `aiomysql`）。用户名/密码中的特殊字符会被自动 URL 编码。可在火山引擎[开通 MySQL 数据库](https://www.volcengine.com/product/rds-mysql)。

# postgresql.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/postgresql.en.mdx

title: "PostgreSQL (postgresql)"

The `postgresql` backend stores sessions in a PostgreSQL database, backed by Google ADK's `DatabaseSessionService`. Multiple agent instances can connect to the same database for shared, distributed persistence.

## When to use

- Production, multi-instance / distributed deployments;
- Teams already using PostgreSQL as shared storage.

## Configuration

Provide connection details via `config.yaml` (or the matching environment variables) — **never hard-code the password**. VeADK reads them through `PostgreSqlConfig`, with the env prefix `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_`:

```yaml title="config.yaml"
database:
  postgresql:
    host:       # host or IP
    port: 5432
    user:
    password:
    database:
```

| Field | Env var | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `host` | `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_HOST` | `""` | Database host. |
| `port` | `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_PORT` | `5432` | Port. |
| `user` | `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_USER` | `""` | Username. |
| `password` | `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD` | `""` | Password. |
| `database` | `DATABASE_POSTGRESQL_DATABASE` | `""` | Database name. |

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(backend="postgresql")  # connection details from config.yaml / env

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")
```

To forward driver args such as connection pooling, use `db_kwargs`.

<Callout type="info">
VeADK auto-selects the sync or async PostgreSQL driver (`psycopg`/`asyncpg`) based on the runtime. Special characters in the username/password are URL-encoded automatically. You can [provision PostgreSQL on Volcengine](https://www.volcengine.com/product/rds-pg).

# sqlite.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite.en.mdx

title: "SQLite (sqlite)"

The `sqlite` backend persists sessions to a local SQLite file, backed by Google ADK's `DatabaseSessionService`. It needs no external database service, but unlike `local`, sessions are written to disk and therefore **survive across processes and restarts**.

## When to use

- Single-node deployments that need persistence;
- Local development where you want to keep past sessions;
- Small data volumes with no need for distributed access.

## Usage

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(
    backend="sqlite",
    local_database_path="./short_term_memory.db",  # DB file location
)

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")
```

If the DB file doesn't exist, VeADK creates it automatically (including any parent directories).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local_database_path` | `str` | `/tmp/veadk_local_database.db` | SQLite file path; resolved to an absolute path. |

For the remaining common parameters, see [Short-term memory · Parameters](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term#parameters).

<Callout type="info">
You can also pass a connection string directly via `db_url`, e.g. `ShortTermMemory(db_url="sqlite:///./test.db")`; then `backend` and `local_database_path` are ignored.

Need distributed persistence? Use [MySQL](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql) or [PostgreSQL](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term/postgresql).

---

# sqlite.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/memory/short-term/sqlite.mdx

title: "SQLite（sqlite）"

`sqlite` 后端把会话持久化到一个本地 SQLite 文件，底层使用 Google ADK 的 `DatabaseSessionService`。它不依赖外部数据库服务，但与 `local` 不同，会话会落盘，因此可以**跨进程、跨重启保留**。

## 何时使用

- 单机部署且需要持久化；
- 本地开发但希望保留历史会话；
- 数据量不大、无需分布式访问的场景。

## 用法

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.memory.short_term_memory import ShortTermMemory

stm = ShortTermMemory(
    backend="sqlite",
    local_database_path="./short_term_memory.db",  # 数据库文件位置
)

agent = Agent(name="demo")
runner = Runner(agent=agent, short_term_memory=stm, app_name="memory_demo")
```

若数据库文件不存在，VeADK 会自动创建（包括所需的父目录）。

## 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `local_database_path` | `str` | `/tmp/veadk_local_database.db` | SQLite 文件路径，会被解析为绝对路径。 |

其余通用参数见[短期记忆 · 参数](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term#参数)。

<Callout type="info">
也可以用 `db_url` 直接给出连接串，例如 `ShortTermMemory(db_url="sqlite:///./test.db")`；此时 `backend` 与 `local_database_path` 都会被忽略。

需要分布式持久化？请改用 [MySQL](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/mysql) 或 [PostgreSQL](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term/postgresql)。

# kwargs are passed through to uvicorn.run; set host, port, etc.

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a-hub.en.mdx

title: "A2A Hub"

In large-scale multi-agent systems, Agents need to discover each other's addresses and capabilities. The **A2A Hub** is a lightweight registry provided by VeADK that centrally manages Agents' [Agent Cards](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/) by **group**, so an Agent can dynamically discover other Agents in the same group without hardcoding each other's addresses.

The A2A Hub consists of two parts:

- **`A2AHubServer`**: A FastAPI-based registry service that stores groups and the Agent Cards under each group.
- **`A2AHubClient`**: A client that lets an Agent process register itself and query the Agent Cards of other Agents in the same group.

## Start the Hub Server

`A2AHubServer` exposes HTTP endpoints for creating groups, registering Agents, and querying groups and Agent Cards. Instantiate it and call `serve` to start the service (it uses `uvicorn` under the hood):

```python title="hub_server.py"
from veadk.a2a.hub.a2a_hub_server import A2AHubServer

server = A2AHubServer()

# kwargs are passed through to uvicorn.run; set host, port, etc.
server.serve(host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
```

The server provides the following endpoints:

| Method | Path | Description |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `GET` | `/ping` | Health check; returns `{"msg": "pong!"}` |
| `POST` | `/create_group` | Create a group (parameter `group_id`) |
| `POST` | `/register_agent` | Register an Agent to a specified group |
| `GET` | `/group/{group_id}/agents` | Get all Agents in a specified group |
| `GET` | `/group/{group_id}/agent/{agent_id}` | Get the Agent Card of an Agent in a group |
| `GET` | `/groups` | Get all registered groups |

## Use the Hub Client

`A2AHubClient` performs a health check against the server during initialization. Through it you can create groups, register Agent Cards, and pull Agent Cards within the same group.

```python title="hub_client.py"
from a2a.types import AgentCard
from veadk.a2a.hub.a2a_hub_client import A2AHubClient

client = A2AHubClient(server_host="127.0.0.1", server_port=8000)

# Create a group
client.create_group(group_id="weather-team")

# Register this Agent's Agent Card into the group
agent_card: AgentCard = ...  # from your A2AServer
client.register_agent(
    group_id="weather-team",
    agent_id="weather_agent",
    agent_card=agent_card,
)

# Pull all Agent Cards in the group
agent_infos = client.get_agent_cards(group_id="weather-team")

# Or pull only the Agent Cards of specific Agents
agent_infos = client.get_agent_cards(
    group_id="weather-team",
    target_agents=["weather_agent"],
)
```

`get_agent_cards` returns a list where each element contains an `agent_id` and its corresponding `agent_card`. When `target_agents` is empty, it returns all Agents in the group; otherwise it returns only the Agents whose IDs match the list.

## Typical Workflow

1. Deploy an `A2AHubServer` as the centralized registry.
2. When each Agent process starts, use `A2AHubClient` to call `create_group` (if the group does not yet exist), then call `register_agent` to register its own Agent Card.
3. Agents that need to collaborate use `get_agent_cards` to discover other Agents in the same group, and use the addresses in their Agent Cards to establish an A2A connection via [`RemoteVeAgent`](/en/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a).

<Callout type="info" title="Note">
The A2A Hub solves the "discovery" problem for Agents; the actual request/response still flows through the A2A protocol between `RemoteVeAgent` and `A2AServer`. The two are typically used together.

---

# kwargs 透传给 uvicorn.run，可设置 host、port 等

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a-hub.mdx

title: "A2A Hub"

在大规模多 Agent 系统中，Agent 之间需要相互发现对方的地址与能力。**A2A Hub** 是 VeADK 提供的一个轻量级注册中心（registry），用于按**分组（group）**集中管理 Agent 的 [Agent Card](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/)，使一个 Agent 能够动态发现同组内的其他 Agent，而无需在代码中硬编码彼此的地址。

A2A Hub 由两部分组成：

- **`A2AHubServer`**：一个基于 FastAPI 的注册中心服务，负责保存分组与各分组下的 Agent Card。
- **`A2AHubClient`**：客户端，供 Agent 进程注册自身、查询同组内其他 Agent 的 Agent Card。

## 启动 Hub 服务器

`A2AHubServer` 暴露了创建分组、注册 Agent、查询分组与 Agent Card 的 HTTP 接口。直接实例化并调用 `serve` 即可启动服务（底层使用 `uvicorn`）：

```python title="hub_server.py"
from veadk.a2a.hub.a2a_hub_server import A2AHubServer

server = A2AHubServer()

# kwargs 透传给 uvicorn.run，可设置 host、port 等
server.serve(host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
```

服务器提供以下接口：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `GET` | `/ping` | 健康检查，返回 `{"msg": "pong!"}` |
| `POST` | `/create_group` | 创建一个分组（参数 `group_id`） |
| `POST` | `/register_agent` | 向指定分组注册一个 Agent |
| `GET` | `/group/{group_id}/agents` | 获取指定分组内的全部 Agent |
| `GET` | `/group/{group_id}/agent/{agent_id}` | 获取指定分组内某个 Agent 的 Agent Card |
| `GET` | `/groups` | 获取全部已注册的分组 |

## 使用 Hub 客户端

`A2AHubClient` 在初始化时会对服务器执行一次健康检查。通过它可以创建分组、注册 Agent Card，以及拉取同组内的 Agent Card。

```python title="hub_client.py"
from a2a.types import AgentCard
from veadk.a2a.hub.a2a_hub_client import A2AHubClient

client = A2AHubClient(server_host="127.0.0.1", server_port=8000)

# 创建一个分组
client.create_group(group_id="weather-team")

# 将本 Agent 的 Agent Card 注册到分组中
agent_card: AgentCard = ...  # 来自您的 A2AServer
client.register_agent(
    group_id="weather-team",
    agent_id="weather_agent",
    agent_card=agent_card,
)

# 拉取同组内的全部 Agent Card
agent_infos = client.get_agent_cards(group_id="weather-team")

# 或仅拉取指定 Agent 的 Agent Card
agent_infos = client.get_agent_cards(
    group_id="weather-team",
    target_agents=["weather_agent"],
)
```

`get_agent_cards` 返回一个列表，每个元素包含 `agent_id` 与对应的 `agent_card`。当 `target_agents` 为空时返回该分组的全部 Agent；否则仅返回列表中匹配的 Agent。

## 典型工作流

1. 部署一个 `A2AHubServer` 作为中心化注册中心。
2. 每个 Agent 进程启动时，先用 `A2AHubClient` 调用 `create_group`（若分组尚不存在），再调用 `register_agent` 注册自身的 Agent Card。
3. 需要协作的 Agent 通过 `get_agent_cards` 发现同组内的其他 Agent，并据其 Agent Card 中的地址，使用 [`RemoteVeAgent`](/cn/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a) 建立 A2A 连接。

<Callout type="info" title="提示">
A2A Hub 解决的是 Agent 的「发现」问题；实际的请求/响应仍通过 A2A 协议在 `RemoteVeAgent` 与 `A2AServer` 之间进行。两者通常配合使用。
