# 1. Initialize the cloud engine; credentials are obtained automatically from environment variables

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/vefaas.en.mdx

title: "Deploy to VeFaaS"

This tutorial explains how to deploy your agent to the Volcengine VeFaaS function service.

## Prerequisites

Before you start deploying, make sure you have completed the following preparations:

1. **Create a Volcengine account**: You first need a valid Volcengine account.
2. **Enable the relevant cloud services**: To successfully deploy and access a VeADK application, you need to activate the following services in the Volcengine console. These are usually one-time operations completed by following the guide when you first access a service.
   - [**Function Service (veFaaS)**](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas): Hosts and runs your agent application code.
   - [**API Gateway**](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig): Creates and manages APIs so your agent application can be accessed externally.

### First-Time Service Authorization

If this is your first time using the above services, the console guides you through the necessary IAM (Identity and Access Management) role authorization. The flow is the same for both services:

1. The first time you enter the [Function Service](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas) or [API Gateway](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig) page, the console prompts you to enable the IAM role. Click **Authorize Now**.
2. After authorization succeeds, the system automatically redirects back to the corresponding service console, indicating the service is enabled.

![Enable IAM role](/assets/images/deploy/vefaas_attach_role.png)

<Callout type="warn">
  This authorization step is required. It grants the Function Service and API Gateway permission to access other cloud resources, ensuring the application can be deployed and run normally.

## Deployment Methods Overview

VeADK offers multiple deployment methods to fit different development workflows:

- **Deploy via the command-line tool (CLI)**: The fastest way, suitable for quickly creating, deploying, and iterating on agent applications.
- **Deploy via the Python SDK**: Lets you manage the deployment process programmatically by writing code, suitable for integration into automation scripts or existing projects.
- **Set up continuous delivery (CI/CD)**: Integrates with a code repository (such as GitHub) to automatically build and deploy after code commits, which is the best practice for team collaboration and production environments.

Next, we will detail the steps for each deployment method.

## Deploy via the Command-Line Tool (CLI)

You can deploy an agent project built with VeADK in the following two ways. For the full parameters of each command, see the [VeADK CLI](/en/docs/cli/veadk-cli).

### Method 1: Create and Deploy a New Project from Scratch

If you want to quickly start a standard enterprise-grade agent project, the `veadk init` command is the best choice. It generates a template project with a complete structure and configuration preset for you.

#### 1. Initialize the Project

Run the following command in your terminal:

```shell
veadk init
```

This command guides you through the basic configuration of the project. You need to enter the following information as prompted:

```shell
$ veadk init
Welcome use VeADK to create your project. We will generate a `weather-reporter` application for you.
Local directory name [veadk-cloud-proj]:
Volcengine FaaS application name [veadk-cloud-agent]:
Volcengine API Gateway instance name []:
Volcengine API Gateway service name []:
Volcengine API Gateway upstream name []:
Choose a deploy mode:
  1. A2A/MCP Server
  2. VeADK Web / Google ADK Web
Enter your choice (1, 2): 1
Choose an authentication method:
  1. None
  2. API key
  3. OAuth2
Enter your choice (1, 2, 3): 1
Template project has been generated at .../veadk-cloud-proj
Edit .../veadk-cloud-proj/src to define your agents
Edit .../veadk-cloud-proj/deploy.py to define your deployment attributes
Run python `deploy.py` for deployment on Volcengine FaaS platform.
```

**Parameter descriptions:**

- **Local directory name**: The directory name where the project is created locally.
- **Volcengine FaaS application name**: The name of your application on the Volcengine function service platform. **Note**: The name cannot contain underscores `_`.
- **Volcengine API Gateway ...**: The instance, service, and upstream names related to the API gateway. These are **optional** parameters. If left blank, VeADK automatically creates and associates the corresponding gateway resources at deploy time.
- **Choose a deploy mode**: Choose the deployment mode.
  - `A2A/MCP Server`: The standard backend agent service mode.
  - `VeADK Web / Google ADK Web`: Choose this if you need a web interaction interface.
- **Choose an authentication method**: Choose the gateway authentication method. `None` for no auth; `API key` for key authentication; `OAuth2` for Agent Identity single sign-on (`API key` is only available in A2A/MCP mode).

After the project is initialized, you can modify these configurations at any time in the generated `deploy.py` file.

The generated project structure is as follows:

<Files>
  <Folder name="veadk-cloud-proj" defaultOpen>
    <File name="__init__.py" />
    <File name="clean.py" />
    <File name="config.yaml.example" />
    <File name="deploy.py" />
    <Folder name="src" defaultOpen>
      <File name="__init__.py" />
      <File name="agent.py" />
      <File name="app.py" />
      <File name="requirements.txt" />
      <File name="run.sh" />
      <Folder name="weather_report" defaultOpen>
        <File name="__init__.py" />
        <File name="agent.py" />
      </Folder>
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

#### 2. Configure Environment Variables and Credentials

Before deploying, you need to configure the necessary environment variables, especially the credentials required to access Volcengine.

1. In the project root directory, copy the `config.yaml.example` file and rename it to `config.yaml`.
2. Edit the `config.yaml` file and fill in your Volcengine access keys (Access Key and Secret Key).
3. If this is a newly created Volcengine account, you also need to confirm whether the `ServerlessApplicationRole` role has been authorized. Go to the [Create Application page](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas/region:vefaas+cn-beijing/application/create) and click [One-Click Authorization].
![One-click authorization](/assets/images/deploy/add_permission.png)

```yaml
volcengine:
  access_key: "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY"    # Replace with your Volcengine Access Key
  secret_key: "YOUR_SECRET_KEY"  # Replace with your Volcengine Secret Key
```

<Callout type="warn" title="Important">
  The `config.yaml` file contains sensitive credential information and will not be uploaded to the cloud. The configuration items in the file are injected as environment variables into the function service's runtime environment. Be sure to keep this file secure and do not commit it to a public code repository.

#### 3. Execute the Deployment

After completing the configuration, run the deployment script in the project root directory:

```shell
python deploy.py
```

After the script runs, if you see the prompt `Start to release VeFaaS application`, it means the deployment process has started. When the terminal outputs information similar to the following, it means your agent application has been successfully deployed and released.

```shell
VeFaaS application ID: 3b015fxxxxxx
Test message: How is the weather like in Beijing?
```

### Method 2: Deploy an Existing Project

If you already have a locally developed agent project, you can use the `veadk deploy` command to quickly deploy it to the Volcengine function service platform.

#### 1. Project Preparation

Before deploying, make sure your project meets the following structural requirements:

- The project root directory must contain an `agent.py` file that defines a global variable `root_agent`.
- The project root directory must contain an `__init__.py` file that includes the `from . import agent` statement.

#### 2. Execute the Deployment

Run the following command in your project root directory:

```shell
veadk deploy --vefaas-app-name {YourAgentAppName}
```

Replace `{YourAgentAppName}` with your application name. After execution, if you see the prompt `Start to release VeFaaS application`, it means the deployment has started.

The `veadk deploy` command supports a rich set of parameters for detailed configuration. You can pass them via command-line flags or set them via environment variables.

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|-------|---------------------------------|
| --access-key | String | Volcengine AK |
| --secret-key | String | Volcengine SK |
| --vefaas-app-name | String | Volcengine VeFaaS application name |
| --veapig-instance-name | String | Volcengine gateway instance name |
| --veapig-service-name | String | Volcengine gateway service name |
| --veapig-upstream-name | String | Volcengine gateway upstream name |
| --short-term-memory-backend | String | `local` or `mysql`, the short-term memory backend |
| --use-adk-web | FLAG | When set, launches web in the cloud; otherwise A2A / MCP mode |
| --path | String | Local project path, defaults to the current directory |

## Deploy via the Python SDK

For developers who want to integrate the deployment process into automation scripts or an existing codebase, VeADK provides a powerful Python SDK. You can deploy, update, and remove applications programmatically through the `CloudAgentEngine` class.

### 1. Deploy the Agent Application

`CloudAgentEngine` is the core of deployment operations. After instantiating this class, call its `deploy` method to deploy your agent project.

**Credential configuration:**

When instantiating `CloudAgentEngine`, you can pass the Volcengine AK/SK directly. If not provided, the SDK automatically reads them from the environment variables `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` and `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY`.

**Code example:**

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

# 1. Initialize the cloud engine; credentials are obtained automatically from environment variables
engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# 2. Call the deploy method to deploy the application
cloud_app = engine.deploy(
    application_name="my-python-agent",
    path="./path/to/your/agent/project",
    gateway_name="my-agent-gateway",
    use_adk_web=False
)

# After successful deployment, you can get the application's access endpoint
print(f"Application endpoint: {cloud_app.vefaas_endpoint}")
```

The key parameters of the `deploy` method are as follows:

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|------------------------------|
| path | String | Local agent project path |
| application_name | String | Volcengine VeFaaS application name |
| gateway_name | String | Volcengine gateway instance name |
| gateway_service_name | String | Volcengine gateway service name |
| gateway_upstream_name | String | Volcengine gateway upstream name |
| use_adk_web | Boolean | Whether to use VeADK Web / Google Web in the cloud |

### 2. Manage the Deployed Application

After the `deploy` method executes successfully, it returns a `CloudApp` instance. This instance represents the application you deployed in the cloud, and you can use it for subsequent management operations such as making invocations, updating code, or removing the application.

#### Make Remote Invocations

You interact with the cloud agent through the `CloudApp` instance's async `message_send` method. Its signature is `message_send(message, session_id, user_id, timeout=600.0)`, and it returns the agent's response message.

**Code example:**

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

# Construct CloudApp via the application name returned at deploy time
# (you can also pass vefaas_endpoint or vefaas_application_id)
cloud_app = CloudApp(vefaas_application_name="my-python-agent")

SESSION_ID = "test_session_123"
USER_ID = "test_user_001"

async def main():
    response = await cloud_app.message_send(
        "How is the weather like in Beijing?", SESSION_ID, USER_ID
    )
    print(f"Agent response: {response}")

asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="info">
  When initializing `CloudApp`, you must provide at least one of `vefaas_endpoint`, `vefaas_application_id`, or `vefaas_application_name`; otherwise it raises `ValueError`.

If you need to interact with an already-deployed application (rather than immediately after deployment), create a `CloudApp` instance from the application's access endpoint, which you can find in the function service console:

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

APP_ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"

app = CloudApp(vefaas_endpoint=APP_ENDPOINT)

# Same call order: message, session_id, user_id
response = asyncio.run(app.message_send("And Shenzhen?", SESSION_ID, USER_ID))
print(f"Agent response: {response}")
```

#### Update Application Code

When your local agent code is updated, you can use the `update_function_code` method to update the deployed application without creating a new one.

<Callout type="warn">
  This operation only updates the function's code and configuration; the application's original access endpoint remains unchanged.

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# Update the code of an existing application, keeping the same access endpoint
updated_cloud_app = engine.update_function_code(
    application_name="my-agent-app",  # existing application name
    path="/my-agent-project"        # local project path; make sure it contains agent.py
)

# You can access your project via updated_cloud_app.vefaas_endpoint
```

#### Remove the Application

If you need to take down and delete a deployed application, you can use the `remove` method.

<Callout type="error" title="Warning">
  The remove operation is irreversible. It will completely remove the function service application and its related configuration. Proceed with caution.

**Code example:**

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# Call the remove method to delete the specified application
engine.remove(app_name="my-python-agent")
```

To prevent accidental operations, the terminal will ask you to confirm when executing this command. You need to enter `y` and press Enter to complete the deletion.

```shell
Confirm delete cloud app my-python-agent? (y/N): y
```

## Verify and Invoke the Application

After the application is successfully deployed, you can verify the deployment status through the Volcengine console and interact with your agent service using different protocols.

### Verify the Deployment in the Console

1. Log in to the [Volcengine Function Service (veFaaS) console](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas).
2. In the left navigation bar, select **My Applications**.
3. In the application list, you should see the application you just deployed. You can click the application name to enter the details page and view its configuration, logs, monitoring, access endpoint, and more.
![Deployment complete](/assets/images/deploy/deploy_agent.png)

### Invocation Methods

After deployment, the VeADK agent service supports invocation through two standard protocols: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Meta-protocol for Calling Plugins).

<Callout type="info" title="About API Gateway Authentication">
  By default, services created by VeADK through the API gateway enable the Key Authentication plugin to ensure interface security. This means all requests sent to the interface must include the correct authentication credentials (token).

  - **For production environments**: It is strongly recommended to keep this security setting and correctly pass the authentication credentials in your client code.
  - **For quick testing**: If you need to temporarily bypass authentication in an internal test environment, you can manually find the corresponding plugin in the **Plugin Center** of the [API Gateway console](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig) and **disable** it. Note, however, that this exposes your API endpoint to the public internet and poses a security risk.

#### 1. Obtain the Authentication Credential (Key Auth Token)

1. Log in to the [API Gateway console](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig).
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Consumer Management**.
3. Find the consumer associated with your application and copy its **Key Auth Token**.

#### 2. Invoke via the A2A Protocol

The A2A protocol is used for direct communication between agents. You can use the `CloudApp` or `RemoteVeAgent` class to make invocations.

**Method 1: Direct invocation (using `CloudApp`)**

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

# -- Configuration --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"  # Replace with your application's access endpoint
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"
TEST_MESSAGE = "北京今天的天气怎么样？"

async def main():
    # Initialize the CloudApp instance with the endpoint
    app = CloudApp(vefaas_endpoint=ENDPOINT)

    # Send the message
    response = await app.message_send(TEST_MESSAGE, SESSION_ID, USER_ID)
    print(f"A2A Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="warn">
  The direct invocation method of `CloudApp` above does not carry authentication information by default. If your API gateway has key authentication enabled, this invocation will fail. You need to use the next method, or temporarily disable the authentication plugin.

  ![Disable plugin](/assets/images/deploy/close_key_auth.png)

**Method 2: Remote invocation as a sub-agent (using `RemoteVeAgent`)**

This wraps the cloud agent as a `RemoteVeAgent` object and invokes it locally as a sub-agent of another agent, while conveniently handling authentication.

```python
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.a2a.remote_ve_agent import RemoteVeAgent

# -- Configuration --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"      # Replace with your application's access endpoint
KEY_AUTH_TOKEN = "<YOUR_KEY_AUTH_TOKEN>"  # Replace with your Key Auth Token
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"
TEST_MESSAGE = "上海呢？"

async def main():
    # 1. Wrap the cloud agent as a RemoteVeAgent
    remote_agent = RemoteVeAgent(
        name="cloud_weather_agent",
        url=ENDPOINT,
        auth_token=KEY_AUTH_TOKEN,
        auth_method="querystring"  # specify that the token is passed via the query string
    )

    # 2. Create a local agent and use the remote agent as its sub-agent
    local_agent = Agent(
        name="local_query_agent",
        instruction="Forward the user's question to the cloud agent and return the result.",
        sub_agents=[remote_agent],
    )

    # 3. Use the Runner to execute the task
    runner = Runner(agent=local_agent, user_id=USER_ID)
    response = await runner.run(TEST_MESSAGE, session_id=SESSION_ID)
    print(f"A2A Remote Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

#### 3. Invoke via the MCP Protocol

The MCP protocol provides a standardized way to discover and invoke plugins (i.e., your agent). You can use the `fastmcp` library to construct a client.

```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp import Client

# -- Configuration --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"      # Replace with your application's access endpoint
KEY_AUTH_TOKEN = "<YOUR_KEY_AUTH_TOKEN>"  # Replace with your Key Auth Token
SESSION_ID = "my_test_session_03"
USER_ID = "my_test_user_03"
TEST_MESSAGE = "广州今天天气如何？"

async def main():
    # Construct the MCP endpoint URL with the authentication token
    mcp_endpoint = f"{ENDPOINT}/mcp?token={KEY_AUTH_TOKEN}"

    # If gateway key authentication is disabled, the token parameter is not needed
    # mcp_endpoint = f"{ENDPOINT}/mcp"

    client = Client(mcp_endpoint)
    async with client:
        # Discover available tools (agents)
        tools = await client.list_tools()
        print(f"MCP Available Tools: {tools}")

        # Invoke the run_agent tool
        response = await client.call_tool(
            "run_agent",
            {
                "user_input": TEST_MESSAGE,
                "session_id": SESSION_ID,
                "user_id": USER_ID,
            },
        )
        print(f"MCP Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

## Continuous Delivery

To achieve a more efficient, automated development workflow, VeADK supports integration with Volcengine's [Continuous Delivery](https://console.volcengine.com/cp) (CP) and [Container Registry](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) (CR) services. By setting up a CI/CD pipeline, you can automate code commits, builds, tests, and deployments, automatically releasing new versions after code changes.

<Callout type="info" title="Best Practice">
  Deploying via container images is the best practice in production environments. It ensures consistency across development, testing, and production environments and simplifies the deployment process.

### 1. Prerequisite: Enable the Relevant Services

Before using the continuous delivery feature, make sure you have enabled the following services in the Volcengine console:

- [**Continuous Delivery (CP)**](https://console.volcengine.com/cp)
- [**Container Registry (CR)**](https://console.volcengine.com/cr)

Similar to the function service and API gateway, the first time you access Continuous Delivery and Container Registry you must complete the **IAM role authorization** as prompted: enter the corresponding service page, click **Authorize Now** (for Continuous Delivery, also click **Apply to Enable**), and after authorization the console redirects back to the service console, indicating success.

![Enable IAM role](/assets/images/deploy/cp_attach_role.png)

### 2. Attach the Continuous Delivery Pipeline

VeADK has built-in integration with Volcengine's [Continuous Delivery](https://console.volcengine.com/cp) product to make your deployment and continuous delivery more convenient. Combined with Volcengine's [Container Registry](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) product, it can continuously deliver your project to the Volcengine FaaS service via images.

Use the `veadk pipeline` command to connect your code repository with Volcengine's [Container Registry](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) and [Continuous Delivery](https://console.volcengine.com/cp) services. The main workflow of the command:

1. Helps you create an image function on VeFaaS containing a template image (Simple FastAPI)
2. Binds the [Continuous Delivery](https://console.volcengine.com/cp) service to your GitHub repository and the created VeFaaS function

Once configured, whenever you commit code to the specified GitHub repository branch, the pipeline is automatically triggered and performs the following operations:

1. **Build the image**: Builds a container image based on your project code.
2. **Push the image**: Pushes the built image to your private [Container Registry](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) (CR).
3. **Deploy the update**: Uses the new image to update the application in the function service (veFaaS), completing the release of the new version.

#### Usage

In your project directory, run the `veadk pipeline` command and provide the necessary parameters. A typical invocation is as follows:

```shell
veadk pipeline --github-url <YOUR_GITHUB_REPO_URL> --github-branch main --github-token <YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN>
```

<Callout type="warn">
  In the directory where you run this command, make sure the `config.yaml` file is ready. The configuration items in the file (such as API keys or other environment variables) will be packaged into the application when the image is built.

#### Parameter Details

| Parameter | Description | Default / Required |
|------|----|------------------------------|
| `--github-url` | GitHub repository URL | Required |
| `--github-branch` | The branch of the GitHub project | Required |
| `--veadk-version` | VeADK version. Options: `preview` (main branch), `latest` (latest stable), `x.x.x` (specific version) | Current version |
| `--github-token` | GitHub token, used to manage the project | Required |
| `--volcengine-access-key` | Volcengine Access Key | Uses the environment variable `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` |
| `--volcengine-secret-key` | Volcengine Secret Key | Uses the environment variable `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` |
| `--region` | Volcengine product region | cn-beijing |
| `--cr-instance-name` | Volcengine container registry instance name | `veadk-user-instance` |
| `--cr-namespace-name` | Volcengine container registry namespace | `veadk-user-namespace` |
| `--cr-repo-name` | Volcengine container registry repo name | veadk-user-repo |
| `--vefaas-function-id` | Volcengine FaaS function ID (must be an image function); if not set, a new function is created automatically | - |

---

# 1. 初始化云引擎，凭证将从环境变量自动获取

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/framework/vefaas.mdx

title: "部署到 VeFaaS"

本教程将介绍如何将您的 Agent 部署到火山引擎 VeFaaS 函数服务。

## 前置准备

在开始部署之前，请确保你已完成以下准备工作：

1. **创建火山引擎账号**：你首先需要一个有效的火山引擎账号。
2. **开通相关云服务**：为了成功部署和访问 VeADK 应用，你需要在火山引擎控制台中激活以下服务。这些通常是首次访问服务时根据引导完成的一次性操作。
   - [**函数服务 (veFaaS)**](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas)：用于托管和运行你的 Agent 应用代码。
   - [**API 网关 (API Gateway)**](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig)：用于创建和管理 API，使你的 Agent 应用能够从外部访问。

### 首次开通服务授权

如果你是首次使用上述服务，控制台会引导你完成必要的 IAM（Identity and Access Management）角色授权。两个服务的开通流程一致：

1. 首次进入 [函数服务](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas) 或 [API 网关](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig) 页面，控制台会提示你开通 IAM 角色，单击 **立即授权**。
2. 授权成功后，系统会自动跳转回对应服务的控制台主页，表明服务已开通。

![IAM 角色开通](/assets/images/deploy/vefaas_attach_role.png)

<Callout type="warn">
  此授权步骤是必需的，它授予函数服务和 API 网关访问其他云资源的权限，以确保应用能够正常部署和运行。

## 部署方式概览

VeADK 提供多种部署方式以适应不同的开发工作流：

- **通过命令行工具 (CLI) 部署**：最快捷的方式，适合快速创建、部署和迭代 Agent 应用。
- **通过 Python SDK 部署**：允许你通过编写代码以编程方式管理部署流程，适合集成到自动化脚本或现有项目中。
- **设置持续交付 (CI/CD)**：与代码仓库（如 GitHub）集成，实现代码提交后自动构建和部署，是团队协作和生产环境的最佳实践。

接下来，我们将详细介绍每种部署方式的操作步骤。

## 通过命令行工具 (CLI) 部署

您可以从以下两个方式来部署使用 VeADK 建设的 Agent 项目。各命令的完整参数见 [VeADK 命令行工具](/cn/docs/cli/veadk-cli)。

### 方式一：从零开始创建并部署新项目

如果你想快速启动一个标准的企业级 Agent 项目，`veadk init` 命令是最佳选择。它会为你生成一个预设了完整结构和配置的模板项目。

#### 1. 初始化项目

在你的终端中运行以下命令：

```shell
veadk init
```

该命令会引导你完成项目的基本配置。你需要根据提示输入以下信息：

```shell
$ veadk init
Welcome use VeADK to create your project. We will generate a `weather-reporter` application for you.
Local directory name [veadk-cloud-proj]:
Volcengine FaaS application name [veadk-cloud-agent]:
Volcengine API Gateway instance name []:
Volcengine API Gateway service name []:
Volcengine API Gateway upstream name []:
Choose a deploy mode:
  1. A2A/MCP Server
  2. VeADK Web / Google ADK Web
Enter your choice (1, 2): 1
Choose an authentication method:
  1. None
  2. API key
  3. OAuth2
Enter your choice (1, 2, 3): 1
Template project has been generated at .../veadk-cloud-proj
Edit .../veadk-cloud-proj/src to define your agents
Edit .../veadk-cloud-proj/deploy.py to define your deployment attributes
Run python `deploy.py` for deployment on Volcengine FaaS platform.
```

**参数说明**：

- **Local directory name**：项目在本地创建的目录名称。
- **Volcengine FaaS application name**：你的应用在火山引擎函数服务平台的名称。**注意**：名称中不能包含下划线 `_`。
- **Volcengine API Gateway ...**：API 网关相关的实例、服务和上游名称。这些为**可选**参数。如果留空，VeADK 会在部署时自动创建和关联相应的网关资源。
- **Choose a deploy mode**：选择部署模式。
  - `A2A/MCP Server`：标准的后端 Agent 服务模式。
  - `VeADK Web / Google ADK Web`：如果你需要一个 Web 交互界面，请选择此项。
- **Choose an authentication method**：选择网关鉴权方式。`None` 不鉴权；`API key` 使用密钥认证；`OAuth2` 使用 Agent Identity 单点登录（API key 仅在 A2A/MCP 模式下可选）。

项目初始化完成后，你可以在生成的 `deploy.py` 文件中随时修改这些配置。

生成后的项目结构如下：

<Files>
  <Folder name="veadk-cloud-proj" defaultOpen>
    <File name="__init__.py" />
    <File name="clean.py" />
    <File name="config.yaml.example" />
    <File name="deploy.py" />
    <Folder name="src" defaultOpen>
      <File name="__init__.py" />
      <File name="agent.py" />
      <File name="app.py" />
      <File name="requirements.txt" />
      <File name="run.sh" />
      <Folder name="weather_report" defaultOpen>
        <File name="__init__.py" />
        <File name="agent.py" />
      </Folder>
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

#### 2. 配置环境变量与凭证

部署前，你需要配置必要的环境变量，特别是访问火山引擎所需的身份凭证。

1. 在项目根目录下，将 `config.yaml.example` 文件复制一份并重命名为 `config.yaml`。
2. 编辑 `config.yaml` 文件，填入你的火山引擎访问密钥 (Access Key 和 Secret Key)。
3. 如果是新建的火山账号，还需确认是否已经授权给 `ServerlessApplicationRole` 角色。进入[创建应用页面](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas/region:vefaas+cn-beijing/application/create)点击[一键授权]即可。
![一键授权](/assets/images/deploy/add_permission.png)

```yaml
volcengine:
  access_key: "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY"    # 替换为你的火山引擎 Access Key
  secret_key: "YOUR_SECRET_KEY"  # 替换为你的火山引擎 Secret Key
```

<Callout type="warn" title="重要提示">
  `config.yaml` 文件包含了敏感的凭证信息，它不会被上传到云端。文件中的配置项会作为环境变量注入到函数服务的运行环境中。请务必确保此文件的安全，不要将其提交到公共代码仓库。

#### 3. 执行部署

完成配置后，在项目根目录下运行部署脚本：

```shell
python deploy.py
```

脚本执行后，如果看到 `Start to release VeFaaS application` 的提示，说明部署流程已开始。当终端输出以下类似信息时，代表你的 Agent 应用已成功部署并发布。

```shell
VeFaaS application ID: 3b015fxxxxxx
Test message: How is the weather like in Beijing?
```

### 方式二：部署现有项目

如果你已经有一个本地开发的 Agent 项目，可以使用 `veadk deploy` 命令将其快速部署到火山引擎函数服务平台。

#### 1. 项目准备

在执行部署前，请确保你的项目满足以下结构要求：

- 项目根目录下必须包含一个 `agent.py` 文件，且该文件中定义了一个全局变量 `root_agent`。
- 项目根目录下必须包含一个 `__init__.py` 文件，且该文件中包含了 `from . import agent` 语句。

#### 2. 执行部署

在你的项目根目录下运行以下命令：

```shell
veadk deploy --vefaas-app-name {YourAgentAppName}
```

请将 `{YourAgentAppName}` 替换为你的应用名称。执行后，如果看到 `Start to release VeFaaS application` 的提示，说明部署已开始。

`veadk deploy` 命令支持丰富的参数以进行详细配置，你可以通过命令行标志传入，或通过环境变量设置。

| 名称 | 类型 | 释义 |
|------|-------|---------------------------------|
| --access-key | 字符串 | 火山引擎 AK |
| --secret-key | 字符串 | 火山引擎 SK |
| --vefaas-app-name | 字符串 | 火山引擎 VeFaaS 平台应用名称 |
| --veapig-instance-name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关实例名称 |
| --veapig-service-name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关服务名称 |
| --veapig-upstream-name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关 Upstream 名称 |
| --short-term-memory-backend | 字符串 | `local` 或者 `mysql`，短期记忆后端 |
| --use-adk-web | FLAG | 设置后将会在云端启动 web，否则为 A2A / MCP 模式 |
| --path | 字符串 | 本地项目路径，默认为当前目录 |

## 通过 Python SDK 部署

对于希望将部署流程集成到自动化脚本或现有代码库中的开发者，VeADK 提供了强大的 Python SDK。你可以通过 `CloudAgentEngine` 类以编程方式完成应用的部署、更新和删除。

### 1. 部署 Agent 应用

`CloudAgentEngine` 是部署操作的核心。实例化该类后，调用其 `deploy` 方法即可部署你的 Agent 项目。

**凭证配置**：

在实例化 `CloudAgentEngine` 时，你可以直接传入火山引擎的 AK/SK。如果未提供，SDK 会自动从环境变量 `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` 和 `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` 中读取。

**代码示例**：

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

# 1. 初始化云引擎，凭证将从环境变量自动获取
engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# 2. 调用 deploy 方法部署应用
cloud_app = engine.deploy(
    application_name="my-python-agent",
    path="./path/to/your/agent/project",
    gateway_name="my-agent-gateway",
    use_adk_web=False
)

# 部署成功后，可以获取应用的访问端点
print(f"Application endpoint: {cloud_app.vefaas_endpoint}")
```

`deploy` 方法的关键参数如下：

| 名称 | 类型 | 释义 |
|------|------|------------------------------|
| path | 字符串 | 本地 Agent 项目路径 |
| application_name | 字符串 | 火山引擎 VeFaaS 平台应用名称 |
| gateway_name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关实例名称 |
| gateway_service_name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关服务名称 |
| gateway_upstream_name | 字符串 | 火山引擎网关 Upstream 名称 |
| use_adk_web | 布尔值 | 是否在云端使用 VeADK Web / Google Web |

### 2. 管理已部署的应用

`deploy` 方法成功执行后，会返回一个 `CloudApp` 实例。这个实例代表了你在云端部署的应用，你可以使用它来进行后续的管理操作，如发起调用、更新代码或删除应用。

#### 发起远程调用

你可以通过 `CloudApp` 实例的异步方法 `message_send` 与云端 Agent 交互。它的签名为 `message_send(message, session_id, user_id, timeout=600.0)`，返回 Agent 的响应消息。

**代码示例**：

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

# 通过部署时返回的应用名称构造 CloudApp（也可传入 vefaas_endpoint 或 vefaas_application_id）
cloud_app = CloudApp(vefaas_application_name="my-python-agent")

SESSION_ID = "test_session_123"
USER_ID = "test_user_001"

async def main():
    response = await cloud_app.message_send(
        "请问北京今天天气怎么样？", SESSION_ID, USER_ID
    )
    print(f"Agent response: {response}")

asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="info">
  初始化 `CloudApp` 时必须至少提供 `vefaas_endpoint`、`vefaas_application_id`、`vefaas_application_name` 中的一个，否则会抛出 `ValueError`。

如果你需要与一个已经部署好的应用进行交互（而非在部署后立即交互），可以通过应用的访问端点（Endpoint）来创建 `CloudApp` 实例。端点可在函数服务控制台找到：

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

APP_ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"

app = CloudApp(vefaas_endpoint=APP_ENDPOINT)

# 调用方式相同：message, session_id, user_id
response = asyncio.run(app.message_send("深圳呢？", SESSION_ID, USER_ID))
print(f"Agent response: {response}")
```

#### 更新应用代码

当你本地的 Agent 代码有更新时，可以使用 `update_function_code` 方法来更新已部署的应用，而无需重新创建一个新应用。

<Callout type="warn">
  此操作只会更新函数的代码和配置，应用原有的访问端点 (Endpoint) 会保持不变。

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# 更新现有应用的代码，保持相同的访问端点
updated_cloud_app = engine.update_function_code(
    application_name="my-agent-app",  # 现有应用名称
    path="/my-agent-project"        # 本地项目路径，确保项目路径包含agent.py文件
)

# 可以使用updated_cloud_app.vefaas_endpoint访问您的项目
```

#### 删除应用

如果你需要下线并删除一个已部署的应用，可以使用 `remove` 方法。

<Callout type="error" title="警告">
  删除操作是不可逆的，它将彻底移除函数服务应用及其相关配置。请谨慎操作。

**代码示例**：

```python
from veadk.cloud.cloud_agent_engine import CloudAgentEngine

engine = CloudAgentEngine()

# 调用 remove 方法删除指定应用
engine.remove(app_name="my-python-agent")
```

为了防止误操作，执行此命令时，终端会要求你进行确认。你需要输入 `y` 并按回车键才能完成删除。

```shell
Confirm delete cloud app my-python-agent? (y/N): y
```

## 验证与调用应用

应用部署成功后，你可以通过火山引擎控制台验证部署状态，并使用不同协议与你的 Agent 服务进行交互。

### 在控制台验证部署

1. 登录 [火山引擎函数服务 (veFaaS) 控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/vefaas)。
2. 在左侧导航栏中，选择 **我的应用**。
3. 在应用列表中，你应该能看到你刚刚部署的应用。你可以单击应用名称进入详情页，查看其配置、日志、监控和访问端点等信息。
![部署完成](/assets/images/deploy/deploy_agent.png)

### 调用方法

部署完成后，VeADK Agent 服务支持通过两种标准协议进行调用：A2A (Agent-to-Agent) 和 MCP (Meta-protocol for Calling Plugins)。

<Callout type="info" title="关于 API 网关认证">
  默认情况下，VeADK 通过 API 网关创建的服务会启用密钥认证 (Key Authentication) 插件，以确保接口的安全性。这意味着所有发向该接口的请求都需要在请求中包含正确的认证凭证 (Token)。

  - **对于生产环境**：强烈建议保留此安全设置，并在你的客户端代码中正确传递认证凭证。
  - **对于快速测试**：如果你在内部测试环境中需要临时绕过认证，可以手动在 [API 网关控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig) 的 **插件中心** 找到对应的插件并将其**禁用**。但请注意，这会使你的 API 端点暴露于公网，带来安全风险。

#### 1. 获取认证凭证 (Key Auth Token)

1. 登录 [API 网关控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/veapig)。
2. 在左侧导航栏中，选择 **消费者管理**。
3. 找到与你的应用关联的消费者，并复制其 **Key Auth Token**。

#### 2. 通过 A2A 协议调用

A2A 协议用于 Agent 之间的直接通信。你可以使用 `CloudApp` 或 `RemoteVeAgent` 类来发起调用。

**方式一：直接调用 (使用 `CloudApp`)**

```python
import asyncio
from veadk.cloud.cloud_app import CloudApp

# -- 配置 --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"  # 替换为你的应用访问端点
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"
TEST_MESSAGE = "北京今天的天气怎么样？"

async def main():
    # 使用端点初始化 CloudApp 实例
    app = CloudApp(vefaas_endpoint=ENDPOINT)

    # 发送消息
    response = await app.message_send(TEST_MESSAGE, SESSION_ID, USER_ID)
    print(f"A2A Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

<Callout type="warn">
  上述 `CloudApp` 的直接调用方式默认不会携带认证信息。如果你的 API 网关开启了密钥认证，此调用会失败。你需要使用下一种方式，或临时关闭认证插件。

  ![关闭插件](/assets/images/deploy/close_key_auth.png)

**方式二：作为子 Agent 远程调用 (使用 `RemoteVeAgent`)**

它将云端的 Agent 封装为一个 `RemoteVeAgent` 对象，并在本地作为另一个 Agent 的子 Agent 来调用，同时可以方便地处理认证。

```python
import asyncio
from veadk import Agent, Runner
from veadk.a2a.remote_ve_agent import RemoteVeAgent

# -- 配置 --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"      # 替换为你的应用访问端点
KEY_AUTH_TOKEN = "<YOUR_KEY_AUTH_TOKEN>"  # 替换为你的 Key Auth Token
SESSION_ID = "test_session"
USER_ID = "test_user"
TEST_MESSAGE = "上海呢？"

async def main():
    # 1. 将云端 Agent 封装为 RemoteVeAgent
    remote_agent = RemoteVeAgent(
        name="cloud_weather_agent",
        url=ENDPOINT,
        auth_token=KEY_AUTH_TOKEN,
        auth_method="querystring"  # 指定 token 通过查询字符串传递
    )

    # 2. 创建一个本地 Agent，并将远程 Agent 作为其子 Agent
    local_agent = Agent(
        name="local_query_agent",
        instruction="将用户问题转发给云端 Agent 并返回结果。",
        sub_agents=[remote_agent],
    )

    # 3. 使用 Runner 执行任务
    runner = Runner(agent=local_agent, user_id=USER_ID)
    response = await runner.run(TEST_MESSAGE, session_id=SESSION_ID)
    print(f"A2A Remote Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

#### 3. 通过 MCP 协议调用

MCP 协议提供了一种标准化的方式来发现和调用插件（即你的 Agent）。你可以使用 `fastmcp` 库来构造客户端。

```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp import Client

# -- 配置 --
ENDPOINT = "<YOUR_APPLICATION_ENDPOINT>"      # 替换为你的应用访问端点
KEY_AUTH_TOKEN = "<YOUR_KEY_AUTH_TOKEN>"  # 替换为你的 Key Auth Token
SESSION_ID = "my_test_session_03"
USER_ID = "my_test_user_03"
TEST_MESSAGE = "广州今天天气如何？"

async def main():
    # 构造带有认证 token 的 MCP 端点 URL
    mcp_endpoint = f"{ENDPOINT}/mcp?token={KEY_AUTH_TOKEN}"

    # 如果关闭了网关的密钥认证，则无需 token 参数
    # mcp_endpoint = f"{ENDPOINT}/mcp"

    client = Client(mcp_endpoint)
    async with client:
        # 发现可用的工具 (Agent)
        tools = await client.list_tools()
        print(f"MCP Available Tools: {tools}")

        # 调用 run_agent 工具
        response = await client.call_tool(
            "run_agent",
            {
                "user_input": TEST_MESSAGE,
                "session_id": SESSION_ID,
                "user_id": USER_ID,
            },
        )
        print(f"MCP Response: {response}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

## 持续交付

为了实现更高效、自动化的开发工作流，VeADK 支持与火山引擎的[持续交付](https://console.volcengine.com/cp) (Continuous Delivery, CP) 和[镜像仓库](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) (Container Registry, CR) 服务集成。通过设置 CI/CD 流水线，你可以将代码提交、构建、测试和部署等环节自动化，实现代码变更后自动发布新版本。

<Callout type="info" title="最佳实践">
  通过容器镜像进行部署是生产环境中的最佳实践，它能确保开发、测试和生产环境的一致性，并简化部署流程。

### 1. 前提条件：开通相关服务

在使用持续交付功能前，请确保你已在火山引擎控制台开通以下服务：

- [**持续交付 (CP)**](https://console.volcengine.com/cp)
- [**镜像仓库 (CR)**](https://console.volcengine.com/cr)

与函数服务和 API 网关类似，首次访问持续交付与镜像仓库时，你需要按页面提示完成 **IAM 角色授权**：进入对应服务页面，单击 **立即授权**（持续交付还需单击 **申请开通**），授权完成后系统自动跳转回服务控制台，即表示开通成功。

![IAM 角色开通](/assets/images/deploy/cp_attach_role.png)

### 2. 挂载持续交付流水线

VeADK 内置了火山引擎[持续交付](https://console.volcengine.com/cp)产品来便捷您的部署与持续交付。结合火山引擎[镜像仓库](https://console.volcengine.com/cr)产品，能够通过镜像将您的项目持续交付到火山引擎 FaaS 服务。

使用命令 `veadk pipeline` 来连结您的代码仓库与火山引擎[镜像仓库](https://console.volcengine.com/cr)、[持续交付](https://console.volcengine.com/cp)服务。命令的主要工作流程：

1. 帮助您在 VeFaaS 上创建一个含有模板镜像（Simple FastAPI）的镜像函数
2. 将[持续交付](https://console.volcengine.com/cp)服务绑定至您的 Github 仓库与创建好的 VeFaaS 函数

配置完成后，每当你向指定的 GitHub 仓库分支提交代码时，流水线将被自动触发，并执行以下操作：

1. **构建镜像**：基于你的项目代码构建一个容器镜像。
2. **推送镜像**：将构建好的镜像推送到你的私有[镜像仓库](https://console.volcengine.com/cr) (CR) 中。
3. **部署更新**：使用新镜像更新函数服务 (veFaaS) 中的应用，完成新版本的发布。

#### 使用方法

在你的项目目录下，运行 `veadk pipeline` 命令并提供必要的参数。一个典型的调用如下：

```shell
veadk pipeline --github-url <YOUR_GITHUB_REPO_URL> --github-branch main --github-token <YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN>
```

<Callout type="warn">
  在运行此命令的目录中，请确保已准备好 `config.yaml` 文件。文件中的配置项（如 API Keys 或其他环境变量）将在构建镜像时被打包到应用中。

#### 参数详解

| 参数 | 说明 | 默认值 / 必填 |
|------|----|------------------------------|
| `--github-url` | Github 仓库 URL | 必填 |
| `--github-branch` | Github 项目的分支 | 必填 |
| `--veadk-version` | VeADK 版本，可选值：`preview`（主分支）、`latest`（最新稳定版）、`x.x.x`（具体版本号）| 当前版本号 |
| `--github-token` | Github Token，用于管理项目 | 必填 |
| `--volcengine-access-key` | 火山引擎 Access Key | 使用环境变量 `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` |
| `--volcengine-secret-key` | 火山引擎 Secret Key | 使用环境变量 `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` |
| `--region` | 火山引擎产品区域 | cn-beijing |
| `--cr-instance-name` | 火山引擎容器镜像仓库实例名 | `veadk-user-instance` |
| `--cr-namespace-name` | 火山引擎容器镜像仓库命名空间 | `veadk-user-namespace` |
| `--cr-repo-name` | 火山引擎容器镜像仓库 Repo 名称 | veadk-user-repo |
| `--vefaas-function-id` | 火山引擎 FaaS 函数 ID（要求为镜像函数），如未设置，将自动创建新函数 | - |

---

# the returned JSON includes an `id` field — that's the sessionId

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/api-server.en.mdx

title: "API server"

In **API Server** mode, your agent exposes a standard set of HTTP endpoints for managing sessions and running the agent (with streaming). Start it locally with `veadk web`; in production, [deploy in VeADK Web mode](/en/docs/framework/vefaas) (same endpoints, with auth handled by the API Gateway).

```bash
veadk web              # local, defaults to http://localhost:8000
```

<Callout type="info">
  The endpoints are unauthenticated by default — for local development only. Add [SSO / inbound auth](/en/docs/framework/inbound) before exposing them.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `GET` | `/list-apps` | List available agent apps |
| `POST` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions` | Create a session (auto ID) |
| `POST` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | Create a session with a given ID |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions` | List sessions |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | Get a session (with its events) |
| `DELETE` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | Delete a session |
| `POST` | `/run` | Run the agent; returns the full event list |
| `POST` | `/run_sse` | Run the agent; stream events as SSE |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}/artifacts` | List artifacts |
| `GET` | `/health`, `/version` | Health check and version |

> `{app}` is the agent app name (the subdirectory name under `--agents-dir`).

## Run an agent

Create a session first, then run. `/run_sse` streams events as [SSE](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events) for real-time UIs; `/run` returns all events at once.

<Steps>

<Step>
### Create a session

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/apps/my_agent/users/u1/sessions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'
# the returned JSON includes an `id` field — that's the sessionId
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Run and stream

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/run_sse \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "appName": "my_agent",
    "userId": "u1",
    "sessionId": "<id from the previous step>",
    "newMessage": { "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "Hello" }] },
    "streaming": true
  }'
```

The response is a stream of SSE events; each `data:` is one agent event (model delta, tool call, final reply, …):

```text
data: {"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"He"}]}, ...}
data: {"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"llo"}]}, ...}
```
</Step>

</Steps>

Request body fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `appName` | string | Agent app name |
| `userId` | string | User ID |
| `sessionId` | string | Session ID |
| `newMessage` | Content | The user message: `{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] }` |
| `streaming` | bool | Stream model deltas (default `false`) |

<Callout type="info">
  In production, prefer calling a deployed agent over A2A with [`CloudApp`](/en/docs/framework/vefaas) instead of hand-writing these HTTP requests.

---

# 返回的 JSON 中包含 id 字段，即 sessionId

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/api-server.mdx

title: "API 服务接口"

以 **API Server** 模式运行时，智能体对外暴露一组标准 HTTP 接口，用于管理会话并运行智能体（支持流式）。本地用 `veadk web` 启动，生产环境通过 [VeADK Web 模式部署](/cn/docs/framework/vefaas)（接口相同，由 API 网关统一鉴权）。

```bash
veadk web              # 本地启动，默认 http://localhost:8000
```

<Callout type="info">
  接口默认无鉴权，仅用于本地开发。对外暴露时请加 [SSO / 入站认证](/cn/docs/framework/inbound)。

## 接口一览

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `GET` | `/list-apps` | 列出可用的智能体应用 |
| `POST` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions` | 新建会话（自动生成 ID） |
| `POST` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | 以指定 ID 新建会话 |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions` | 列出会话 |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | 获取会话（含历史事件） |
| `DELETE` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}` | 删除会话 |
| `POST` | `/run` | 运行智能体，一次性返回事件列表 |
| `POST` | `/run_sse` | 运行智能体，以 SSE 流式返回事件 |
| `GET` | `/apps/{app}/users/{user}/sessions/{session}/artifacts` | 列出产物（artifacts） |
| `GET` | `/health`、`/version` | 健康检查与版本 |

> `{app}` 为智能体应用名（即 `--agents-dir` 下的子目录名）。

## 运行智能体

先创建会话，再运行。`/run_sse` 以 [SSE](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events) 流式返回事件，适合实时展示；`/run` 一次性返回全部事件。

<Steps>

<Step>
### 创建会话

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/apps/my_agent/users/u1/sessions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'
# 返回的 JSON 中包含 id 字段，即 sessionId
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 运行并流式接收

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/run_sse \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "appName": "my_agent",
    "userId": "u1",
    "sessionId": "<上一步返回的 id>",
    "newMessage": { "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "你好" }] },
    "streaming": true
  }'
```

响应是一串 SSE 事件，每个 `data:` 是一个智能体事件（模型增量、工具调用、最终回复等）：

```text
data: {"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"你"}]}, ...}
data: {"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"好"}]}, ...}
```
</Step>

</Steps>

请求体字段：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `appName` | string | 智能体应用名 |
| `userId` | string | 用户 ID |
| `sessionId` | string | 会话 ID |
| `newMessage` | Content | 本轮用户消息：`{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] }` |
| `streaming` | bool | 是否在模型层开启增量流式（默认 `false`） |

<Callout type="info">
  生产环境推荐用 [`CloudApp`](/cn/docs/framework/vefaas) 通过 A2A 协议调用已部署的智能体，无需手写上述 HTTP 请求。

---

# api.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/api.en.mdx

title: "Module index"

VeADK does not publish an auto-generated API reference site. This page is a quick map of the main `veadk.*` packages, so you can find which module holds a capability and which guide covers it. For per-symbol signatures and docstrings, browse the [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/veadk-python/) or the [source on GitHub](https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/tree/main/veadk).

## Top-level entry points

The two most common objects are importable directly from `veadk`:

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
```

| Object | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `Agent` | The core agent class — wraps the model, tools, memory, and knowledge base. See [Create an Agent](/en/docs/framework/agent). |
| `Runner` | The execution engine that runs an agent and manages sessions. See [Runner](/en/docs/framework/runner). |

## Module index

| Module | Responsibility | Related guide |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `veadk.agent` | The single-agent `Agent` definition. | [Create an Agent](/en/docs/framework/agent) |
| `veadk.agents` | Multi-agent orchestration (sequential, parallel, loop). | [Multi-agent](/en/docs/framework/multi-agent/overview) |
| `veadk.runner` | The `Runner` execution engine. | [Runner](/en/docs/framework/runner) |
| `veadk.tools` | Built-in tools, custom function tools, and MCP tools. | [Built-in tools](/en/docs/framework/tools/builtin) |
| `veadk.memory` | Short-term and long-term memory backends. | [Short-term memory](/en/docs/framework/memory/short-term) |
| `veadk.knowledgebase` | Knowledge base (RAG) integration and retrieval. | [Knowledge base](/en/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview) |
| `veadk.a2a` | Agent-to-Agent protocol and remote agents. | [A2A](/en/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a) |
| `veadk.a2ui` | A2UI (agent-driven UI) catalog and toolset. | [A2UI](/en/docs/framework/a2ui) |
| `veadk.auth` | Inbound / outbound authentication and permission policy. | [Security](/en/docs/framework/security) |
| `veadk.tracing` | Tracing and instrumentation (APMPlus, CozeLoop, TLS). | [Observability](/en/docs/framework/observability) |
| `veadk.evaluation` | Evaluation and optimization. | [Evaluation](/en/docs/framework/evaluation) |
| `veadk.cli` | Command-line tools. | [CLI](/en/docs/cli/veadk-cli) |
| `veadk.config` | Configuration system (env vars and `config.yaml`). | [Configuration](/en/docs/references/configuration) |

<Callout type="info">
  This is a navigation map, not a complete symbol listing. Treat the source as the authority for the actual classes, functions, and parameters in each module.

# api.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/api.mdx

title: "模块索引"

VeADK 没有自动生成的 API 参考站点。本页把 `veadk.*` 的主要包整理成一张速查地图，帮你快速定位某个能力在哪个模块、对应哪篇指南。需要逐个符号的签名与 docstring 时，请直接看 [PyPI 包](https://pypi.org/project/veadk-python/)或 [GitHub 源码](https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/tree/main/veadk)。

## 顶层入口

最常用的两个对象可直接从 `veadk` 导入：

```python
from veadk import Agent, Runner
```

| 对象 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- |
| `Agent` | 智能体核心类，封装模型、工具、记忆、知识库等能力。参见[构建智能体](/cn/docs/framework/agent)。 |
| `Runner` | 执行引擎，负责运行智能体并管理会话。参见[执行引擎](/cn/docs/framework/runner)。 |

## 模块索引

| 模块 | 职责 | 相关指南 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |

| `veadk.runner` | `Runner` 执行引擎。 | [执行引擎](/cn/docs/framework/runner) |
| `veadk.tools` | 内置工具、自定义函数工具与 MCP 工具。 | [内置工具](/cn/docs/framework/tools/builtin) |
| `veadk.memory` | 短期记忆与长期记忆后端。 | [短期记忆](/cn/docs/framework/memory/short-term) |
| `veadk.knowledgebase` | 知识库（RAG）接入与检索。 | [知识库](/cn/docs/framework/knowledgebase/overview) |
| `veadk.a2a` | Agent-to-Agent 协议与远程智能体。 | [A2A](/cn/docs/framework/multi-agent/a2a) |
| `veadk.a2ui` | A2UI（智能体驱动 UI）目录与工具集。 | [A2UI](/cn/docs/framework/a2ui) |
| `veadk.auth` | 入站 / 出站认证与权限策略。 | [安全](/cn/docs/framework/security) |

<Callout type="info">
  这是一张面向导航的地图，不是完整的符号清单。每个模块的实际类、函数与参数请以源码为准。

# constants.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/constants.en.mdx

title: "Built-in defaults"

VeADK ships sensible defaults for common settings. When a value is specified neither in code nor in environment variables, the default applies — defaults are the fallback, environment variables are the override.

The tables below list the main defaults by purpose. They are tuned for the Volcengine Ark platform and work out of the box; override any of them via [environment variables](/en/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables).

## Agent and model

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Agent name | `veAgent` | Default name for an unnamed agent |
| Inference model | `doubao-seed-1-8-251228` | Default inference model |
| Model provider | `openai` | Ark is OpenAI-compatible, so `openai` by default |
| Model API base | `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/` | Ark API base URL |

## Multimodal generation

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Image model | `doubao-seedream-5-0-260128` | Default Ark model for image generation |
| Video model | `doubao-seedance-2-0-260128` | Default Ark model for video generation |
| Generation API base | `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/` | API base for the models above |

## Observability reporting

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| APMPlus endpoint | `http://apmplus-cn-beijing.volces.com:4317` | Trace export endpoint |
| APMPlus service name | `veadk_tracing` | Default service name |
| CozeLoop endpoint | `https://api.coze.cn/v1/loop/opentelemetry/v1/traces` | Trace report endpoint |
| CozeLoop space name | `VeADK Space` | Default space name |
| TLS endpoint | `https://tls-cn-beijing.volces.com:4318/v1/traces` | Trace report endpoint |
| TLS region | `cn-beijing` | Default region |
| Log project name | `veadk-logs` | TLS log project name |
| Tracing instance name | `veadk-tracing` | TLS tracing instance name |

## Deployment

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Object storage bucket | `veadk-default-bucket` | Default TOS bucket name |
| Image repo instance | `veadk-user-instance` | Container registry instance name |
| Image repo namespace | `veadk-user-namespace` | Container registry namespace |
| Image repo name | `veadk-user-repo` | Container registry repository name |

<Callout type="warn">
Object storage bucket names are globally unique. Set a dedicated bucket name to avoid conflicts with other users that would cause failures.

---

# constants.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/constants.mdx

title: "内置默认值"

VeADK 为常用配置预置了合理的默认值。某一项在代码与环境变量中均未指定时，采用这些缺省值——默认值是兜底，环境变量是覆盖。

下表按用途列出主要默认项。这些值面向火山引擎方舟平台优化，开箱即用；如需替换，按[环境变量](/cn/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables)覆盖。

## 智能体与模型

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| 智能体名称 | `veAgent` | 未命名时智能体的缺省名称 |
| 推理模型 | `doubao-seed-1-8-251228` | 默认的推理模型 |
| 模型提供商 | `openai` | 方舟兼容 OpenAI 规范，故默认按 `openai` 接入 |
| 模型访问地址 | `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/` | 方舟平台 API 基础地址 |

## 多模态生成

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| 生图模型 | `doubao-seedream-5-0-260128` | 图像生成工具默认使用的方舟模型 |
| 视频生成模型 | `doubao-seedance-2-0-260128` | 视频生成工具默认使用的方舟模型 |
| 生成模型访问地址 | `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/` | 上述模型的 API 基础地址 |

## 可观测上报

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| APMPlus 上报地址 | `http://apmplus-cn-beijing.volces.com:4317` | 链路追踪导出地址 |
| APMPlus 服务名 | `veadk_tracing` | 默认服务名 |
| CozeLoop 上报地址 | `https://api.coze.cn/v1/loop/opentelemetry/v1/traces` | 链路追踪上报地址 |
| CozeLoop 空间名 | `VeADK Space` | 默认空间名称 |
| TLS 上报地址 | `https://tls-cn-beijing.volces.com:4318/v1/traces` | 链路追踪上报地址 |
| TLS 区域 | `cn-beijing` | 默认区域 |
| 日志项目名 | `veadk-logs` | TLS 日志项目名称 |
| 追踪实例名 | `veadk-tracing` | TLS Tracing 实例名称 |

## 部署相关

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| 对象存储桶名 | `veadk-default-bucket` | 默认 TOS 桶名 |
| 镜像仓库实例 | `veadk-user-instance` | 容器镜像仓库实例名 |
| 镜像仓库命名空间 | `veadk-user-namespace` | 容器镜像仓库命名空间 |
| 镜像仓库名称 | `veadk-user-repo` | 容器镜像仓库名称 |

<Callout type="warn">
对象存储桶名全球唯一，强烈建议自定义一个专属桶名，避免与其他用户冲突导致运行失败。

# environment-variables.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables.en.mdx

title: "Environment variables"

Environment variables are the primary configuration method, supplying secrets, connection details, and service addresses. Names are grouped by domain prefix: Volcengine account, models, built-in tools, databases, and observability. Every variable can also be expressed as the equivalent nested structure in `config.yaml`.

<Callout type="info">
Supply secrets through environment variables or `config.yaml`. The tables below list common variables by domain; configure only those for the capabilities actually used.

## Volcengine account

Prefix `VOLCENGINE_`, for accessing Volcengine cloud services.

| Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- |
| `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` | Volcengine Access Key |
| `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | Volcengine Secret Key |

```yaml title="config.yaml"
volcengine:
  access_key:
  secret_key:
```

## Models

Prefix `MODEL_`, split into inference, embedding, and judge models.

| Group | Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Inference | `MODEL_AGENT_NAME` | Model name |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_PROVIDER` | LiteLLM-compatible provider |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE` | API base URL |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` | API key |
| Embedding | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_NAME` | Embedding model name |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM` | Embedding dimension |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_BASE` | API base URL |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | API key |
| Judge | `MODEL_JUDGE_NAME` | Model name |
| | `MODEL_JUDGE_API_BASE` | API base URL |
| | `MODEL_JUDGE_API_KEY` | API key |

## Built-in tools

Prefix `TOOL_`, configured only when the corresponding tool is used.

| Group | Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| VeSearch | `TOOL_VESEARCH_ENDPOINT` | Volcengine search bot ID |
| | `TOOL_VESEARCH_API_KEY` | Volcengine search service key |
| WebScraper | `TOOL_WEB_SCRAPER_ENDPOINT` | WebScraper endpoint |
| | `TOOL_WEB_SCRAPER_API_KEY` | WebScraper key |
| Lark | `TOOL_LARK_ENDPOINT` | Lark app ID |
| | `TOOL_LARK_API_KEY` | Lark app secret |
| | `TOOL_LARK_TOKEN` | Lark user token |
| Feishu Channel | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_APP_ID` | Feishu bot app ID |
| | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_APP_SECRET` | Feishu bot app secret |
| | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_TRANSPORT` | Transport mode, default `ws` |
| LAS | `TOOL_LAS_URL` | LAS SSE service URL (with token) |
| | `TOOL_LAS_DATASET_ID` | LAS dataset ID |
| VOD | `TOOL_VOD_GROUPS` | Video editing capability groups |
| | `TOOL_VOD_TIMEOUT` | Connection timeout |

## Harness Extension

Prefix `HARNESS_`, used to attach optional Harness plugins to HarnessApp Runtime or `Runner`. The Harness Extension is bundled with VeADK; install the `veadk-python[harness]` extra only when you want the optional `headroom` compaction provider.

| Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- |
| `HARNESS_ENHANCE_ENABLED` | Enable Harness plugins; accepts `true` / `false`. |
| `HARNESS_ENHANCE_COMPONENTS` | Enabled components, comma-separated; common value: `invocation_context,compactor,response_verification`. |
| `HARNESS_PROFILE` | Plugin runtime profile for policy selection; default `default`. |
| `HARNESS_COMPRESSION_PROVIDER` | Tool-result compaction provider, default `builtin`; optional `headroom`. |
| `HARNESS_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS` | Context compaction threshold, default `24000`. |
| `HARNESS_MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS` | Single tool-result compaction threshold, default `4000`. |
| `HARNESS_VERIFIER_MODE` | Final-response verification mode, `observe` or `block`; default `observe`. |
| `HARNESS_STORE_PATH` | Optional JSONL event store path; in-memory store is used when unset. |

The `harness_enhance` block maps to these environment variables when deploying a HarnessApp Runtime. Prefer `harness.yaml` or `veadk agentkit invoke` flags for normal developer workflows; use environment variables for platform integration and container runtimes.

## Databases

Prefix `DATABASE_`, grouped by storage type. Memory and the knowledge base read the matching config based on the selected backend.

| Group | Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| OpenSearch | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_HOST` | Host (without scheme) |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PORT` | Port, default 9200 |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USERNAME` | Username |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD` | Password |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_CERT_PATH` | Cert path (recommended in production) |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USE_SSL` | Enable SSL, default True |
| MySQL | `DATABASE_MYSQL_HOST` | Host |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_USER` | Username |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_PASSWORD` | Password |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_DATABASE` | Database name |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_CHARSET` | Charset, default utf8 |
| Redis | `DATABASE_REDIS_HOST` | Host |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_PORT` | Port, default 6379 |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_PASSWORD` | Password |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_DB` | Database number, default 0 |
| VikingDB | `DATABASE_VIKING_PROJECT` | Project name |
| | `DATABASE_VIKING_REGION` | Region |
| TOS | `DATABASE_TOS_ENDPOINT` | Endpoint |
| | `DATABASE_TOS_REGION` | Region |
| | `DATABASE_TOS_BUCKET` | Bucket name |

## Observability

Prefix `OBSERVABILITY_`, configuring where traces and metrics are reported.

| Group | Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- | :- |
| APMPlus | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_ENDPOINT` | Report endpoint |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_API_KEY` | Auth key |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_SERVICE_NAME` | Service name |
| CozeLoop | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_ENDPOINT` | Report endpoint |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_API_KEY` | Auth key |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_SERVICE_NAME` | Space ID |
| TLS | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_ENDPOINT` | Report endpoint |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_SERVICE_NAME` | topic_id |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_REGION` | Region |
| Prometheus | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_PUSHGATEWAY_URL` | Pushgateway URL |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_USERNAME` | Username |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_PASSWORD` | Password |

## Others

| Variable | Meaning |
| :- | :- |
| `PROMPT_PILOT_API_KEY` | Prompt Pilot product key |
| `VEIDENTITY_REGION` | Identity service region, default cn-beijing |
| `VEIDENTITY_ENDPOINT` | Identity service endpoint (optional, auto-generated if omitted) |

```yaml title="config.yaml"
veidentity:
  region: cn-beijing
  endpoint:  # optional, auto-generated if omitted
```

# environment-variables.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables.mdx

title: "环境变量"

环境变量是最主要的配置方式，提供密钥、连接信息与服务地址。变量名按领域前缀分组：火山引擎账号、模型、内置工具、数据库、可观测各成一类。每个环境变量都能在 `config.yaml` 中以对应层级结构表达，两者等价。

<Callout type="info">
密钥统一通过环境变量或 `config.yaml` 提供。下表按领域列出常用变量，仅需配置实际用到的能力对应项。

## 火山引擎账号

统一前缀 `VOLCENGINE_`，用于访问火山引擎各类云服务。

| 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- |
| `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY` | 火山引擎 Access Key |
| `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | 火山引擎 Secret Key |

```yaml title="config.yaml"
volcengine:
  access_key:
  secret_key:
```

## 模型

统一前缀 `MODEL_`，区分推理、向量化（embedding）、评测三类模型。

| 子类 | 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| 推理模型 | `MODEL_AGENT_NAME` | 模型名称 |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_PROVIDER` | 符合 LiteLLM 规范的模型提供商 |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_API_BASE` | 访问地址 |
| | `MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY` | 访问密钥 |
| 向量化模型 | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_NAME` | Embedding 模型名称 |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_DIM` | Embedding 维度 |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_BASE` | 访问地址 |
| | `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | 访问密钥 |
| 评测模型 | `MODEL_JUDGE_NAME` | 模型名称 |
| | `MODEL_JUDGE_API_BASE` | 访问地址 |
| | `MODEL_JUDGE_API_KEY` | 访问密钥 |

## 内置工具

统一前缀 `TOOL_`，仅在使用对应工具时配置。

| 子类 | 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| VeSearch | `TOOL_VESEARCH_ENDPOINT` | 火山引擎搜索机器人 ID |
| | `TOOL_VESEARCH_API_KEY` | 火山引擎搜索服务密钥 |
| WebScraper | `TOOL_WEB_SCRAPER_ENDPOINT` | WebScraper 端点 |
| | `TOOL_WEB_SCRAPER_API_KEY` | WebScraper 密钥 |
| Lark | `TOOL_LARK_ENDPOINT` | Lark 应用 ID |
| | `TOOL_LARK_API_KEY` | Lark 应用密钥 |
| | `TOOL_LARK_TOKEN` | Lark 用户 token |
| Feishu Channel | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_APP_ID` | 飞书机器人应用 ID |
| | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_APP_SECRET` | 飞书机器人应用密钥 |
| | `TOOL_FEISHU_CHANNEL_TRANSPORT` | 传输模式，默认 `ws` |
| LAS | `TOOL_LAS_URL` | LAS SSE 服务地址（含 token） |
| | `TOOL_LAS_DATASET_ID` | LAS 数据集 ID |
| VOD | `TOOL_VOD_GROUPS` | 视频编辑能力组 |
| | `TOOL_VOD_TIMEOUT` | 连接超时时长 |

## Harness Extension

统一前缀 `HARNESS_`，用于给 HarnessApp Runtime 或 `Runner` 挂载可选的 Harness 插件能力。Harness Extension 随 VeADK 安装；只有当选择 `headroom` 压缩 provider 时，才需要安装 `veadk-python[harness]` 额外依赖。

| 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- |
| `HARNESS_ENHANCE_ENABLED` | 是否启用 Harness 插件，支持 `true` / `false`。 |
| `HARNESS_ENHANCE_COMPONENTS` | 启用的组件，逗号分隔；常用值为 `invocation_context,compactor,response_verification`。 |
| `HARNESS_PROFILE` | 插件运行 profile，用于区分运行策略；默认 `default`。 |
| `HARNESS_COMPRESSION_PROVIDER` | 工具结果压缩 provider，默认 `builtin`；可选 `headroom`。 |
| `HARNESS_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS` | 上下文压缩阈值，默认 `24000`。 |
| `HARNESS_MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS` | 单个工具结果压缩阈值，默认 `4000`。 |
| `HARNESS_VERIFIER_MODE` | 最终回答校验模式，`observe` 或 `block`，默认 `observe`。 |
| `HARNESS_STORE_PATH` | 可选 JSONL 事件存储路径；不设置时使用内存存储。 |

`harness_enhance` 配置块会在 HarnessApp Runtime 部署时映射为这些环境变量。推荐开发者优先通过 `harness.yaml` 或 `veadk agentkit invoke` 参数启用，环境变量适合平台集成和镜像运行时。

## 数据库

统一前缀 `DATABASE_`，按存储类型分组。记忆与知识库按所选后端读取对应配置。

| 子类 | 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| OpenSearch | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_HOST` | 主机地址（不含协议头） |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PORT` | 端口，默认 9200 |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USERNAME` | 用户名 |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD` | 密码 |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_CERT_PATH` | 证书路径（生产环境建议配置） |
| | `DATABASE_OPENSEARCH_USE_SSL` | 是否启用 SSL，默认 True |
| MySQL | `DATABASE_MYSQL_HOST` | 主机地址 |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_USER` | 用户名 |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_PASSWORD` | 密码 |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_DATABASE` | 数据库名 |
| | `DATABASE_MYSQL_CHARSET` | 字符集，默认 utf8 |
| Redis | `DATABASE_REDIS_HOST` | 主机地址 |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_PORT` | 端口，默认 6379 |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_PASSWORD` | 密码 |
| | `DATABASE_REDIS_DB` | 数据库编号，默认 0 |
| VikingDB | `DATABASE_VIKING_PROJECT` | 项目名称 |
| | `DATABASE_VIKING_REGION` | 区域 |
| TOS | `DATABASE_TOS_ENDPOINT` | 访问端点 |
| | `DATABASE_TOS_REGION` | 区域 |
| | `DATABASE_TOS_BUCKET` | 桶名称 |

## 可观测

统一前缀 `OBSERVABILITY_`，配置追踪与指标的上报目标。

| 子类 | 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- | :- |
| APMPlus | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_ENDPOINT` | 上报地址 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_API_KEY` | 鉴权密钥 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_APMPLUS_SERVICE_NAME` | 服务名称 |
| CozeLoop | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_ENDPOINT` | 上报地址 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_API_KEY` | 鉴权密钥 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_COZELOOP_SERVICE_NAME` | 服务空间 ID |
| TLS | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_ENDPOINT` | 上报地址 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_SERVICE_NAME` | topic_id |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_OPENTELEMETRY_TLS_REGION` | 区域 |
| Prometheus | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_PUSHGATEWAY_URL` | Pushgateway 地址 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_USERNAME` | 用户名 |
| | `OBSERVABILITY_PROMETHEUS_PASSWORD` | 密码 |

## 其他

| 环境变量 | 释义 |
| :- | :- |
| `PROMPT_PILOT_API_KEY` | Prompt Pilot 产品密钥 |
| `VEIDENTITY_REGION` | 身份认证服务区域，默认 cn-beijing |
| `VEIDENTITY_ENDPOINT` | 身份认证服务端点（可选，不填自动生成） |

```yaml title="config.yaml"
veidentity:
  region: cn-beijing
  endpoint:  # 可选，不提供时自动生成
```

# index.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/index.en.mdx

title: "Configuration"

VeADK separates configuration from code. Model keys, database connections, and service addresses change across environments and don't belong in source, so configuration supplies them. The same code then moves cleanly between local, staging, and production. Secrets stay out of the repository.

Configuration comes in three layers, from static to dynamic:

- **Environment variables**: read at startup, the most common layer. Holds model keys and connection details, supplied via system environment variables, `.env`, or `config.yaml`.
- **Built-in defaults**: sensible defaults for common settings, so it runs with zero configuration.
- **Runtime dynamic config**: hot-update the prompt, model, and other settings after deployment, with no restart.

## Priority

When a setting appears in more than one place, the value is taken in this order (higher first):

1. System environment variables
2. The `.env` file in the project root
3. The `config.yaml` file
4. Built-in defaults

`config.yaml` suits centralized management of most settings; system environment variables override individual ones in a specific environment; anything unset falls back to built-in defaults.

<Callout type="warn">
Put secrets in environment variables or `config.yaml` — **never hard-code them**. Add both `.env` and `config.yaml` to `.gitignore` so they don't reach the repository.

## The three layers

<Cards>
  <Card title="Environment variables" href="/en/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables" description="Domain-grouped variables and their config.yaml mapping — for secrets and connection details." />
  <Card title="Built-in defaults" href="/en/docs/references/configuration/constants" description="Run with zero config: the defaults the framework ships for common settings." />
  <Card title="Runtime dynamic config" href="/en/docs/references/configuration/runtime" description="Hot-update the prompt and model after deployment, without a restart." />
</Cards>

---

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/index.mdx

title: "配置"

VeADK 将配置与代码分离。模型密钥、数据库连接、服务地址会随环境变化，也不宜写入源码，因此统一由配置提供。同一份代码即可在本地、测试与生产间迁移，密钥也不会进入代码仓库。

配置分为三层，由静到动：

- **环境变量**：启动时读取，最常用。存放模型密钥与连接信息，可通过系统环境变量、`.env` 或 `config.yaml` 提供。
- **内置默认值**：常用项均有合理缺省，零配置即可运行。
- **运行时动态配置**：部署后无需重启，热更新提示词、模型等设定。

## 优先级

同一项配置在多处出现时，按以下顺序取值（越靠前优先级越高）：

1. 系统环境变量
2. 项目根目录下的 `.env` 文件
3. `config.yaml` 文件
4. 框架内置默认值

`config.yaml` 适合集中管理大部分配置，系统环境变量用于在特定环境临时覆盖个别项；未提供的项回落到内置默认值。

<Callout type="warn">
密钥应放入环境变量或 `config.yaml`，**切勿硬编码到代码**。`.env` 与 `config.yaml` 都应加入 `.gitignore`，避免提交到代码仓库。

## 三层配置

<Cards>
  <Card title="环境变量" href="/cn/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables" description="按领域分组的环境变量与 config.yaml 对照，存放密钥与连接信息。" />
  <Card title="内置默认值" href="/cn/docs/references/configuration/constants" description="零配置即可运行：框架为常用项预置的缺省值。" />
  <Card title="运行时动态配置" href="/cn/docs/references/configuration/runtime" description="部署后无需重启，热更新提示词与模型等设定。" />
</Cards>

# runtime.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/runtime.en.mdx

title: "Runtime dynamic config"

Environment variables and defaults are fixed at startup and don't change once the process is running. Production often calls for adjusting an agent without restarting or redeploying — swapping the prompt temporarily, or switching models to compare results. Runtime dynamic config (hot-update) addresses this.

## How it works

Mutable settings are hosted in a config center, in three steps:

1. **Publish**: push a config describing the agent's settings to the config center;
2. **Subscribe**: the running agent subscribes to that config;
3. **Apply**: when the config changes, the agent fetches and updates in place, with no restart.

It is backed by Volcengine's managed config service; credentials are supplied via environment variables or injected automatically by the platform in cloud deployments, so connection details need no attention.

<Callout type="info">
Dynamic config suits frequently changing content (prompt, model). Startup-time config such as secrets and connection details remains managed by [environment variables](/en/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables).

## Hot-updatable fields

The config is JSON, with an `agent` array describing one or more agents. Each entry may include:

| Field | Meaning |
| :- | :- |
| `id` | The target agent's identifier; must match a running agent for precise matching |
| `name` | Name (for display and logs) |
| `description` | Description (for display and logs) |
| `model_name` | Model name; changing it switches the agent's model |
| `instruction` | System prompt defining the agent's behavior |

```json
{
  "agent": [
    {
      "id": "...",
      "name": "...",
      "description": "...",
      "model_name": "...",
      "instruction": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```

Updates match an agent by `id`; on a match, name, description, model, and prompt are replaced immediately, with a model change triggering a smooth model switch.

---

# runtime.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/configuration/runtime.mdx

title: "运行时动态配置"

环境变量与默认值在启动时确定，进程运行后不再改变。生产环境往往需要在不重启、不重新部署的前提下调整智能体，例如临时更换提示词或切换模型对比效果。运行时动态配置（热更新）即为此而设。

## 工作方式

可变设定托管在配置中心，运转分三步：

1. **下发**：将描述智能体设定的配置发布到配置中心；
2. **订阅**：运行中的智能体订阅该配置；
3. **生效**：配置变化时，智能体实时拉取并就地更新，无需重启。

底层由火山引擎托管配置服务承载，凭据通过环境变量提供，或在云上部署时由平台自动注入，无需关心连接细节。

<Callout type="info">
动态配置适合调整频繁变动的内容（提示词、模型）。密钥与连接信息等启动期配置仍由[环境变量](/cn/docs/references/configuration/environment-variables)管理。

## 可热更新的字段

配置采用 JSON 结构，用一个 `agent` 数组描述一个或多个智能体的设定。每个条目可包含：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| :- | :- |
| `id` | 目标智能体的标识，须与运行中的智能体一致，用于精确匹配 |
| `name` | 名称（用于展示与日志） |
| `description` | 描述（用于展示与日志） |
| `model_name` | 模型名称，变更后智能体会切换到新模型 |
| `instruction` | 系统提示词，定义智能体的行为 |

```json
{
  "agent": [
    {
      "id": "...",
      "name": "...",
      "description": "...",
      "model_name": "...",
      "instruction": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```

更新通过 `id` 匹配到对应的智能体；命中后，名称、描述、模型与提示词会被即时替换——其中模型变更会触发一次平滑的模型切换。

---

# contributing.en.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/contributing.en.mdx

title: "Contributing"

Contributions to VeADK code and docs are welcome. This page walks you through setting up a local development environment and the submission flow.

## Set up your environment

<Steps>

<Step>
### Clone and install

VeADK requires Python 3.10+. Install in editable mode with the dev dependencies:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python.git
cd veadk-python

pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

The repo manages dependencies and a lockfile with `uv`; you can also set everything up (including the `dev` group) in one step:

```bash
uv sync --extra dev
```

<Callout type="info">
  Install optional extras as needed: `extensions` (memory / knowledge-base backends), `eval` (evaluation), `a2ui` (agent-driven UI), and more. For example, `pip install -e ".[dev,eval]"`.
</Step>

<Step>
### Install the pre-commit hooks

`pre-commit` runs Ruff (formatting and linting) and gitleaks (secret-leak detection) before you commit. Commits that fail these checks won't pass GitHub CI and therefore won't be merged.

```bash
pre-commit install
```

`pre-commit` is included in the `dev` dependencies. Once installed, every `git commit` runs the hooks automatically; you can also run them across all files manually:

```bash
pre-commit run --all-files
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Run the tests

Tests live in the `tests/` directory and run with `pytest`:

```bash
pytest
```

Run a single file or directory:

```bash
pytest tests/test_agent.py
```

<Callout type="warn">
  Some tests require Volcengine credentials or external backends (such as Redis or OpenSearch). These are skipped or fail without the corresponding environment variables, so focus on the cases relevant to your change before opening a PR.
</Step>

</Steps>

## Development conventions

- Follow the [Google Python Style Guide](https://google.github.io/styleguide/pyguide.html).
- Make sure `pre-commit run --all-files` and `pytest` pass before submitting.
- When a change affects behavior or interfaces, update `docs/` and `README.md` accordingly.

## Open a pull request

<Steps>

<Step>
### Fork and branch

```bash
git checkout -b feat/your-feature
```
</Step>

<Step>
### Commit and push

After pre-commit and the tests pass, commit and push to your fork.
</Step>

<Step>
### Open the PR

Open a pull request against the `main` branch of `volcengine/veadk-python`, clearly describing the motivation and the change. Maintainers typically respond within 1 to 2 business days.
</Step>

</Steps>

---

# contributing.mdx

Source: https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python/blob/main/docs/content/docs/references/contributing.mdx

title: "贡献代码"

欢迎为 VeADK 贡献代码与文档。本页带你完成本地开发环境的搭建和提交流程。

## 准备开发环境

<Steps>

<Step>
### 克隆并安装

VeADK 需要 Python 3.10+。以可编辑模式安装，并带上开发依赖：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/volcengine/veadk-python.git
cd veadk-python

pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

仓库使用 `uv` 管理依赖与锁文件，你也可以用它一步装好（含 `dev` 分组）：

```bash
uv sync --extra dev
```

<Callout type="info">
  可选依赖按需安装：`extensions`（记忆 / 知识库后端）、`eval`（评测）、`a2ui`（智能体驱动 UI）等。例如 `pip install -e ".[dev,eval]"`。
</Step>

<Step>
### 安装 pre-commit 钩子

`pre-commit` 会在你提交代码前运行 Ruff（格式化与 lint）和 gitleaks（密钥泄漏检查）。未通过这些检查的提交无法通过 GitHub CI，也就无法被合并。

```bash
pre-commit install
```

`dev` 依赖里已包含 `pre-commit`。安装后，每次 `git commit` 都会自动运行钩子；也可以手动对全部文件运行一次：

```bash
pre-commit run --all-files
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 运行测试

测试位于 `tests/` 目录，使用 `pytest`：

```bash
pytest
```

只运行某个文件或目录：

```bash
pytest tests/test_agent.py
```

<Callout type="warn">
  部分测试需要火山引擎凭据或外部后端（如 Redis、OpenSearch）。这类测试在缺少对应环境变量时会跳过或失败，提交 PR 前请关注与你改动相关的用例。
</Step>

</Steps>

## 开发规范

- 遵循 [Google Python 风格指南](https://google.github.io/styleguide/pyguide.html)。
- 提交前确保 `pre-commit run --all-files` 与 `pytest` 通过。
- 改动涉及行为或接口时，同步更新 `docs/` 与 `README.md`。

## 提交 Pull Request

<Steps>

<Step>
### Fork 并新建分支

```bash
git checkout -b feat/your-feature
```
</Step>

<Step>
### 提交并推送

确保 pre-commit 与测试通过后提交、推送到你的 Fork。
</Step>

<Step>
### 发起 PR

在 GitHub 上向 `volcengine/veadk-python` 的 `main` 分支发起 Pull Request，清晰描述改动动机与内容。维护者通常会在 1 至 2 个工作日内处理。
</Step>

</Steps>
